trans-unit.source: Counts down to a fixed moment, or through a duration, with rolling digit wheels (Arc Countdown), and morphs into a live label at zero. The clock ticks just after each whole second, only while the countdown is on screen; a separate `PausableTimer` makes `Completed` land on time even while ticking is paused. A `Duration` countdown can be paused and resumed (`IsPaused`, `Pause`, `Resume`); a `Target` countdown counts to a fixed instant, so pausing only freezes the display. Wheels turn the short way round; the shell springs to the size of whatever it holds.
trans-unit.target: 倒數至一個固定時刻，或在一段時長內倒數，以滾動數字輪顯示（Arc Countdown），歸零時變形為即時標籤。時鐘僅在倒數計時顯示於畫面上時，於每個整秒之後稍後滴答；獨立的 `PausableTimer` 使 `Completed` 即使在暫停滴答時也能準時觸發。`Duration` 倒數計時可暫停與恢復（`IsPaused`、`Pause`、`Resume`）；`Target` 倒數計時則倒數至一個固定時刻，因此暫停只會凍結顯示。數字輪沿最短路徑轉動；外殼會彈簧式地調整為所容納內容的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: Shown once the countdown reaches zero, beside a pulsing live dot (Arc `completeLabel`, "Live now").
trans-unit.target: 倒數計時歸零後顯示，位於脈動的即時圓點旁（Arc `completeLabel`，「Live now」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once, the moment the countdown reaches zero while it is shown.
trans-unit.target: 在倒數計時顯示期間剛好歸零的那一刻引發，僅引發一次。

trans-unit.source: Counts down this long from when the countdown is shown (or restarted); pausable.
trans-unit.target: 從倒數計時顯示（或重新開始）時起倒數這麼長時間；可暫停。

trans-unit.source: True once the countdown has reached zero.
trans-unit.target: 倒數計時一旦歸零即為 true。

trans-unit.source: Pauses a duration countdown (remaining time is kept); freezes the display of a target countdown.
trans-unit.target: 暫停時長倒數計時（保留剩餘時間）；凍結目標倒數計時的顯示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name (Arc `label`, "Time remaining").
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱（Arc `label`，「Time remaining」）。

trans-unit.source: Time left, read from the clock on every tick.
trans-unit.target: 剩餘時間，每次滴答時從時鐘讀取。

trans-unit.source: The moment to count down to. Takes precedence over `Duration`.
trans-unit.target: 倒數至的時刻。優先於 `Duration`。

trans-unit.source: Clock source; pass a server-synced provider when device time cannot be trusted.
trans-unit.target: 時鐘來源；當裝置時間不可信時，傳入與伺服器同步的提供程式。

trans-unit.source: Units to show, largest first; the largest absorbs the rest. Defaults to days through seconds.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的單位，由大到小排列；最大的單位吸收其餘部分。預設為天至秒。

trans-unit.source: Large display digits with unit names (default) or one compact pill.
trans-unit.target: 帶單位名稱的大型顯示數字（預設），或緊湊的單一膠囊。

trans-unit.source: An animated data pipeline: events leave their sources, queue up in an event stream, are validated and enriched in batches (some are filtered out) and land in a warehouse, with part of them pushed to live dashboards. Readouts show throughput and what has been stored.
trans-unit.target: 動畫資料管線：事件從各來源送出，在事件串流中排隊，分批驗證並豐富化（部分事件會被過濾掉），最後存入資料倉儲，其中一部分會推送到即時儀表板。讀數顯示吞吐量與已儲存的數量。

trans-unit.source: How many events per second the sources emit (1–60).
trans-unit.target: 來源每秒送出的事件數（1–60）。

trans-unit.source: Share of events the transform filters out (0–0.5).
trans-unit.target: 轉換步驟過濾掉的事件比例（0–0.5）。

trans-unit.source: Node titles, details and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的節點標題、詳細資訊與說明文字；設定此項即可重新命名或翻譯場景。

trans-unit.source: The event sources (1–4); defaults to a web app, a mobile app and webhooks.
trans-unit.target: 事件來源（1–4）；預設為網頁應用程式、行動應用程式和 Webhook。

trans-unit.source: Every visible word of a `DataFlow` (override for another language or domain).
trans-unit.target: `DataFlow` 中所有可見的文字（可覆寫，以用於其他語言或領域）。

trans-unit.source: A spreadsheet grid for editing tabular data in place: range selection, a fill handle, Excel and Google Sheets clipboard, undo, multi-column sort, a filter row and quick search, pinned and hidden columns, row checks with bulk actions, a totals row, grouping with subtotals, CSV and Excel export, and rows and columns that render only while in view. Every piece of view state (sort, filters, search, checked rows, hidden and pinned columns, density, grouping) is a two-way property, so it works bound or left to the grid. Rows come from `ItemsSource` (`DataGridRow` objects or any class read through column bindings or accessors), or block by block from a `DataSource`. Edits write back into the row items and raise `CellsChanged`; editing never re-sorts or re-filters, so rows never jump under the cursor.
trans-unit.target: 就地編輯表格資料的試算表式表格：範圍選取、填滿控點、與 Excel 和 Google 試算表互通的剪貼簿、復原、多欄排序、篩選列和快速搜尋、固定與隱藏欄、列勾選與批次操作、總計列、分組小計、CSV 與 Excel 匯出，列和欄只在可見時繪製。所有檢視狀態（排序、篩選、搜尋、勾選列、隱藏和固定的欄、列密度、分組）都是雙向屬性，既可以繫結，也可以交給表格自行管理。列來自 `ItemsSource`（`DataGridRow` 物件，或透過欄的繫結或存取函式讀取的任意類別），或者透過 `DataSource` 分塊載入。編輯會寫回列物件並引發 `CellsChanged`；編輯不會重新排序或篩選，列不會在游標下跳動。

trans-unit.source: The active cell (display row and visible column), or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 作用中的儲存格（顯示列號與可見欄序號）；表格沒有儲存格時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a bulk action is clicked (its command runs too).
trans-unit.target: 按下批次操作時引發（它的命令也會執行）。

trans-unit.source: Shows Delete for checked rows; deleting can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 為勾選的列顯示「刪除」；刪除可以復原。

trans-unit.source: Decides per cell whether it can be edited, on top of `IsEditable` (for example locking the rows of closed deals). Edits, pastes, fills and clears skip cells it refuses. Keep it cheap: it runs for every cell a write touches.
trans-unit.target: 在欄的 `IsEditable` 之外，逐一儲存格決定能否編輯（例如鎖定已結案交易的列）。編輯、貼上、填滿和清除會略過它拒絕的儲存格。請保持輕量：每次寫入涉及的每個儲存格都會執行它。

trans-unit.source: Shows Add row in the toolbar and allows `AddRow` and `InsertRow` (Ctrl+Shift+Plus inserts above the active row). Needs an `ItemsSource` that is a writable list, and either `DataGridRow` rows or a `RowFactory`. Added rows can be undone. Default false.
trans-unit.target: 在工具列顯示「新增列」，並允許呼叫 `AddRow` 和 `InsertRow`（Ctrl+Shift+加號在作用列上方插入）。需要可寫入清單的 `ItemsSource`，以及 `DataGridRow` 列或 `RowFactory`。新增的列可以復原。預設 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to redo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可重做的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to undo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可復原的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a body cell is pressed with the primary button, after the selection moved (or when a renderer took the press).
trans-unit.target: 用主按鈕按下主體儲存格時觸發，此時選取範圍已經移動（或轉譯器已經接管了這次按下）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a context menu is asked for on a body cell; set `Handled` to show your own menu instead of the built-in one.
trans-unit.target: 在主體儲存格上要求右鍵選單時觸發；設定 `Handled` 可以顯示你自己的選單，而不是內建選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised on a double click or double tap of a body cell, before the editor opens; set `Handled` to keep the editor from opening.
trans-unit.target: 按兩下主體儲存格時、編輯器開啟之前觸發；設定 `Handled` 可以阻止編輯器開啟。

trans-unit.source: Raised before an edit is written; cancel it to keep the editor open with an error.
trans-unit.target: 編輯寫入前引發；取消它可讓編輯器保持開啟並顯示錯誤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a cell renderer reports a click on something actionable, such as a link.
trans-unit.target: 當儲存格轉譯器回報對可操作內容（例如連結）的點擊時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Picks a tone for a cell from its row and value, for looks the column's `FormatRules` cannot express. It runs for every cell in view on every frame, so keep it cheap; null from it falls through to the format rules.
trans-unit.target: 根據儲存格所在的列和值為它選擇色調，用於欄的 `FormatRules` 無法表達的外觀。它每一影格都會為檢視區內的每個儲存格執行，所以請保持輕量；回傳 null 時交給格式規則處理。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an edit, paste, cut, clear, fill, fill down, undo or redo wrote cells.
trans-unit.target: 編輯、貼上、剪下、清除、填滿、向下填滿、復原或重做寫入儲存格後引發。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the checked rows, in data order (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 勾選列的鍵，依資料順序（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Column keys in display order (people drag headers, or press Alt+Shift+arrows in one, to change it). Columns not listed follow in their defined order; null keeps the defined order. Pinned columns still come first. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的欄索引鍵（使用者拖曳表頭，或在表頭上按 Alt+Shift+方向鍵來改變它）。未列出的欄依定義順序排在後面；為 null 時保持定義順序。固定欄仍然排在最前。雙向。

trans-unit.source: The widths people set by dragging, double clicking or pressing Alt+arrows on a header, by column key. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 使用者透過拖曳、按兩下或在表頭上按 Alt+方向鍵設定的寬度，依欄索引鍵保存。雙向。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the built-in menu opens, so the entries can be changed or the menu cancelled.
trans-unit.target: 在內建選單開啟之前觸發，可以修改項目或取消選單。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting and parsing values; null follows the AtomUI language.
trans-unit.target: 格式化和解析值所用的文化；為 null 時跟隨 AtomUI 的語言。

trans-unit.source: Loads rows from a server one block at a time as people scroll, instead of `ItemsSource`. The grid is then read only, does not group, hides Select all and exports only checked rows.
trans-unit.target: 取代 `ItemsSource`，在捲動時從伺服器分塊載入列。此時表格為唯讀、不分組、隱藏全選，並且只匯出勾選列。

trans-unit.source: Row density (two-way): Compact 32px, Standard 40px or Comfortable 48px rows.
trans-unit.target: 列密度（雙向）：Compact 32px、Standard 40px 或 Comfortable 48px。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there are no rows at all; null uses the built-in "No rows yet".
trans-unit.target: 完全沒有列時顯示的文字；為 null 時使用內建的「尚無資料」。

trans-unit.source: How many cells are flagged for failing their rules (see `Flag` and `ValidateAll`).
trans-unit.target: 因不符合規則而被標出的儲存格數量（見 `Flag` 和 `ValidateAll`）。

trans-unit.source: Export file name without the extension; null derives one from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 匯出檔名（不含副檔名）；為 null 時由 `Label` 產生。

trans-unit.source: Formats Export offers; with more than one, Export opens a menu.
trans-unit.target: 「匯出」提供的格式；多於一種時，「匯出」會開啟選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the save dialog of an export opens.
trans-unit.target: 匯出的儲存對話方塊開啟前引發。

trans-unit.source: Column filters by column key (two-way). The filter row opens when any filter is set at start.
trans-unit.target: 依欄鍵的欄篩選（雙向）。開始時設定了任何篩選，篩選列就會展開。

trans-unit.source: Group-by column keys, outermost first (two-way). Group rows show a toggle, the value, a count and subtotals.
trans-unit.target: 分組欄鍵，外層在前（雙向）。分組列顯示摺疊按鈕、分組值、列數和小計。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the hidden columns (two-way); null uses each column's `IsHidden`.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏欄的鍵（雙向）；為 null 時使用各欄的 `IsHidden`。

trans-unit.source: Whether a cell editor is open.
trans-unit.target: 儲存格編輯器是否開啟。

trans-unit.source: Whether the filter row is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 篩選列是否展開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Shows six placeholder rows while data loads.
trans-unit.target: 資料載入時顯示六列預留列。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row gutter with row numbers and checkboxes for checking rows.
trans-unit.target: 顯示帶列號和核取方塊的列號欄，用於勾選列。

trans-unit.source: Row items: `DataGridRow` objects or any objects the columns can read. `INotifyCollectionChanged` sources are followed.
trans-unit.target: 列物件：`DataGridRow` 或欄能讀取的任意物件。會追蹤 `INotifyCollectionChanged` 資料來源的變化。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the grid; also names exported files and the xlsx worksheet.
trans-unit.target: 表格的無障礙名稱；也用於命名匯出檔案和 xlsx 工作表。

trans-unit.source: Most cells a paste may hold (default 1,000,000). A bigger clipboard is refused with a message instead of being read, so a huge or hostile table cannot exhaust memory.
trans-unit.target: 一次貼上最多允許的儲存格數（預設 1,000,000）。超過時會拒絕並給出提示，而不是讀取內容，因此過大或惡意構造的表格不會耗盡記憶體。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the scrolling area grows before it scrolls, in px (default 400); infinity fills the available height.
trans-unit.target: 捲動區域開始捲動前的最大高度，單位 px（預設 400）；無限大表示佔滿可用高度。

trans-unit.source: Prefixes exported CSV text that a spreadsheet would run as a formula (it starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return) with a single quote, which blocks CSV injection (default true). Numbers and days are not touched.
trans-unit.target: 為匯出的 CSV 中試算表會當作公式執行的文字（以 =、+、-、@、定位字元或歸位字元開頭）加上一個單引號前綴，以防止 CSV 注入（預設 true）。數字和日期不受影響。

trans-unit.source: What a paste does with clipboard rows that run past the last row: drop them (default) or add rows for them.
trans-unit.target: 貼上時超出最後一列的剪貼簿列如何處理：捨棄（預設）或為它們新增列。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the pinned columns (two-way); null uses `IsPinned`, or the first column when no column sets it.
trans-unit.target: 固定欄的鍵（雙向）；為 null 時使用 `IsPinned`，沒有任何欄設定時固定第一欄。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter is pressed on a cell that cannot be edited, and on a double click of the row number: "open this row".
trans-unit.target: 對不可編輯的儲存格按 Enter 時觸發，也在按兩下列號時觸發：「開啟這一列」。

trans-unit.source: Creates the object for a new row, for typed rows: `() => new Account()`. Rows of `DataGridRow` need no factory. Give typed rows a key that `RowKeySelector` reads and that no other row has.
trans-unit.target: 為自有類別的列建立新列的物件：`() => new Account()`。`DataGridRow` 類型的列不需要工廠。請給自有類別的列一個 `RowKeySelector` 能讀到、且沒有其他列使用的索引鍵。

trans-unit.source: Stable row identity; defaults to `Key`, else the item itself. Required with `DataSource`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的列識別；預設用 `Key`，否則用列物件本身。使用 `DataSource` 時必須設定。

trans-unit.source: Tints a whole row with a tone chosen from the row object (null for no tint). Runs for every row in view on every frame.
trans-unit.target: 根據列物件選擇的色調為整列著色（回傳 null 表示不著色）。每一影格都會為檢視區內的每一列執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after checked rows were deleted (removed from the source when it is a writable list).
trans-unit.target: 勾選的列被刪除後引發（資料來源是可寫入清單時會從中移除）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after rows are added, and after a redo puts them back (undoing an addition raises `RowsDeleted`).
trans-unit.target: 在新增列之後，以及取消復原把它們放回去之後觸發（復原新增會觸發 `RowsDeleted`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a delete was undone (rows put back into a writable source at their old indices).
trans-unit.target: 刪除被復原後引發（列依原來的位置放回可寫入的資料來源）。

trans-unit.source: Quick search text (two-way): every word must appear in some visible column.
trans-unit.target: 快速搜尋文字（雙向）：每個字詞都必須出現在某個可見欄中。

trans-unit.source: The selected range, or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 選取的範圍；表格沒有儲存格時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Shows the built-in right-click menu (also Shift+F10 and the menu key, and a long press on touch). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示內建的右鍵選單（也包括 Shift+F10、功能表鍵，以及觸控螢幕上的長按）。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row number in the gutter. When false the gutter narrows to 40px and its checkboxes always show.
trans-unit.target: 在列號欄顯示列號。為 false 時列號欄縮窄到 40px，核取方塊一律顯示。

trans-unit.source: Shows the selection address and the Sum, Average and Count of the selected cells in the status bar.
trans-unit.target: 在狀態列顯示選取範圍位址以及所選儲存格的加總、平均值和計數。

trans-unit.source: Shows the toolbar with search, undo and redo, filters, columns, density and export.
trans-unit.target: 顯示工具列：搜尋、復原與重做、篩選、欄、列密度和匯出。

trans-unit.source: Shows the sticky totals row; it covers every row the filters keep, collapsed groups included.
trans-unit.target: 顯示固定在底部的總計列；它統計篩選後保留的全部列，包括摺疊分組中的列。

trans-unit.source: Sort keys in priority order (two-way). Header clicks, Shift-clicks and the column menu change it.
trans-unit.target: 依優先順序排列的排序鍵（雙向）。按一下欄標題、按住 Shift 按一下和欄選單都會改變它。

trans-unit.source: Steps kept for undo (default 100; 0 turns undo off).
trans-unit.target: 復原保留的步數（預設 100；0 表示關閉復原）。

trans-unit.source: What happens to a value that fails its column's rules: refused (default) or accepted and flagged.
trans-unit.target: 不符合欄規則的值如何處理：拒絕（預設），或接受並標出。

trans-unit.source: Number of rows the filters keep (the data source's row count with a `DataSource`).
trans-unit.target: 篩選後保留的列數（使用 `DataSource` 時為資料來源回報的列數）。

trans-unit.source: An extra toolbar action for checked rows, shown between Export and Delete.
trans-unit.target: 勾選列時工具列上的額外操作，顯示在「匯出」和「刪除」之間。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the checked rows (an `IReadOnlyList<object>` in data order) as its parameter.
trans-unit.target: 執行時以勾選的列（依資料順序的 `IReadOnlyList<object>`）作為參數。

trans-unit.source: A 24x24 Lucide geometry shown before the label (such as `ArcIcons.Archive`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤前的 24x24 Lucide 幾何圖形（例如 `ArcIcons.Archive`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the button in the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 以危險色繪製按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Button text; also the accessible name. The label hides below 640px of grid width.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕文字，也是無障礙名稱。表格寬度小於 640px 時隱藏標籤。

trans-unit.source: One icon button of an `ActionsRenderer`.
trans-unit.target: `ActionsRenderer` 的一個圖示按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the row object as its parameter; the button is disabled while `CanExecute` is false.
trans-unit.target: 以該列物件為參數執行；`CanExecute` 為 false 時按鈕被停用。

trans-unit.source: A 24 x 24 stroked geometry drawn at 16 px (such as `ArcIcons.Trash2`).
trans-unit.target: 24 x 24 的描邊幾何圖形，以 16 px 繪製（例如 `ArcIcons.Trash2`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the icon in the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 用危險色繪製圖示。

trans-unit.source: Names the action in `Part` and for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Part` 中以及對螢幕閱讀器命名這個動作。

trans-unit.source: One cell as the grid hands it to a validation rule, an editability predicate or a style selector.
trans-unit.target: 表格交給驗證規則、可編輯判斷或樣式選擇器的一個儲存格。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of the cell events of a `DataGrid`: `CellClick`, `CellDoubleClick`, `CellContextRequested` and `RowActivated`.
trans-unit.target: `DataGrid` 儲存格事件的引數：`CellClick`、`CellDoubleClick`、`CellContextRequested` 和 `RowActivated`。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `CellInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: `CellInvoked` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A pointer press over a cell, for `OnPointerPressed`.
trans-unit.target: 儲存格上的一次指標按下，用於 `OnPointerPressed`。

trans-unit.source: Everything a `DataGridCellRenderer` needs to draw one cell.
trans-unit.target: `DataGridCellRenderer` 繪製一個儲存格所需的全部資訊。

trans-unit.source: Draws the cells of a `DataGridColumn` in place of the plain text: a status badge, a progress bar, a link, an icon. The grid keeps drawing rows itself, so a renderer is a few draw calls over the cell, never a control. Sorting, filtering, totals, copy and export keep working on the column's value; `GetText` decides the text that copy and screen readers see.
trans-unit.target: 取代純文字來繪製 `DataGridColumn` 的儲存格：狀態徽章、進度列、連結、圖示。表格仍然自己繪製列，所以轉譯器只是在儲存格上的幾次繪製呼叫，絕不是控制項。排序、篩選、合計、複製和匯出仍然作用於欄的值；`GetText` 決定複製和螢幕閱讀器看到的文字。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `DataGrid`. The cell value comes from `ValueGetter`, else from `Binding` (a compiled binding against the row item, written back two-way), else from the `DataGridRow` field (or dictionary entry) named by `Key`. Values are normalized to a string, a `Decimal`, a `DateOnly` or null by `Type`.
trans-unit.target: `DataGrid` 的一欄。儲存格的值來自 `ValueGetter`，其次是 `Binding`（針對列物件的編譯繫結，雙向寫回），再次是 `Key` 指定的 `DataGridRow` 欄位（或字典項目）。值依 `Type` 正規化為字串、`Decimal`、`DateOnly` 或 null。

trans-unit.source: What the totals row and group subtotals show; null sums numbers and currency, averages percent and shows nothing otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 總計列和分組小計顯示的內容；為 null 時數字和貨幣加總、百分比取平均，其他類型不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Symbol of a Currency column (default "$"); it does not change with the interface language.
trans-unit.target: 貨幣欄的符號（預設 "$"）；不隨介面語言變化。

trans-unit.source: .NET format of a Date column (such as "yyyy-MM-dd"); null uses the language's short date with the month name.
trans-unit.target: 日期欄的 .NET 格式（例如 "yyyy-MM-dd"）；為 null 時使用該語言帶月份名稱的日期格式。

trans-unit.source: Decimal places of Number, Currency and Percent values.
trans-unit.target: Number、Currency 和 Percent 值的小數位數。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the text box that edits the column's cells with your own content (a slider, a rating, a picker). The template gets a `DataGridEditContext` as its data context; only the cell being edited is a real control.
trans-unit.target: 用你自己的內容（滑桿、評分、選擇器）取代編輯該欄儲存格的文字方塊。範本以 `DataGridEditContext` 作為資料內容；只有正在編輯的儲存格是真正的控制項。

trans-unit.source: Header text; also used for copied header rows, exports and accessible names.
trans-unit.target: 欄標題文字；也用於複製的標題列、匯出和無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: False makes the column read only: edits, pastes, fills and clears skip it.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時欄為唯讀：編輯、貼上、填滿和清除都會略過它。

trans-unit.source: False leaves the filter cell empty and drops Filter from the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時篩選格留空，欄選單中也沒有「篩選」。

trans-unit.source: Offers Group by in the column menu; null allows it for Text, Select and Date columns.
trans-unit.target: 欄選單是否提供「依此欄分組」；為 null 時 Text、Select 和 Date 欄可以分組。

trans-unit.source: Starts hidden; people can show it again from the Columns menu.
trans-unit.target: 初始隱藏；使用者可以在「欄」選單中重新顯示它。

trans-unit.source: Starts pinned to the left edge. When no column sets it, the first column is pinned.
trans-unit.target: 初始固定在左側。沒有任何欄設定它時，固定第一欄。

trans-unit.source: False disables the header sort button and the sort items of the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時停用欄標題的排序按鈕和欄選單中的排序項目。

trans-unit.source: Row field the column reads and writes; also the id used by sorting, filters, pinning and hiding.
trans-unit.target: 該欄讀寫的列欄位；也是排序、篩選、固定和隱藏使用的識別。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a resize can reach (default 72). Resizing stops at 560px.
trans-unit.target: 調整欄寬能達到的最小寬度（預設 72）。最大到 560px 為止。

trans-unit.source: Choices of a Select column, in sort order; null uses up to 200 distinct values already in the column.
trans-unit.target: Select 欄的選項，依排序順序；為 null 時取該欄已有的最多 200 個不同值。

trans-unit.source: Draws the column's cells in place of the plain text: a status badge, a progress bar, a link, an icon, or your own `DataGridCellRenderer`. Null draws the formatted value. Sorting, filtering, totals and export still use the value.
trans-unit.target: 取代純文字來繪製該欄的儲存格：狀態徽章、進度列、連結、圖示，或你自己的 `DataGridCellRenderer`。為 null 時繪製格式化後的值。排序、篩選、合計和匯出仍然使用值。

trans-unit.source: Kind of data: Text, Number, Currency, Percent, Select or Date.
trans-unit.target: 資料類型：Text、Number、Currency、Percent、Select 或 Date。

trans-unit.source: Starting width in px (default 140). The last column absorbs spare width on a wide grid.
trans-unit.target: 初始寬度，單位 px（預設 140）。表格較寬時，最後一欄吸收多餘的寬度。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ContextMenuOpening`: change `Items` or set `Cancel` to stop the menu.
trans-unit.target: `ContextMenuOpening` 的引數：修改 `Items` 或設定 `Cancel` 來阻止選單。

trans-unit.source: What a `EditTemplate` edits: the value of one cell. The template's content gets this object as its `DataContext`; bind your controls to `Value` and call `Commit` or `Cancel` (Enter, Tab and Escape do the same when the focused control leaves them alone).
trans-unit.target: `EditTemplate` 所編輯的內容：一個儲存格的值。範本的內容以該物件作為 `DataContext`；把你的控制項繫結到 `Value`，並呼叫 `Commit` 或 `Cancel`（當取得焦點的控制項不處理時，Enter、Tab 和 Escape 同樣有效）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Value` or `ErrorMessage` changes.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Value` 或 `ErrorMessage` 變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: A column filter as stored in a `DataGridLayoutState`: an expression or the values a select column keeps.
trans-unit.target: 儲存在 `DataGridLayoutState` 中的欄篩選：一個運算式，或選擇欄保留的值。

trans-unit.source: Tints the cells of a column whose value passes a test, such as an ARR below 10,000 or a stage that reads "Lost". Add rules to `FormatRules`; the first rule that matches decides. Compared values are read the way the column reads typed text, so `Value` for a date column is a day such as 2026-03-01.
trans-unit.target: 為值通過某項測試的欄儲存格著色，例如低於 10,000 的 ARR，或寫著「Lost」的階段。把規則新增到 `FormatRules`；第一條符合的規則生效。被比較的值依該欄讀取輸入文字的方式讀取，所以日期欄的 `Value` 是形如 2026-03-01 的日期。

trans-unit.source: The view of a `DataGrid` that people shape: column order, widths, pinned and hidden columns, sort, filters, grouping and density. `GetLayoutState` reads it and `SetLayoutState` applies it, so a view can be saved when a window closes and restored when it opens. `ToJson` and `FromJson` use a source-generated serializer (trim and AOT safe); unknown fields are ignored and missing fields fall back to the defaults.
trans-unit.target: 使用者塑造的 `DataGrid` 檢視：欄順序、寬度、固定與隱藏的欄、排序、篩選、分組和列密度。`GetLayoutState` 讀取它，`SetLayoutState` 套用它，所以檢視可以在視窗關閉時儲存、在開啟時還原。`ToJson` 和 `FromJson` 使用來源產生的序列化器（對裁剪和 AOT 安全）；未知欄位會被忽略，缺少的欄位回到預設值。

trans-unit.source: An entry you add to the grid's context menu through `ContextMenuItems`.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `ContextMenuItems` 新增到表格右鍵選單的一個項目。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the row object of the clicked cell as its parameter.
trans-unit.target: 以被點擊儲存格的列物件為參數執行。

trans-unit.source: A 24 x 24 stroked geometry shown before the label.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤前的 24 x 24 描邊幾何圖形。

trans-unit.source: The entry's text.
trans-unit.target: 項目的文字。

trans-unit.source: The colors and pens a `DataGridCellRenderer` draws with. They are resolved from the ArcDesign tokens and follow the theme and the accent, so a renderer never holds a color of its own.
trans-unit.target: `DataGridCellRenderer` 繪製時使用的色彩和筆刷。它們由 ArcDesign 權杖解析而來，並跟隨主題和強調色，所以轉譯器從不持有自己的色彩。

trans-unit.source: A check on the values of a column. Add rules to `Rules`; they run when a value is typed, pasted, filled or set by a renderer, and `ValidateAll` runs them over every row. The first rule that returns a message decides.
trans-unit.target: 對欄的值的一項檢查。把規則新增到 `Rules`；在輸入、貼上、填滿或由轉譯器設定值時執行，`ValidateAll` 會對每一列執行它們。第一條回傳訊息的規則生效。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `SortableDataTable`. The cell value comes from `ValueSelector` or `Binding` (compiled against the table's item type in XAML); sorting uses `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` when given, else the cell value, and `Comparer` when given, else Arc's comparison (numbers numerically, text with natural ordering, empty values last in both directions). Cells are drawn as text; `CellTemplate` hosts custom content.
trans-unit.target: `SortableDataTable` 的一欄。儲存格值來自 `ValueSelector` 或 `Binding`（在 XAML 中針對表格的項目類型編譯）；排序時，若提供了 `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` 則使用它們，否則使用儲存格值；若提供了 `Comparer` 則使用它，否則使用 Arc 的比較方式（數字依數值比較，文字依自然排序，空值在兩個方向上都排在最後）。儲存格以文字繪製；`CellTemplate` 用於承載自訂內容。

trans-unit.source: Custom cell content (Arc `render`); the data context is the row item.
trans-unit.target: 自訂儲存格內容（Arc `render`）；資料內容為該列的項目。

trans-unit.source: Column label; also the default `EffectiveKey`.
trans-unit.target: 欄標籤；同時也是預設的 `EffectiveKey`。

trans-unit.source: Right-aligns the column. Null detects it: every non-empty value is a number.
trans-unit.target: 使該欄靠右對齊。為 null 時自動偵測：所有非空值均為數字。

trans-unit.source: When false the header is a plain label (Arc `sortable: false`).
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，表頭僅為一般標籤（Arc `sortable: false`）。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported by `SortKey` and sort events (defaults to `SortMemberPath`, then `Header`).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，由 `SortKey` 與排序事件回報（預設為 `SortMemberPath`，其次為 `Header`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the member the column sorts by, reported as the sort key. The sorted value itself comes from `SortBinding`, `SortValueSelector` or the cell value.
trans-unit.target: 此欄排序所依據的成員名稱，作為排序鍵回報。實際用於排序的值來自 `SortBinding`、`SortValueSelector` 或儲存格值。

trans-unit.source: Format for cell text: a composite format (`{0:N0} items`) or a format string (`C0`).
trans-unit.target: 儲存格文字的格式：複合格式（`{0:N0} items`）或格式字串（`C0`）。

trans-unit.source: Pixel widths are fixed; Auto columns are measured once and held so sorting never reflows them; star columns share the rest.
trans-unit.target: 像素寬度固定；Auto 欄在首次測量後保持不變，因此排序時不會重新排版；星號欄平分其餘空間。

trans-unit.source: Arc date field: type a date (parsed with `Culture`) or open the calendar popup (click, Alt+Down or ArrowDown) and pick a day. The shown date rolls part by part in time's direction (a later date rises from below, an earlier one drops from above; parts after a wider or narrower part slide along), the picked day's disc glides in the calendar and the footer confirms it before the popup returns to the field. Escape closes and keeps focus in the field; `MinDate`, `MaxDate` and `DisabledDates` reach the calendar and also reject typed dates. Label, description, error and size come from the field foundation.
trans-unit.target: Arc 日期欄位：輸入日期（依 `Culture` 解析），或開啟日曆彈出層（點擊、Alt+Down 或 ArrowDown）並選取某一天。顯示的日期依時間方向逐段滾動（較晚的日期由下方升起，較早的日期由上方落下；位於較寬或較窄部分之後的部分沿其滑動）；所選日期的圓點在日曆中滑動，頁尾確認選取後彈出層返回欄位。按 Escape 關閉並使焦點留在欄位中；`MinDate`、`MaxDate` 與 `DisabledDates` 同時作用於日曆，並拒絕輸入的日期。標籤、說明、錯誤與尺寸由欄位基礎元件提供。

trans-unit.source: Footer button that clears the value (Arc: "Clear").
trans-unit.target: 用於清除值的頁尾按鈕（Arc：「Clear」）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting, parsing and the calendar (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 用於格式化、解析與日曆的地區設定（null = 目前 UI 的地區設定）。

trans-unit.source: Extra disabled days (weekends, booked dates...), passed to the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 額外停用的日期（週末、已預訂日期等），傳遞給日曆。

trans-unit.source: .NET date pattern of the shown value. Null uses the culture's long date without the weekday and with the abbreviated month (en-US "Oct 20, 2026", Arc's default `{ month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示值的 .NET 日期格式。為 null 時，使用該地區設定的長日期格式，去掉星期並使用縮寫月份（en-US 為 "Oct 20, 2026"，即 Arc 的預設值 `{ month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }`）。

trans-unit.source: Footer status without a value (Arc: "Choose a day").
trans-unit.target: 未選取值時的頁尾狀態文字（Arc：「Choose a day」）。

trans-unit.source: First column of the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 日曆的第一欄。

trans-unit.source: Whether the calendar popup is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 日曆彈出層是否開啟（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable date.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最晚日期。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable date.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最早日期。

trans-unit.source: The picked date (two-way). Null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 所選日期（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedDate` changes.
trans-unit.target: 當 `SelectedDate` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Footer status with a value; {0} is the formatted date (Arc: "Selected {0}").
trans-unit.target: 有值時的頁尾狀態文字；{0} 為格式化後的日期（Arc：「Selected {0}」）。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Today button to the calendar header.
trans-unit.target: 在日曆標題中新增「今天」按鈕。

trans-unit.source: An inclusive range of whole days.
trans-unit.target: 以整日計的閉區間日期範圍。

trans-unit.source: Arc date range picker: a compact trigger whose surface grows into the panel it opens (P9) — two months beside a preset rail, or one month under a scrolling preset row when the boundary is narrower than 712px. The range highlight stretches across each week as you hover or move with the keyboard, its solid ends glide between days, months slide in the direction you travel, the preset highlight glides between presets, and on Apply the formatted label flies back into the trigger as the surface shrinks around it (P8). Picking is a draft: only Apply commits (`SelectedRangeChanged`); Cancel, Escape or a press outside discard it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 日期範圍選擇器：緊湊的觸發器，其表面會展開為所開啟的面板（P9）——並排顯示兩個月份與預設清單，或在邊界寬度小於 712px 時，於可捲動的預設列下方顯示一個月份。懸停或使用鍵盤移動時，範圍高亮會橫跨每一週延伸，其實心端點在日期之間滑動，月份沿移動方向滑入，預設高亮在預設之間滑動；點選「套用」時，格式化後的標籤會在表面收合時飛回觸發器（P8）。選取是草稿：只有「套用」會提交（`SelectedRangeChanged`）；「取消」、Escape 或在外部按下都會捨棄草稿。

trans-unit.source: Label of the button that applies the picked range (default Apply).
trans-unit.target: 套用所選日期範圍的按鈕的標籤（預設為「套用」）。

trans-unit.source: The element the panel stays inside (null = the window).
trans-unit.target: 面板保持在其內部的元素（null = 視窗）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the cancel button in the panel (default Cancel).
trans-unit.target: 面板中取消按鈕的標籤（預設為「取消」）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for month titles, weekday heads and the range label.
trans-unit.target: 用於月份標題、星期標題與範圍標籤的地區設定。

trans-unit.source: Day count; {0} is the number (Arc: "1 day" / "12 days").
trans-unit.target: 天數；{0} 為數字（Arc：「1 day」 / 「12 days」）。

trans-unit.source: Day count for two or more days; {0} is the number (default "{0} days").
trans-unit.target: 兩天或以上時的天數格式；{0} 為天數（預設為「{0} 天」）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的輔助文字。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的錯誤提示。

trans-unit.source: First column of the months (Arc's weekStartsOn: Sunday or Monday).
trans-unit.target: 月份的第一欄（Arc 的 weekStartsOn：週日或週一）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板是否開啟（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Arc names the trigger with its label but does not show it; set true for a visible field label.
trans-unit.target: Arc 以標籤為觸發器命名，但不顯示標籤；設為 true 可顯示可見的欄位標籤。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the trigger and the panel (Arc: "Date range"); shown above when `IsLabelVisible`.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器與面板的無障礙名稱（Arc：「Date range」）；當 `IsLabelVisible` 為 true 時顯示於上方。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable day.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最晚日期。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable day.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最早日期。

trans-unit.source: One or two months; Auto picks two when the boundary is at least 712px wide.
trans-unit.target: 一個或兩個月份；Auto 在邊界寬度至少為 712px 時選擇兩個月份。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the next-month button (default Next month).
trans-unit.target: 下個月按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設為「下個月」）。

trans-unit.source: Trigger text when no range is selected (default No dates).
trans-unit.target: 未選取範圍時的觸發文字（預設為「未選取日期」）。

trans-unit.source: Readout while the hovered date is the start date and the end is still to be picked (default Pick an end date).
trans-unit.target: 懸停日期為起始日期、尚待選取結束日期時的讀數（預設為「選取結束日期」）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while no range is applied (Arc: "Select dates").
trans-unit.target: 未套用範圍時顯示（Arc：「Select dates」）。

trans-unit.source: The preset rail (null = Arc's eight defaults, `Default`).
trans-unit.target: 預設清單（null = Arc 的八個預設值，`Default`）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the previous-month button (default Previous month).
trans-unit.target: 上個月按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設為「上個月」）。

trans-unit.source: The applied range (two-way). Null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的範圍（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a range is applied.
trans-unit.target: 套用範圍時引發。

trans-unit.source: A focused surface for decisions that need attention: confirmations, short forms, step flows whose title crossfades. Declare it anywhere in XAML; it renders nothing in place and shows its panel above a blurred scrim while `IsOpen` is true: The overlay fades in while the panel rises 8px from 0.96 on the smooth spring; closing is shorter and starts from wherever the entrance is. Escape and a press on the scrim close it (cancellable through `Closing`); Tab cycles inside; focus returns to the opener. Code can await a result with `ShowAsync` or `ConfirmAsync`.
trans-unit.target: 用於需要注意之決策的聚焦表面：確認、簡短表單、標題淡入切換的分步流程。可在 XAML 中任意位置宣告；它不會在原位置渲染任何內容，當 `IsOpen` 為 true 時，會在模糊遮罩之上顯示其面板。覆蓋層淡入，面板以平滑彈簧從 0.96 縮放並上升 8px；關閉比進入更短，並從進入動畫當前所在的位置開始。Escape 與在遮罩上按下都會關閉（可透過 `Closing` 取消）；Tab 在內部循環；焦點返回至開啟它的元素。程式碼可透過 `ShowAsync` 或 `ConfirmAsync` 等待結果。

trans-unit.source: Set on a button inside a dialog, drawer or bottom sheet: clicking it closes that overlay with this value as its `CloseResult` (and the result of `ShowAsync`).
trans-unit.target: 設定於對話方塊、抽屜或底部面板內的按鈕上：點選後會以此值作為其 `CloseResult` 關閉該覆蓋層（同時也是 `ShowAsync` 的結果）。

trans-unit.source: Panel width: Small 360, Medium 440 (Arc), Large 560 — always within the viewport minus 32px.
trans-unit.target: 面板寬度：Small 360、Medium 440（Arc）、Large 560——始終不超過視埠寬度減去 32px。

trans-unit.source: Arc's donut chart: a few parts of one whole. The legend and the ring show and hide segments together, the center reads the active segment (or the total at rest) and rolls like a drum between readouts, small parts fold into "Other", and new data moves every arc from where it is on screen, keeping its velocity. The first time the chart is seen all segments sweep out of the top together, each trailing edge a beat behind. Arc interpolates start and end angles rather than paths; every angle is a `MotionValue` written into one self-drawn ring, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 環形圖：表示一個整體的若干部分。圖例與圓環同步顯示和隱藏分段；中心顯示目前啟用的分段（靜止時顯示總計），並在讀數之間像滾筒一樣滾動；過小的部分合併為「Other」；新資料會讓每段弧線從其在畫面上的目前位置出發，並保留其速度。首次看到此圖表時，所有分段會一同從頂部掃出，每段的後緣比前緣晚一拍。Arc 對起始角與結束角進行插值，而非路徑；每個角度都是寫入一個自繪圓環的 `MotionValue`，這是 ControlTheme 過渡無法表達的。

trans-unit.source: The selected (pinned) segment key. Hover and focus preview other segments without changing it. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 所選（固定）分段的鍵。懸停與聚焦只預覽其他分段，不會改變它。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected segment changes.
trans-unit.target: 當所選分段變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Ring diameter in pixels; the ring scales down to fit narrower containers.
trans-unit.target: 圓環直徑（像素）；當容器較窄時，圓環會等比縮小以適應。

trans-unit.source: Segments below this share of the total join "Other" (only when at least two would).
trans-unit.target: 占總量比例低於此值的分段合併為「Other」（僅當至少有兩個分段符合條件時）。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden segments. A hidden segment closes and the rest of the ring redistributes. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏分段的鍵。隱藏的分段會收合，其餘圓環重新分配空間。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a segment.
trans-unit.target: 當圖例顯示或隱藏某個分段時引發。

trans-unit.source: What clicking a legend row does.
trans-unit.target: 點選圖例列時執行的動作。

trans-unit.source: The most segments drawn, counting "Other".
trans-unit.target: 最多繪製的分段數，包含「Other」。

trans-unit.target: 容納合併小部分之分段的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Ring thickness in pixels.
trans-unit.target: 圓環粗細（像素）。

trans-unit.source: The synced legend beside (at least 460px wide) or below the ring.
trans-unit.target: 與圓環同步的圖例，位於圓環旁（寬度至少 460px）或其下方。

trans-unit.source: Center label at rest, above the total.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時位於中心的標籤，顯示於總計上方。

trans-unit.source: A temporary side surface for focused work that keeps the page in context: filters, settings, record details, forms too long for a dialog. Declare it anywhere; while `IsOpen` its panel springs in from `Side` above a lightly blurred scrim. The header is a drag handle: it follows the pointer toward the edge and rubber-bands the other way; past a third of the panel, or on a flick toward the edge faster than 500px/s, the drawer closes and keeps the flick's velocity; otherwise it springs back. A click, Escape or the scrim closes it with a quicker tween. The close button is always there; under reduced motion dragging is off and the panel only fades.
trans-unit.target: 用於聚焦工作的暫時側邊表面，可讓頁面保持上下文：篩選器、設定、紀錄詳情、過長而不適合對話方塊的表單等。可在任意位置宣告；當 `IsOpen` 為 true 時，其面板會從 `Side` 方向以彈簧彈入，並位於輕微模糊的遮罩之上。標題列是拖曳把手：它跟隨指標朝邊緣移動，朝另一方向則產生橡皮筋回彈；超過面板的三分之一，或以快於 500px/s 的速度朝邊緣輕彈時，抽屜會關閉並保留輕彈的速度；否則會彈回。點選、Escape 或遮罩會以較快的補間動畫關閉它。關閉按鈕始終存在；在減少動態效果模式下，拖曳功能關閉，面板只淡入淡出。

trans-unit.source: Edge the panel is anchored to (default Right).
trans-unit.target: 面板所固定的邊緣（預設為 Right）。

trans-unit.source: A focused list of actions anchored to a labelled trigger (Arc dropdown menu). The trigger shows an optional icon, the `Label` (a new label rises in from a soft blur while the trigger width springs) and a chevron that turns on the CSS spring while open. The menu grows from the trigger edge on Arc's 580ms CSS spring with a 160ms fade, one highlight glides between rows for the pointer and jumps for the keyboard, and rows fade in with a short stagger. Rows are declared inline (`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`) or supplied with `ItemsSource`. Replace the built-in trigger with `Trigger` (any control; buttons toggle the menu on click and never press-scale). Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger open the menu on the first row; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 錨定在帶標籤觸發器上的聚焦動作清單（Arc 下拉式選單）。觸發器顯示可選圖示、`Label`（新標籤從柔和模糊中升起，同時觸發器寬度以彈簧變化）以及在開啟時透過 CSS 彈簧轉動的箭頭。選單以 Arc 的 580ms CSS 彈簧從觸發器邊緣展開，伴隨 160ms 淡入；一個高亮會在列之間為指標滑動，為鍵盤則直接跳轉；各列以短促的錯落時序淡入。列可以內嵌宣告（`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`），也可透過 `ItemsSource` 提供。可用 `Trigger` 取代內建觸發器（任意控制項；按鈕在點選時切換選單，且從不產生按壓縮放）。在觸發器上按 Enter、Space 或 ArrowDown 會在第一列開啟選單；Escape 關閉選單並將焦點返回觸發器。

trans-unit.source: Menu alignment against the trigger (Arc: end).
trans-unit.target: 選單相對觸發器的對齊方式（Arc：end）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 選單關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon of the built-in trigger (a 24x24 Lucide geometry such as `ArcIcons.Settings`).
trans-unit.target: 內建觸發器的前置圖示（24x24 Lucide 幾何圖形，例如 `ArcIcons.Settings`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 選單是否開啟（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row is activated.
trans-unit.target: 當某一列被啟用時引發。

trans-unit.source: Template that renders each ItemsSource item as a row.
trans-unit.target: 將每個 ItemsSource 項目渲染為一列的範本。

trans-unit.source: Data items shown as one row each; ItemTemplate renders them when set.
trans-unit.target: 以每個項目一列顯示的資料項目；設定後由 ItemTemplate 渲染。

trans-unit.source: Trigger text (Arc: required). Changing it morphs the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器文字（Arc：必填）。變更時觸發器會變形。

trans-unit.source: Turns any control into a dropdown trigger for a `MenuSurface`: clicks (buttons) or taps toggle the menu, Enter / Space / ArrowDown open it on the first row, ArrowUp on the last, Escape returns focus to the control, and Arc buttons stop press-scaling while they anchor the menu. Used by split buttons, button groups and row "more" buttons: `<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`.
trans-unit.target: 將任意控制項轉換為 `MenuSurface` 的下拉式觸發器：點選（按鈕）或輕觸會切換選單，Enter / Space / ArrowDown 在第一列開啟選單，ArrowUp 在最後一列開啟，Escape 將焦點返回該控制項；當 Arc 按鈕錨定選單時會停止按壓縮放。用於分割按鈕、按鈕群組與列內「更多」按鈕：`<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu opens.
trans-unit.target: 選單開啟時引發。

trans-unit.source: Edge of the trigger the menu opens from: Bottom (default), Top, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 選單從觸發器的哪一側展開：Bottom（預設）、Top、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Custom trigger content that replaces the built-in button (the menu anchors to it).
trans-unit.target: 取代內建按鈕的自訂觸發器內容（選單錨定於此）。

trans-unit.source: Arc elastic slider: a single value slider made of something that gives. The thumb swells to 1.28× under the finger (P24), the track stretches like rubber up to 26px past either end and springs back with the release velocity (0.5s, bounce 0.42), the end icons are pushed outward with the stretch, a value tag hangs off the thumb and sways with its speed (up to 11°), and marks act as detents the thumb clicks into within 7px. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit hits the wall and bounces. `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to.
trans-unit.target: Arc 彈性滑桿：一個帶有回彈感的單一數值滑桿。拇指在手指按下時放大至 1.28×（P24），軌道在任一端之外最多如橡皮筋般拉伸 26px，並以釋放速度回彈（0.5s，bounce 0.42）；兩端圖示隨拉伸向外推移；數值標籤懸掛於拇指上，並隨其速度擺動（最多 11°）；刻度充當檔位，拇指在 7px 之內會「喀嗒」一聲卡入。方向鍵、Shift+方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的用法與原生 range 輸入相同；按鍵在極限處會碰壁並回彈。`SmallChange` 是數值吸附的步長。

trans-unit.source: Icon after the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its end.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之後的圖示；當軌道被拉過末端時向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value beside the label. The tag still appears while dragging or using keys.
trans-unit.target: 在標籤旁顯示數值。拖曳或使用鍵盤時數值標籤仍會出現。

trans-unit.source: Visible label; it also names the thumb.
trans-unit.target: 可見標籤；同時也作為拇指的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Detents: a dragged thumb clicks into each one and holds for a few pixels. Labels print under the track.
trans-unit.target: 檔位：拖曳的拇指會在每個檔位處「喀嗒」一聲卡入，並在幾個像素範圍內停留。標籤印在軌道下方。

trans-unit.source: Icon before the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its start.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之前的圖示；當軌道被拉過起點時向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Runs once a drag is released, a key changes the value or a mark label is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳釋放、按鍵變更數值或點選刻度標籤後執行一次。

trans-unit.source: Formats the value in the value tag and readout; when not set, the value is shown with the slider's Decimals.
trans-unit.target: 設定數值標籤與讀數的格式；未設定時，數值依滑桿的 Decimals 顯示。

trans-unit.source: Arc empty state: a useful next step when there is nothing to show yet (an empty list, zero search results, first use). A centered icon block, a title, one or two sentences and an optional action. Keep it mounted and change its properties to morph between states: the icon pops into the new one, the copy rises in while the old copy leaves, and the text block's height springs to fit. The icon block settles in once when it first appears.
trans-unit.target: Arc 空狀態：在尚無內容可顯示時（空清單、搜尋結果為零、首次使用）提供有用的下一步。包括置中的圖示區塊、標題、一到兩句說明以及可選的動作。保持其掛載，透過變更屬性在各狀態之間變形：圖示彈入新的圖示，文案升起，舊文案離開，文字區塊的高度以彈簧適應內容。圖示區塊在首次出現時僅穩定地進入一次。

trans-unit.source: The call to action, usually a button (or a panel of two).
trans-unit.target: 引導操作，通常為一個按鈕（也可為兩個按鈕的面板）。

trans-unit.source: One or two sentences on why it is empty and what to do next.
trans-unit.target: 說明為何為空以及下一步該做什麼，一到兩句。

trans-unit.source: The icon: a control, or a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry`. Default: Lucide Folder at stroke 1.5.
trans-unit.target: 圖示：一個控制項，或 24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry`。預設為 Lucide Folder，描邊寬度 1.5。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the region.
trans-unit.target: 該區域的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The headline (a heading, level 3).
trans-unit.target: 標題（三級標題）。

trans-unit.source: Four empty states in one illustration whose shapes morph between scenes as you switch tabs. Each `EmptyStatesItem` is a tab with a scene (no results, offline, caught up, not found) and its copy; every shape of the drawing travels to its new position, size, radius, rotation and color on a spring, outlines morph point by point and line accents draw in a beat later. The primary action raises `ActionInvoked` (and runs `ActionCommand`); the app does the work and moves `Phase` to Loading and then Done, and the drawing and copy follow. With no items the block shows Arc's four scenes and copy.
trans-unit.target: 同一幅插圖中的四種空狀態，切換標籤時圖形會在各場景之間變形。每個 `EmptyStatesItem` 是一個標籤，包含場景（無結果、離線、已全部處理、未找到）及其文案；圖形中的每個形狀都會以彈簧動畫移動到新的位置、大小、圓角、旋轉角度與顏色，輪廓逐點變形，線條強調則稍後再繪製。主要操作會觸發 `ActionInvoked`（並執行 `ActionCommand`）；應用程式負責處理工作，並將 `Phase` 設為 Loading，接著設為 Done，插圖與文案隨之變化。若沒有任何項目，該區塊會顯示 Arc 的四個場景與文案。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the action is pressed, after `ActionInvoked`; its parameter is the event arguments.
trans-unit.target: 按下操作按鈕時，於 `ActionInvoked` 之後執行；其參數為事件引數。

trans-unit.source: The action of the selected item was pressed (Idle or Done). Do the work and set `Phase`.
trans-unit.target: 所選項目的操作（處於 Idle 或 Done 時）被按下。請執行工作並設定 `Phase`。

trans-unit.source: The tabs, in order. Empty (the default) shows Arc's four scenes with Arc's copy.
trans-unit.target: 標籤，依序排列。為空（預設）時顯示 Arc 的四個場景與文案。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the region.
trans-unit.target: 該區域的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Where the selected item's action stands: Idle, Loading or Done (two way). Switching tabs resets it to Idle.
trans-unit.target: 所選項目操作目前所處的階段：Idle、Loading 或 Done（雙向）。切換標籤會將其重設為 Idle。

trans-unit.source: The index of the selected tab (two way).
trans-unit.target: 所選標籤的索引（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The selected item (two way). Choosing another item puts `Phase` back to Idle.
trans-unit.target: 所選項目（雙向）。選取其他項目會將 `Phase` 恢復為 Idle。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the tab list.
trans-unit.target: 標籤列表的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: One tab of an `EmptyStates` block: the scene its illustration shows and its copy for each phase. Text left null uses Arc's copy for `Scene`.
trans-unit.target: `EmptyStates` 區塊中的一個標籤：其插圖所顯示的場景，以及各階段的文案。為 null 的文字會使用 Arc 針對 `Scene` 的文案。

trans-unit.source: The button label in the Idle phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Idle 階段的按鈕文字。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: The description in the Idle phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Idle 階段的說明文字。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: The button label in the Done phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Done 階段的按鈕文字。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: The description in the Done phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Done 階段的說明文字。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: The accessible description of the illustration in the Done phase. Null uses Arc's description of the drawing.
trans-unit.target: Done 階段插圖的無障礙描述。為 null 時使用 Arc 對該圖形的描述。

trans-unit.source: The title in the Done phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Done 階段的標題。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: The tab label. Null uses Arc's label for the scene ("No results", "Offline", "Caught up", "Not found").
trans-unit.target: 標籤文字。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的標籤（「No results」、「Offline」、「Caught up」、「Not found」）。

trans-unit.source: The accessible description of the illustration while Loading. Null uses Arc's description of the drawing.

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back in `ActionInvoked`.

trans-unit.source: The title in the Idle phase. Null uses Arc's copy for the scene.
trans-unit.target: Idle 階段的標題。為 null 時使用 Arc 針對該場景的文案。

trans-unit.source: Arc expandable card: a summary card whose header opens a details panel below it. Opening is one morph: width and height grow on the same smooth spring (real size, never a scale, so text and corners never stretch) and the chevron turns with it; the details fade in once the box has made room, and on close they fade first and the box follows 60ms later. A second click mid-flight reverses from the current size and velocity. The summary line rolls only the words that changed. Escape closes the card from anywhere inside it and returns focus to the header.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展開卡片：摘要卡片，其標題可在下方開啟詳細資料面板。展開為一次連續的形變：寬度與高度沿同一平滑彈簧同時增長（使用真實尺寸而非縮放，因此文字與圓角不會變形），箭頭隨之轉動；詳細資料在方塊騰出空間後淡入，收合時則先淡出，方塊再延遲 60ms 收攏。飛行途中再次按一下會從當前尺寸與速度反向運動。摘要列只滾動變化的詞語。Escape 可在卡片內任何位置將其關閉，並把焦點交回標題。

trans-unit.source: Width cap while collapsed, in px; NaN fills the container (Arc width).
trans-unit.target: 摺疊時的寬度上限，單位 px；NaN 表示填滿容器（Arc width）。

trans-unit.source: Summary line under the title; changed words roll in.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的摘要列；變化的詞會滾入。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the card opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 卡片展開或收合後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Width cap while open, so the card can grow sideways; NaN uses `CollapsedWidth` (Arc expandedWidth).
trans-unit.target: 展開時的寬度上限，使卡片可向側邊擴展；NaN 時使用 `CollapsedWidth`（Arc expandedWidth）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the details are open. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 詳細資料是否展開。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the content opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 內容展開或收合後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the full content shows. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示完整內容。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Whether the last visible line fades out while collapsed (Arc: on).
trans-unit.target: 摺疊時最後一行可見內容是否漸隱（Arc 預設開啟）。

trans-unit.source: True when the content is longer than `Lines` lines (the toggle shows).
trans-unit.target: 內容超過 `Lines` 行時為 true（此時顯示切換按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Toggle label while open.
trans-unit.target: 展開時切換按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Line height in px. `ExpandableText` lays its text out at this height (theme: text-sm × leading-body); `ExpandableContent` clamps at `Lines × LineHeight` when it is set, which is how content that is not text (rendered Markdown, a list) is clamped.
trans-unit.target: 行高，單位 px。`ExpandableText` 依此行高排版文字（主題：text-sm × leading-body）；`ExpandableContent` 設定了它時依 `Lines × LineHeight` 截斷，不是文字的內容（轉譯後的 Markdown、清單）就是這樣截斷的。

trans-unit.source: How many lines show while collapsed (Arc: 3).
trans-unit.target: 摺疊時顯示的行數（Arc 預設為 3）。

trans-unit.source: Toggle label while collapsed.
trans-unit.target: 摺疊時切換按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Arc expandable text: long text clamped to `Lines` lines with a soft fade over the last one. Read more opens it to its full height with a calm ease out (500–600ms, growing with the distance) and Show less closes it (400–450ms); the height, the fade and the chevron follow one progress value, so they always move in step, and a click mid-flight reverses from the current height. The toggle only appears when the text really overflows, and stays correct as the width or font changes. While collapsed the text is laid out only past the clamp, so a very long text costs as much as a short one. The whole text is always available to assistive technology. For selectable or rich content, use `ExpandableContent`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展開文字：過長的文字被截斷為 `Lines` 行，末行帶柔和的漸隱效果。「閱讀更多」會以平緩的 ease out 緩動（500–600ms，隨距離增加）展開至完整高度，「收合」則以 400–450ms 收攏；高度、漸隱與箭頭共用同一進度值，因此始終同步移動，動畫途中點選會從目前高度反向。僅當文字確實溢出時才顯示切換按鈕，並在寬度或字型變化時保持正確。摺疊時文字只排版到截斷線之後，因此很長的文字與短文字的開銷相同。完整文字始終可供輔助技術使用。需要可選取或豐富內容時，請使用 `ExpandableContent`。

trans-unit.source: Rich text with runs and inline links (`InlineUIContainer`); used instead of `Text` when set.
trans-unit.target: 富文字，包含多段文字與行內連結（`InlineUIContainer`）；設定後取代 `Text` 使用。

trans-unit.source: The text (paragraphs separated by line breaks).
trans-unit.target: 文字內容（段落以換行分隔）。

trans-unit.source: A compact pill of icon buttons for 3 to 6 related actions (message, file and card actions). One action always shows its label; the one you point at or focus takes it over while its neighbours slide aside (width springs inside one row, P5), and an action can confirm in place: the icon draws a check and the label becomes a past tense word (P2, P15). On touch the first tap reveals the label and a second tap runs the action. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space run.
trans-unit.target: 緊湊的膠囊形圖示按鈕組，用於 3 至 6 個相關操作（訊息、檔案與卡片操作）。始終有一個操作顯示其標籤；滑鼠指向或取得焦點的操作會接管標籤，相鄰項目同時滑開（寬度在同一列內以彈簧變化，P5）。操作可原地確認：圖示變為勾選，標籤變為過去式詞語（P2、P15）。觸控螢幕上，第一次點按顯示標籤，第二次點按執行操作。整組只佔用一個 Tab 焦點；方向鍵移動並循環，Home 與 End 跳轉，Enter 與空白鍵執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever an action runs, before its own `AsyncAction`.
trans-unit.target: 每次操作執行時觸發，早於其自身的 `AsyncAction`。

trans-unit.source: How long a confirmation stays (default 1.4s).
trans-unit.target: 確認狀態保持的時長（預設 1.4s）。

trans-unit.source: The action (item or its container) whose label shows at rest; null uses the first enabled action.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時顯示標籤的操作（項目或其容器）；為 null 時使用第一個啟用的操作。

trans-unit.source: The action currently showing its label.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示標籤的操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Message actions".
trans-unit.target: 工具列的無障礙名稱，例如「訊息操作」。

trans-unit.source: Small (28px, 14px icons) or Medium (36px, 16px icons; default). Large is treated as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（28px，圖示 14px）或 Medium（36px，圖示 16px；預設）。Large 按 Medium 處理。

trans-unit.source: One action of an `ExpandingButtonGroup`: an icon that grows to reveal its label. The width rides the morph spring between the icon and the icon plus the longer of `Label` and `DoneLabel`; the label slides out from behind the icon and tucks back faster. Code-driven because the reveal is asymmetric (240ms with a delay in, 120ms out) and blurs, which a ControlTheme transition cannot express.
trans-unit.target: `ExpandingButtonGroup` 的一個操作：圖示會展開以顯示標籤。寬度沿形變彈簧在圖示與「圖示加上 `Label` 與 `DoneLabel` 中較長者」之間變化；標籤從圖示後滑出，收回時更快。由程式碼驅動，因為展開與收合不對稱（展開 240ms 並帶延遲，收合 120ms）且帶模糊效果，ControlTheme 過渡無法表達。

trans-unit.source: Runs the action. The button is busy until the task completes; returning false, or throwing, skips the confirmation. Without it, `Click` and `Command` count as success.
trans-unit.target: 執行該操作。任務完成前按鈕處於忙碌狀態；回傳 false 或擲出例外則略過確認。未設定時，`Click` 與 `Command` 視為成功。

trans-unit.source: Past tense word shown in place after the action (such as "Archived"); omit for actions that open something.
trans-unit.target: 操作執行後原位顯示的過去式詞語（如「已封存」）；開啟內容的操作請省略。

trans-unit.source: 16px Lucide glyph shown while collapsed (sized by the group).
trans-unit.target: 收合時顯示的 16px Lucide 圖形（尺寸由群組決定）。

trans-unit.source: True while `AsyncAction` runs.
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 執行期間為 true。

trans-unit.source: Dimmed and inert, but still focusable and still reveals its label, so people can learn what it would do.
trans-unit.target: 變淡且無法操作，但仍可取得焦點並會顯示標籤，讓人了解該操作的用途。

trans-unit.source: True while the confirmation shows.
trans-unit.target: 確認狀態顯示期間為 true。

trans-unit.source: True while this action shows its label.
trans-unit.target: 該操作顯示標籤時為 true。

trans-unit.source: A short verb, visible once expanded and the accessible name at all times.
trans-unit.target: 簡短的動詞；展開後可見，並始終作為無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Color of the expanded action: Neutral (default), or Danger for destructive actions such as Delete.
trans-unit.target: 展開操作的顏色：Neutral（預設），或用於刪除等破壞性操作的 Danger。

trans-unit.source: Arc expanding search: a search that waits as an icon button until it is needed (headers, toolbars). The button morphs into the field on the morph spring (its corners follow the width, from a circle to the control radius), results unfold beneath it in groups with the match in medium weight, and a highlight glides between them on the snappy spring. ArrowUp / ArrowDown move (wrapping), Enter chooses, Escape folds it back into the icon; leaving an empty field folds it too. Before anything is typed it shows `Suggestions`. Place it in the lane the field may grow into: it fills that lane's width and keeps the button on the `Anchor` edge; the field never grows past `ExpandedWidth` or the lane.
trans-unit.target: Arc 展開式搜尋：平時以圖示按鈕形式出現，需要時才展開（用於標題列、工具列）。按鈕沿形變彈簧變形為欄位（圓角隨寬度變化，從圓形過渡到控制項圓角），結果在其下方依群組展開，符合的部分以中等字重顯示，醒目提示沿靈敏彈簧在各結果之間滑動。ArrowUp / ArrowDown 移動（循環），Enter 選取，Escape 將其收回為圖示；欄位為空時離開也會收回。尚未輸入任何內容時顯示 `Suggestions`。請將其放在欄位可以擴展的區域內：它會填滿該區域的寬度，並把按鈕保持在 `Anchor` 所在的邊緣；欄位的寬度永遠不會超過 `ExpandedWidth` 或該區域。

trans-unit.source: The edge the button sits on. Default End.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕所在的邊緣。預設為 End。

trans-unit.source: A short tip under the empty state.
trans-unit.target: 空狀態下方的簡短提示。

trans-unit.source: The widest the field grows (it never grows past its lane). Default 360.
trans-unit.target: 欄位可展開的最大寬度（不會超過其所在區域）。預設 360。

trans-unit.source: Whether the field is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 欄位是否展開（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a result or suggestion is chosen (after the field folds back).
trans-unit.target: 選取結果或建議項目時觸發（在欄位收回之後）。

trans-unit.source: Items to search (alternatively add them inline as children).
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的項目（也可直接作為子元素內嵌加入）。

trans-unit.source: Names the button, the field and the results, such as "Search projects and docs".
trans-unit.target: 為按鈕、欄位與結果命名，例如「搜尋專案與文件」。

trans-unit.source: The text in the field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 欄位中的文字（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Executed with the chosen item.
trans-unit.target: 以選取的項目作為參數執行。

trans-unit.source: Shown before anything is typed, such as recent searches.
trans-unit.target: 尚未輸入任何內容時顯示，例如最近的搜尋。

trans-unit.target: 建議清單的標題。預設為「最近」。

trans-unit.source: One searchable entry of an `ExpandingSearch`.
trans-unit.target: `ExpandingSearch` 中一個可搜尋的條目。

trans-unit.source: Results gather under this heading, in the order groups first appear.
trans-unit.target: 結果依此標題歸組，分組依首次出現的順序排列。

trans-unit.source: An 18px leading icon: a Lucide `Geometry` or any control.
trans-unit.target: 18px 的前導圖示：Lucide `Geometry` 或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (defaults to the title).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼（預設為標題）。

trans-unit.source: Extra words that also find this item.
trans-unit.target: 額外的關鍵字，同樣可用於找到該項目。

trans-unit.source: One short line under the title (type, owner, last edit); also searched.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一列簡短資訊（類型、擁有者、最近編輯）；同樣參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the item is chosen.

trans-unit.source: The line that is searched first and shown in bold where it matches.
trans-unit.target: 優先搜尋的一列文字，符合處以粗體顯示。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the frame (rewrites changed words in place; counts roll).
trans-unit.target: 外框下方的輔助文字（原地改寫變化的詞，數字滾動）。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the frame; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 外框下方的錯誤提示；不為空時欄位為無效狀態。

trans-unit.source: Invalid state; always true while an error is shown.
trans-unit.target: 無效狀態；顯示錯誤時一律為 true。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden visually but still names the field.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤不顯示，但仍作為欄位的名稱。

trans-unit.source: The visible label above the frame; also the accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 外框上方的可見標籤，同時作為無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Hint shown while the field is empty (same as `PlaceholderText`).
trans-unit.target: 欄位為空時顯示的提示（與 `PlaceholderText` 相同）。

trans-unit.source: Content before the text (icon, unit, currency).
trans-unit.target: 文字前面的內容（圖示、單位、貨幣符號）。

trans-unit.source: Frame height: Small 36, Medium 44 (default), Large 50.
trans-unit.target: 外框高度：Small 36、Medium 44（預設）、Large 50。

trans-unit.source: Content after the text (unit, action button).
trans-unit.target: 文字後面的內容（單位、動作按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's generous target for dropping one or more files: drag files from the system onto it, click (or Enter / Space) to choose from the device, or paste a file while the pointer is over it. Files are checked against `Accept`, `MaxFileSize` and `MaxFiles`; refusals shake the target. The list shows each file with an upload state driven by `UploadHandler` or by the app, with Retry and Remove.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的檔案拖放區，目標區域較大，便於放入一個或多個檔案：可從系統拖入檔案，點選（或按 Enter / 空白鍵）從裝置選擇，或在指標懸停時貼上檔案。檔案會依 `Accept`、`MaxFileSize` 與 `MaxFiles` 檢查；被拒絕時目標區域會抖動。清單顯示每個檔案的上傳狀態（由 `UploadHandler` 或應用程式驅動），並提供重試與移除。

trans-unit.source: Accepted types like an HTML file input: extensions (".pdf") and MIME types ("image/*", "application/pdf"), comma separated.
trans-unit.target: 接受的類型，與 HTML 檔案輸入相同：副檔名（「.pdf」）與 MIME 類型（「image/*」、「application/pdf」），以逗號分隔。

trans-unit.source: Allow several files (default true); a single-file dropzone replaces its file.
trans-unit.target: 是否允許多個檔案（預設 true）；單檔拖放區會取代其檔案。

trans-unit.source: Once the list holds this many files, the prompt folds to a slim bar; a file dragged over brings the icon back.
trans-unit.target: 清單中檔案數達到此數量後，提示會收為細條；拖入檔案時圖示會重新出現。

trans-unit.source: The line under the label (default "Drop files here or choose from your device").
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的文字（預設「將檔案拖曳到此處，或從裝置中選取」）。

trans-unit.source: The label while files hover over the target (default "Drop to upload" / "Drop to add files").
trans-unit.target: 檔案懸停在目標上時顯示的標籤（預設「放開以上傳」／「放開以新增檔案」）。

trans-unit.source: The refusal shown under the target, or null.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在目標下方的拒絕提示；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the visitor's files change (added or removed; Arc's `onFilesChange`).
trans-unit.target: 訪客的檔案變化（新增或移除）時觸發（Arc 的 `onFilesChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when files are refused (type not accepted, or more than `MaxFiles`).
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拒絕時觸發（類型不被接受，或超過 `MaxFiles`）。

trans-unit.source: True while files are dragged over the target.
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拖曳到目標上方時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The target's label (default "Add files").
trans-unit.target: 目標的標籤（預設「新增檔案」）。

trans-unit.source: List the files under the target (default) or inside its edge.
trans-unit.target: 檔案清單顯示在目標下方（預設）或目標邊緣之內。

trans-unit.source: Files above this many bytes fail with a size reason and never upload.
trans-unit.target: 超過此位元組數的檔案會因大小原因失敗，且永遠不會上傳。

trans-unit.source: The most files the list holds (default 5).
trans-unit.target: 清單最多可容納的檔案數（預設 5）。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the small line under the description (default: the accepted types, or the file limit).
trans-unit.target: 取代描述下方的小字列（預設：接受的類型，或檔案數量上限）。

trans-unit.source: Uploads each added file: report 0–100 through the progress, complete the task when it lands, throw to fail it (the message becomes the reason). Removing the row cancels the token.
trans-unit.target: 上傳每個新增的檔案：透過進度回報 0–100，檔案上傳完成時完成任務，擲出例外則任務失敗（例外訊息將作為原因顯示）。移除該列會取消權杖。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `FileDropzone`. Every property notifies, so an app can drive an upload itself by setting `Status` and `Progress` (or through `ReportProgress` and friends).
trans-unit.target: `FileDropzone` 的一列。每個屬性都會發出通知，因此應用程式可透過設定 `Status` 與 `Progress`（或透過 `ReportProgress` 等方法）自行驅動上傳。

trans-unit.source: Raised when any property of this row changes.
trans-unit.target: 此列的任一屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: An applied filter shown as a chip: "Label · Value". The id is the field id, so one chip per field.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的篩選條件，以標籤形式顯示：「標籤 · 值」。ID 為欄位 ID，因此每個欄位對應一個標籤。

trans-unit.source: A filterable field of the Add filter menu: pick the field, then one of its options.
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」選單中的可篩選欄位：先選取欄位，再選取其中一個選項。

trans-unit.source: Arc's filter toolbar: keep collection filters close and easy to reset. Applied filters are removable chips ("Status · Open") whose slots open and close on a spring so neighbors slide along, a changed value morphs in place, Clear all appears while any filter is applied, and the Add filter menu picks a field, then a value (one chip per field). An optional search field sits with the actions. `ActiveFilters` is two-way and a mutable list is updated in place; `FiltersChanged` reports every change, and changes are announced.
trans-unit.target: Arc 篩選工具列：讓集合的篩選條件保持在手邊，並易於重設。已套用的篩選為可移除的標籤（「狀態 · 未解決」），其位置以彈簧展開或收合，使相鄰標籤滑動讓位；變化的值會原位形變；只要套用了任一篩選，就會出現「全部清除」；「新增篩選」選單先選取欄位，再選取值（每個欄位一個標籤）。操作按鈕旁可放置選用的搜尋欄位。`ActiveFilters` 為雙向繫結，可變清單會原地更新；`FiltersChanged` 回報每一次變化，並會向輔助技術播報。

trans-unit.source: Extra actions shown beside Add filter (Arc `children`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在「新增篩選」旁邊的額外操作（Arc 的 `children`）。

trans-unit.source: The applied filters (two-way). A mutable list is updated in place by remove, Clear all and Add filter.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的篩選（雙向繫結）。可變清單會因移除、「全部清除」與「新增篩選」而原地更新。

trans-unit.source: Label of the Add filter button (default Add filter).
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」按鈕的標籤（預設 「Add filter」）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the button that removes every applied filter (default Clear all).
trans-unit.target: 移除所有已套用篩選條件之按鈕的標籤（預設 「Clear all」）。

trans-unit.source: Text shown in the toolbar when no filter is applied (default No filters applied).
trans-unit.target: 未套用篩選時工具列中顯示的文字（預設 「No filters applied」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a filter is added, changed, removed or all are cleared from the toolbar.
trans-unit.target: 在工具列中新增、修改、移除篩選或全部清除之後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Shows a search field with the actions; its text is `SearchText`.
trans-unit.target: 與操作按鈕一同顯示搜尋欄位；其文字為 `SearchText`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar group.
trans-unit.target: 工具列群組的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The trigger edge the Add filter panel lines up with.
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」面板對齊的觸發邊緣。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder text of the search field (default Search).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄位的預留位置文字（預設 「Search」）。

trans-unit.source: Text of the search field (two-way). Escape in the field clears it.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄位的文字（雙向繫結）。在搜尋欄位中按 Escape 會將其清空。

trans-unit.source: Separate soft buttons in a quiet tray for floating editors and canvas toolbars (Undo, Redo, Share, Present). One shared highlight (P7 `GlidingIndicator`) morphs in position and size to whichever button the pointer or keyboard focus is on, holds still across gaps and separators, fades when the pointer leaves the tray, and settles darker in place while a button is pressed; the buttons themselves never scale. Icon-only buttons and shortcut hints show the Arc `Tooltip`. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space act.

trans-unit.source: A read-only preview of a person or link that opens after a short hover or keyboard focus: mentions, avatars, author names, link previews — where a click must stay free for navigation. It waits 500ms; moving to another trigger while a card is open (or within 300ms of one closing) opens the next after 80ms with a fade only. The pointer can travel into the card during a 140ms grace and it stays open while the pointer is over it. Tab focus opens at once, Enter skips the wait, Escape closes (and it stays closed while the pointer rests on the trigger); on touch a tap toggles it. One card is open at a time. The card grows from the trigger edge: scale 0.96 and 4px toward the trigger on the smooth spring, with its own fade; leaving mid-exit and coming back turns it around. Focus never enters the card, so keep its content read-only.

trans-unit.source: Before and after, split by a divider (Arc image compare). Drag anywhere to move it: the handle follows 1:1, rubber-bands past the edges and stays where it is released. A press on the image springs the divider there; on touch the press waits for a drag along the divider's axis so the page still scrolls, and a tap moves the divider. Arrow keys step 1% (Shift 10%), PageUp / PageDown 10%, Home and End reveal one side fully, and a double-click on the handle springs it back to the middle. Changing `Orientation` swings the divider a quarter turn. `Before` / `After` take any content (an `Image` with `Stretch="UniformToFill"`, a drawing, a control). `BeforeSource` / `AfterSource` load a picture with AtomUI's `AsyncImage` on top of that content: it fades in from a soft blur while downloading, and when it fails the content underneath shows instead.

trans-unit.source: Arc inline edit: click-to-edit text for names and short fields read far more often than they change. The text turns into a field in place with the same metrics, so nothing around it moves, and the frame grows with what is typed. Enter commits (`TextCommitted`) and saves optimistically through `SaveHandler`: the new text shows at once, quieter until the save lands, then a check draws. Escape cancels and the text rolls back; a failed save restores the last saved `Value`, says why, and offers to try again. Tab or a click elsewhere saves like Enter. Multiline: Shift+Enter adds a line break.
trans-unit.target: Arc 行內編輯：點擊即可編輯，適用於名稱與短欄位這類經常閱讀、卻很少變動的文字。文字會就地轉為欄位，度量保持一致，因此周圍內容不會移動，框架會隨輸入內容增長。Enter 提交（`TextCommitted`），並透過 `SaveHandler` 樂觀儲存：新文字立即顯示，儲存完成前稍顯淡化，隨後繪製一個勾號。Escape 取消並回復文字；儲存失敗時會還原上一次儲存的 `Value`，說明原因，並提供重試。Tab 或點擊其他位置與 Enter 一樣儲存。多行模式下，Shift+Enter 新增換行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an edit is cancelled with Escape or the cancel button.
trans-unit.target: 按 Escape 或取消按鈕取消編輯時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The validation message shown under the field, if any.
trans-unit.target: 顯示於欄位下方的驗證資訊（如有）。

trans-unit.source: The failed-save sentence: {0} the attempted text, {1} the label in lower case.
trans-unit.target: 儲存失敗的提示句：{0} 為嘗試儲存的文字，{1} 為小寫形式的標籤。

trans-unit.target: 回報給輔助技術的標題層級（Arc 的 `as="h1".."h3"`）；0 表示無。

trans-unit.source: Arc input: a single-line field with a visible label, helper and error rows that open on a spring and rewrite only the words that change, and the Arc frame states (hover and focus darken the border, an error turns it danger, disabled fades). Everything from Avalonia's TextBox is kept: caret, selection, IME, undo, clipboard and a two-way `Text`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 輸入框：帶可見標籤的單行欄位，輔助文字列與錯誤列以彈簧展開，只改寫變化的詞；外框狀態與 Arc 一致（懸停與聚焦加深邊框，錯誤時變為危險色，停用時變淡）。Avalonia TextBox 的能力全部保留：游標、選取、輸入法、復原、剪貼簿與雙向繫結的 `Text`。

trans-unit.source: A collapsible tree for JSON. Values are colored by type, branches unfold row by row on a smooth spring, search highlights every match and opens the branches that hold them, long arrays and objects load in pages, and each row can copy its value or path. Follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: arrows move and open, Home/End jump, Enter/Space toggle, Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the current value (Shift: its path) and / focuses the search. Rows are a flat, virtualized list (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`), so very large documents stay smooth. Input: `Json` (text), `Value` (`JsonNode`) or `Element`.
trans-unit.target: 用於 JSON 的可摺疊樹狀結構。值依類型著色，分支以平滑彈簧逐列展開，搜尋會醒目標示每個符合項並展開包含符合項的分支，長陣列與物件分頁載入，每一列都可複製其值或路徑。遵循 WAI-ARIA 樹狀模式：方向鍵移動與展開，Home/End 跳轉，Enter/Space 切換展開，Ctrl/Cmd+C 複製目前的值（Shift：複製其路徑），/ 聚焦搜尋。列是一個扁平的虛擬化清單（參見 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`），因此非常大的文件依然流暢。輸入：`Json`（文字）、`Value`（`JsonNode`）或 `Element`。

trans-unit.target: Copied 對應的路由事件；引數包含複製類型、節點路徑與複製的文字。

trans-unit.source: Arc's line chart: one or more measures over time with series toggles, a crosshair that glides between points and a tooltip that follows on its own spring. Lines draw in from the left the first time the chart is seen, and a new range morphs every line from the shape on screen (resampled on shared x positions) while the value axis springs to its new range and the gridlines ride it. A hidden series flattens into the baseline as it fades. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` and a per-point spring array) because every animated value is a coordinate inside one self-drawn geometry, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 折線圖：一個或多個隨時間變化的度量，帶有系列切換、在資料點之間滑動的十字游標，以及依自身彈簧跟隨的提示框。圖表首次出現時，線條從左側繪製出現；切換到新範圍時，每條線會從畫面上的形狀變形（在共用的 x 位置上重新取樣），同時數值軸以彈簧移動到新範圍，網格線隨之移動。隱藏的系列會在淡出時壓平到基線。動態效果由程式碼驅動（`MotionValue` 加上每個點的彈簧陣列），因為每個動畫值都是同一幅自繪幾何圖形中的一個座標，而 ControlTheme 過渡無法表達這一點。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的單調曲線（不會超出資料範圍），或直線段。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden series. Two-way; the legend toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏系列的鍵。雙向繫結；圖例可切換其顯示狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series; the argument carries the hidden series keys.

trans-unit.source: Fixes the top of the value axis (default: the next nice tick above the data).

trans-unit.source: Fixes the bottom of the value axis (default: zero, or the data minimum when it dips below).

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as an accent-colored link with an underline that strengthens on hover. A click on the text raises `CellInvoked` with `Part`; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 把儲存格顯示為強調色連結，底線在滑鼠移上時加深。點擊文字會以 `Part` 觸發 `CellInvoked`；該次點擊不會選取儲存格。

trans-unit.source: An Arc-styled Markdown document rendered by StreamMark: headings, lists, tables, quotes, links, inline code and fenced code highlighted in Arc's syntax palette. Show static text with `Text`, or stream a reply with `Append` / `Complete` (or your own `Stream`). The document grows with its content (no internal scrolling); put long documents in a `ScrollViewer`.
trans-unit.target: 由 StreamMark 渲染的 Arc 風格 Markdown 文件：標題、清單、表格、引言、連結、行內程式碼，以及依 Arc 語法配色高亮的圍欄程式碼區塊。使用 `Text` 顯示靜態文字，或使用 `Append` / `Complete`（或你自己的 `Stream`）串流輸出回覆。文件隨內容增長（無內部捲動）；長文件請放入 `ScrollViewer`。

trans-unit.target: 區塊之間的垂直間距（段落、清單、程式碼、表格）。

trans-unit.source: True when the current document has been parsed and the result is applied to the view, so the outline, the search matches and the scroll targets are final. A static `Text` becomes ready once; a stream becomes ready when it completes. False before the template is applied and while a new source is being parsed.

trans-unit.source: One row of a `MenuSurface`: a leading icon (a Lucide `Geometry` such as `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`, or any control), a header, an optional shortcut hint and the check or radio indicator of toggle rows. Rows never draw their own hover or focus fill: the surface's shared highlight glides to the row under the pointer and jumps to the keyboard position. Activation runs `Command`, raises `Click` and the surface's `ItemClicked`, then closes the menu unless `StaysOpenOnClick` is set.

trans-unit.source: Arc metric card: a compact summary for a number that needs context (uptime, orders). A currency menu switches the currency and keeps the major amount. `Value` is the amount in major units (12.5 for $12.50); `MinorUnits` gives the integer minor units Arc reports.

trans-unit.source: Arc morph select: a select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface (width, height and corners spring together, P9), a single highlight glides between options (P7), and the chosen label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger (P8) while the trigger springs to its new width (P5). Supports groups (`Group`), icons and trailing meta, type-ahead, search for long lists and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open on the selected option (Home / End open on the first or last); arrows, PageUp / PageDown (8 at a time) and Home / End move; Enter or Space picks; Alt+Up picks and closes; typing jumps (or searches when search is on); Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes without picking.
trans-unit.target: Arc 變形選擇框：觸發器本身即是清單。開啟時，觸發器會直接變形為選項面板（寬度、高度與圓角一同以彈簧變化，P9），單一反白在選項之間滑動（P7），所選標籤從清單中浮起並落入觸發器（P8），同時觸發器以彈簧變為新寬度（P5）。支援群組（`Group`）、圖示與尾隨中繼資料、輸入搜尋、長清單搜尋以及完整的清單方塊鍵盤操作模型。適用於屬性選擇器以及最多數百個選項的表單欄位。鍵盤：Enter、空白鍵與方向鍵會在所選選項上開啟（Home / End 在第一個或最後一個選項上開啟）；方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown（每次 8 項）與 Home / End 用於移動；Enter 或空白鍵用於選取；Alt+Up 選取並關閉；輸入字元會跳轉（開啟搜尋時則進行搜尋）；Escape 關閉並返回焦點；Tab 關閉且不選取。

trans-unit.source: An animated multi-region deployment: a global load balancer sends users to the primary region while its database replicates to standby regions. When a region fails its health checks traffic shifts to the next healthy region and, if it held the primary database, a replica is promoted; a recovered region catches up as a replica.
trans-unit.target: 動畫示範的多區域部署：全域負載平衡器將使用者導向主要區域，其資料庫同時複寫至備援區域。某區域的健康檢查失敗時，流量會切換至下一個健康區域；若該區域持有主要資料庫，則會將一個副本升格為主要；恢復的區域則以副本身分重新同步。

Each option's check draws itself. A clear button pops in while anything is selected. Keyboard: Enter or Space opens and closes; arrows open and move the highlight (wrapping, skipping disabled options); Enter toggles the highlighted option; Escape closes. `IsSearchable` adds a search field to the menu (an addition: Arc's menu has none).

trans-unit.source: A home for updates: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications with read state, an All / Unread switch, expandable details and bulk actions ("Mark all read", "Clear read"). Use it when updates need a persistent place instead of a brief toast, and connect the read state to your data store through `IsRead` and the `ReadChanged` and `Dismissed` events. The panel grows out of the bell (6px toward it at scale 0.97, standard 240ms) and leaves in 120ms; counts roll, the summary rises into its new wording, the view highlight glides on the morph spring, rows collapse their height on the smooth spring as they leave (cascading 35ms apart after a bulk action) and settle in with a 4px rise when the panel opens. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the bell. Ported from Arc's free notification-center block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: 更新的常駐入口：一個帶未讀徽章的鈴鐺，點選後開啟通知面板，面板包含已讀狀態、All / Unread 切換、可展開的詳細資料與批次操作（「Mark all read」、「Clear read」）。當更新需要持久的位置，而非短暫的訊息提示時使用，並透過 `IsRead` 與 `ReadChanged` 及 `Dismissed` 事件，將已讀狀態連接到你的資料儲存。面板從鈴鐺處展開（朝鈴鐺方向偏移 6px、縮放至 0.97，標準時長 240ms），並在 120ms 內收合；計數滾動更新，摘要以向上推入的方式切換為新文字，檢視的醒目提示沿變形彈簧滑動，列離開時以平滑彈簧收合高度（批次操作後以 35ms 間隔依序串接），面板開啟時各列以 4px 上升的方式就位。按下 Escape 關閉面板，並將焦點返回鈴鐺。移植自 Arc 免費的通知中心區塊（MIT 授權，版權所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: Arc number field: a bounded number with clear increment controls. The value rolls like an odometer, the steppers and ArrowUp / ArrowDown repeat and speed up while held, Shift, PageUp and PageDown take large steps, Home and End jump to the limits, and `IsScrubEnabled` lets the label be dragged sideways. Typing edits a plain draft that applies live while valid and commits on Enter, blur or the next step (snapped to the step grid and clamped). A press past a limit strains the value toward it, shakes the refused stepper and names the limit beside the label (`"Max 10 seats"`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 數字輸入框：帶有明確增減控制項的有界數值。數值以里程表式滾動；步進按鈕及 ArrowUp / ArrowDown 按住時會重複並逐步加速；Shift、PageUp 與 PageDown 以較大步幅調整；Home 與 End 跳到上下限；`IsScrubEnabled` 允許左右拖曳標籤來調整數值。輸入時編輯一份一般草稿：有效時即時套用，並在按下 Enter、失去焦點或執行下一步時確認（會對齊步進網格並限制在範圍內）。按壓超出上下限時，數值會向該限制拉伸，被拒絕的步進按鈕會晃動，並在標籤旁標示該限制（`"Max 10 seats"`）。

trans-unit.source: Formatting and parsing culture (Arc `locale`, default en-US, never the current culture).
trans-unit.target: 格式化與解析所用的區域性（Arc 的 `locale`，預設 en-US，從不使用目前的系統區域性）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name prefix of the plus stepper (default "Increase", read as "Increase Seats").
