trans-unit.target: PageUp、PageDown 以及按住 Shift 配合方向鍵時移動的距離（預設十個步長）。

trans-unit.source: Writes the limit note (default `"Max 10 seats"` / `"Min 1 seat"`).
trans-unit.target: 產生限制提示文字（預設 `"Max 10 seats"` / `"Min 1 seat"`）。

trans-unit.source: Upper limit (default 9007199254740991, Arc's `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`).
trans-unit.target: 上限（預設 9007199254740991，即 Arc 的 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）。

trans-unit.source: Most fraction digits shown (default: the precision of `Step` and `Minimum`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最多小數位數（預設：由 `Step` 與 `Minimum` 的精度決定）。

trans-unit.source: Lower limit and step-grid origin (default 0).
trans-unit.target: 下限，同時也是步進網格的起點（預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Fewest fraction digits shown (default: the precision of `Step` and `Minimum`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最少小數位數（預設：由 `Step` 與 `Minimum` 的精度決定）。

trans-unit.source: Computes the prefix from the value (Arc's function prefix); wins over `Prefix`.
trans-unit.target: 根據數值計算前綴（Arc 的函式式前綴）；優先於 `Prefix`。

trans-unit.source: One step (default 1; zero or less counts as 1). Its precision sets the default fraction digits.
trans-unit.target: 單一步長（預設 1；為零或負數時以 1 計算）。其精度決定預設的小數位數。

trans-unit.target: 根據數值計算後綴：`n => n == 1 ? " seat" : " seats"`。

trans-unit.source: The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.
trans-unit.target: 專案或紀錄頁面（Arc 頁首區塊）的框架：固定在頂部的頁首，包含麵包屑、附帶狀態徽章的大型標題、描述、中繼資訊列、操作與標籤，下方為所選標籤的可捲動內文。內文捲動超過 16px 時，頁首收合為精簡列（麵包屑讓位給標題及其狀態；選取標題時會捲回頂部）；只有回到頂部附近（4px 以內）才會再次展開，因此不會閃爍。當麵包屑可用寬度將小於 240px 時，次要操作會收合進「More actions」選單，寬度回到 272px 時再展開。標籤計數逐位滾動，2px 指示條在標籤之間滑動，面板從移動方向的一側滑入。斷點依控制項自身的寬度而定：低於 560px 時內距收緊，根麵包屑與精簡徽章隱藏，標題降一級字級；低於 460px 時主要操作只顯示圖示。移植自 Arc 的免費頁首區塊（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli），並改為資料驅動：標籤為 `PageHeaderTab` 項目（或帶有 `ItemTemplate` 與 `ContentTemplate` 的資料項目），操作為 `PageHeaderAction`。

Changing `Label` or `Icon` swaps the button content in place (Follow becomes Following) while the button width springs to fit.

trans-unit.source: One tab of a `PageHeader`: `Header` is the label in the tab row, `Count` an optional number beside it that rolls digit by digit when it changes, and `Content` the page body shown in the header's scroller while the tab is selected.

trans-unit.source: Arc pagination: previous and next buttons around a sliding window of five page buttons and one current-page mark that travels between them on a morph spring. When the window moves, the numbers travel like a belt by the number of slots it moved (smooth spring), entering numbers fade in and leaving ones fade out quickly. `CurrentPage` is 1-based, two-way and clamped to `1..PageCount`; with `ShowBoundaryPages` the first and last pages stay reachable behind an ellipsis.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分頁：上一頁、下一頁按鈕之間是由五個頁碼按鈕組成的滑動視窗，以及一個目前頁標記，它會藉由變形彈簧在各按鈕之間移動。視窗移動時，頁碼會依移動的格數如輸送帶般平移（平滑彈簧）；新出現的頁碼淡入，離開的頁碼快速淡出。`CurrentPage` 從 1 開始計算，為雙向繫結，並限制在 `1..PageCount` 範圍內；啟用 `ShowBoundaryPages` 後，首頁與末頁仍可透過省略號存取。

trans-unit.source: The current page, 1-based. Two-way; values outside `1..PageCount` are clamped for display.
trans-unit.target: 目前頁碼，從 1 開始。雙向繫結；超出 `1..PageCount` 範圍的值在顯示時會被限制。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

trans-unit.source: Arc password field: a labeled password input with a reveal toggle inside the frame. The toggle's eye is crossed out by a slash that draws itself (it is never swapped for a second icon), and after the first toggle every switch between dots and characters resolves in place from a light blur. Enter or Space on the toggle shows or hides the password; the toggle reports its pressed state and switches its name between `ShowPasswordText` and `HidePasswordText`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼輸入框：帶標籤的密碼輸入框，外框內有顯示切換按鈕。切換按鈕的眼睛圖示上有一條自行繪製的斜線（從不替換為第二個圖示）；首次切換之後，圓點與字元之間的每次切換都會透過輕微模糊原地過渡。在切換按鈕上按 Enter 或 Space 可顯示或隱藏密碼；該按鈕會回報其按下狀態，並在 `ShowPasswordText` 與 `HidePasswordText` 之間切換其名稱。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is shown.
trans-unit.target: 密碼顯示時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shows the password as text (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式顯示密碼（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 密碼隱藏時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Arc password strength: a new-password field that shows how strong the password is while it is typed. Four segments fill in a staggered wave and change tone, the strength word rises when strength improves and drops when it falls, each requirement checks off with a drawn tick (unmet length rules show a rolling "4 more"), and a new `ErrorMessage` shakes the field once. Scoring runs on the device through a pluggable `Scorer` (default: `PasswordStrengthEstimator`, synchronous and cheap).
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼強度：新密碼輸入框，在輸入時即顯示密碼的強度。四段分段條以交錯波浪的方式填滿並變換色調，強度文字在強度提升時上升、下降時下降；每項要求都會以繪製的勾號逐一打勾（未達成的長度規則會顯示滾動的 "4 more"）；新的 `ErrorMessage` 會讓輸入框晃動一次。評分在本機透過可替換的 `Scorer` 完成（預設：`PasswordStrengthEstimator`，同步且成本低）。

trans-unit.source: How characters are counted for `ShortLength`; null counts code points.
trans-unit.target: `ShortLength` 的字元計數方式；為 null 時以碼點計數。

trans-unit.source: The current level, 0 (empty) to 4 (strong).
trans-unit.target: 目前等級，從 0（空）到 4（強）。

trans-unit.source: Every user-facing string (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 所有面向使用者的字串（英文預設值）。

trans-unit.source: Requirements to check. Strength is the share of rules met, spread over four steps.
trans-unit.target: 要檢查的要求。強度為達成規則的比例，分布在四個等級上。

trans-unit.source: Scores the password; null uses `PasswordStrengthEstimator` with `ShortLength`.
trans-unit.target: 為密碼評分；為 null 時使用帶有 `ShortLength` 的 `PasswordStrengthEstimator`。

trans-unit.source: Below this many characters the meter holds at its first step and reads "Too short". Default 8.
trans-unit.target: 低於此字元數時，強度條停留在第一段並顯示 "Too short"。預設 8。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every scored change of the password.
trans-unit.target: 每次密碼經過評分並發生變更後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The current strength word.
trans-unit.target: 目前的強度文字。

trans-unit.source: Fails text that does not match a regular expression; empty values pass (add `RequiredRule` to refuse them).
trans-unit.target: 文字不符合規則運算式時不通過；空值通過（新增 `RequiredRule` 可拒絕空值）。

trans-unit.source: An animated card payment: the customer pays at checkout, the gateway tokenizes the card, the authorization request travels through the card network to the issuing bank, the issuer approves or declines, the response comes back and approved payments settle to the merchant account, whose balance grows.
trans-unit.target: 動畫示範的信用卡付款：顧客於結帳時付款，支付閘道將卡片權杖化，授權要求經由卡組織傳送至發卡銀行，發卡行核准或拒絕，回應回傳；核准的付款會結算至商家帳戶，其餘額隨之增加。

trans-unit.source: Arc phone input: a phone field with a country picker. The number formats as it is typed in the selected country's shape (separators only print while digits follow, a typed trunk prefix is kept) with a faint guide showing the rest of the expected number; the value comes out in E.164. The flag button grows into a searchable country list (one morphing surface), pasted or autofilled international numbers pick their own country (+1 picks Canada by area code), and typing "+" in the number jumps into the picker with a calling-code search. After blur an incomplete or too long number shows "Numbers in United Kingdom have 10 digits" unless `IsValidationEnabled` is off or an `ErrorMessage` replaces it; a valid number shows a check. Keyboard: on the country button ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the list and a printable key opens it seeded with that key; in the search ArrowDown / ArrowUp, PageDown / PageUp (8 rows), Home / End (with an empty search) move, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns to the button, Tab closes. In the number, Backspace / Delete on a separator delete the digit beside it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 電話輸入框：帶國家選擇器的電話欄位。號碼會依所選國家的格式邊輸入邊排版（分隔符僅在後面有數字時才顯示，輸入的國內長途前綴會保留），並以淡色提示顯示預期號碼的其餘部分；值以 E.164 格式輸出。國旗按鈕會展開為可搜尋的國家清單（同一個變形面板）；貼上或自動填入的國際號碼會自動選取對應國家（+1 依區碼選取加拿大）；在號碼中輸入 "+" 會跳至選擇器並以國際區號搜尋。失去焦點後，不完整或過長的號碼會顯示 "英國號碼應為 10 位數字"，除非關閉了 `IsValidationEnabled` 或被 `ErrorMessage` 取代；有效號碼會顯示勾號。鍵盤操作：在國家按鈕上，ArrowDown / ArrowUp 開啟清單，可列印字元鍵會開啟清單並以該字元作為搜尋初始值；在搜尋框中，ArrowDown / ArrowUp、PageDown / PageUp（8 列）、Home / End（搜尋框為空時）可移動，Enter 選取，Escape 關閉並回到按鈕，Tab 關閉。在號碼中，在分隔符上按 Backspace / Delete 會刪除其旁邊的數字。

trans-unit.source: A small surface anchored to a trigger and opened by a click, for interactive content that should not block the page: share settings, a small filter form, a picker built from your own controls. Two ways to use it: Code can open any content anchored to any control with `ShowAt`. The panel starts 5px toward its trigger at scale 0.97, fades in fast and settles on a spring from the side it actually landed on; it leaves in about 160ms at half the travel, and an open and a close reverse each other mid-flight. Escape and a press outside close it and return focus to the trigger; focus moves into the panel on open. The trigger answers presses with color only (no press scale), since the panel is measured against it.
trans-unit.target: 一個錨定在觸發器上、由點擊開啟的小型浮層，適用於不應阻擋頁面的互動內容：分享設定、小型篩選表單、由您自己的控制項組成的選取器。有兩種用法：程式碼可透過 `ShowAt` 將任意內容錨定到任意控制項上開啟。面板從觸發器方向偏移 5px 開始，縮放比例為 0.97，快速淡入並以彈簧從實際落位的一側穩定下來；關閉時約 160ms 內完成，移動距離為一半，且開啟與關閉在過程中可相互反轉。按下 Escape 或在外部按下會關閉面板，並將焦點返回觸發器；開啟時焦點會移入面板。觸發器僅以顏色回應按下（無按壓縮放），因為面板是相對於它量測的。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿觸發器邊緣的對齊方式（預設 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Attaches a popover to any control: a click on the control toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 將浮層附加到任意控制項上：點擊該控制項即可切換其顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the popover closes (the exit may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 浮層關閉時觸發（退出動畫可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Modal: presses outside are swallowed (they only close the popover). Default false.
trans-unit.target: 模態：外部按下會被攔截（僅用於關閉浮層）。預設 false。

trans-unit.source: Open state (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 開啟狀態（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Gap to the trigger in px (Arc: 6).
trans-unit.target: 與觸發器之間的間距，單位 px（Arc 為 6）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the popover opens.
trans-unit.target: 浮層開啟時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Preferred side (flips when it does not fit; the motion follows the side it lands on).
trans-unit.target: 偏好方向（放不下時會翻轉；動態效果跟隨實際落位的一側）。

trans-unit.source: The control that opens the panel, shown in place of the popover (optional with `AttachProperty` or `ShowAt`).
trans-unit.target: 開啟面板的控制項，會顯示在浮層所在位置（可選，與 `AttachProperty` 或 `ShowAt` 搭配使用）。

trans-unit.source: Shows how much of a known task is complete (Arc Progress). One smooth spring drives both the fill and the counted percentage, so the number always matches the bar; the fill slides in from the left (keeping its round end) and turns to the success color at 100%, where a check settles in beside the count. `Minimum` is treated as 0 like Arc; a non-positive `Maximum` counts as 100.
trans-unit.target: 顯示已知任務的完成進度（Arc 進度條）。同一個平滑彈簧同時驅動填滿與計數百分比，因此數字始終與進度條一致；填滿從左側滑入（保留圓形末端），達到 100% 時變為成功色，同時一個勾號在計數旁彈入定位。`Minimum` 與 Arc 相同，視為 0；非正數的 `Maximum` 按 100 計算。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsComplete` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsComplete` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Shows the counted percentage and, at 100%, a check (Arc `showValue`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示計數的百分比；達到 100% 時還會顯示勾號（Arc 的 `showValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Visible label above the bar; it is also the accessible name (defaults to "Progress").
trans-unit.target: 進度條上方的可見標籤；同時也是無障礙名稱（預設為 "Progress"）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Percentage` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Percentage` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Shows a number as a horizontal bar with its text at the right edge. The value is read against `Minimum` and `Maximum` (0 to 100 by default, which suits a percent column).
trans-unit.target: 把數字顯示為水平條，文字顯示在右端。值依 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 讀取（預設 0 到 100，適合百分比欄）。

trans-unit.source: One option of `RadioCards` (Arc `RadioCardOption`): a label with optional description, a meta value (price, estimate), a decorative icon, and a reason shown in place of the description when the option is disabled.
trans-unit.target: `RadioCards` 的一個選項（Arc 的 `RadioCardOption`）：包含標籤（可選描述）、中繼資料值（價格、預估時間）、裝飾性圖示，以及選項停用時代替描述顯示的原因。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio cards: selectable option cards for choices that need more than a label (plans, shipping speeds, regions). One selection ring springs from card to card, so the eye follows the change, and a 6px dot pops into the chosen card's indicator. Behaves as a radio group: one tab stop, arrows (mirrored in right-to-left) move and select, Home / End jump to the ends and Enter / Space select. Disabled cards are skipped and show their reason. Cards come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioCardOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's value.
trans-unit.target: Arc 單選卡片：用於需要超過文字標籤的選擇（方案、配送速度、地區）的可選選項卡片。單一選取環會從一張卡片彈向另一張，讓視線跟隨變化；選中卡片的指示器中會彈出一個 6px 的圓點。其行為與單選群組一致：只有一個 Tab 停駐點，方向鍵（在由右至左的版面中鏡像）移動並選取，Home / End 跳到兩端，Enter / Space 選取。停用的卡片會被略過，並顯示其原因。卡片來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `RadioCardOption` 項目；`SelectedValue`（雙向繫結）為所選選項的值。

trans-unit.source: A choice is required (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 必須進行選擇（會告知輔助技術）。

trans-unit.source: Card placement: Grid (responsive columns, the default) or List (full-width rows with the meta at the end).
trans-unit.target: 卡片排列方式：Grid（響應式欄，預設）或 List（全寬列，中繼資料位於末端）。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a grid column may get before the grid drops a column (Arc default 180).
trans-unit.target: 網格欄可收窄到的最小寬度，低於此寬度時網格會減少一欄（Arc 預設 180）。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio group: choose one option from a visible set. One highlight (a `ControlOn` border with a faint fill) glides to the chosen row on the morph spring while the new dot springs in and the old one shrinks away, so a change reads as a single physical move. Arrow keys take the same path; the group is one tab stop (the selected row). Options come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's `Value`. The `Header` is the legend and the group's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: Arc 單選群組：從一組可見選項中選取其一。一個高亮框（`ControlOn` 邊框加淡色填滿）會以變形彈簧滑動到所選列，新的圓點彈入，舊的圓點縮小消失，因此變化看起來像一次連貫的物理移動。方向鍵走同樣的路徑；整個群組只有一個 Tab 停駐點（所選列）。選項來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `RadioOption` 項目；`SelectedValue`（雙向繫結）為所選選項的 `Value`。`Header` 為圖例，也是該群組的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `RadioGroup` (Arc `{ value, label, description? }`). Use it in `ItemsSource` or inline in XAML; the group reports `Value` as its `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: `RadioGroup` 的一個選項（Arc 的 `{ value, label, description? }`）。可用於 `ItemsSource` 或 XAML 內嵌；該群組會將 `Value` 回報為其 `SelectedValue`。

trans-unit.source: Fails a number outside `Minimum` and `Maximum`; empty values and other types pass.
trans-unit.target: 數字超出 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 時不通過；空值和其他型別通過。

trans-unit.source: The state of one reaction (Arc's `Reaction`): how many people chose it and whether the viewer did. A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 單一回應的狀態（Arc 的 `Reaction`）：選擇它的人數，以及檢視者是否已選擇。計數降為零的回應會離開回應列。

trans-unit.source: One reaction the picker offers (Arc's `ReactionOption`): an id, a label and a 24×24 Lucide glyph.
trans-unit.target: 選取器提供的一個回應（Arc 的 `ReactionOption`）：包含 id、標籤與一個 24×24 的 Lucide 圖形。

trans-unit.source: Arc reactions: a bar of reaction pills with counts plus an add button that opens a compact picker, like Slack's reactions on a comment, post or release note. One tap adds or removes the viewer's reaction: the count rolls (only the digits that change, in the direction it moved), the icon gets a velocity kick that stacks on quick taps (P27), the viewer's own reactions take the accent and a filled glyph. Pills scale in out of a blur and leave the bar when their count reaches zero while the rest glide into place (P26, P19); a new row grows the bar on a spring (P6). Hovering or focusing a pill shows its label and who reacted (`Tooltip`). Keyboard: Enter / Space toggles a pill or opens the picker; in the picker every arrow moves and wraps, Home / End jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button. Each change is announced politely.
trans-unit.target: Arc 回應：一排帶計數的回應膠囊，以及一個開啟精簡選取器的新增按鈕，類似 Slack 在留言、貼文或發布說明上的回應。單擊即可新增或移除檢視者的回應：計數滾動（只滾動變化的數字，方向與變化方向一致），圖示會獲得速度衝擊，快速連點時疊加（P27）；檢視者自己的回應採用強調色與實心圖形。膠囊從模糊中縮放出現，計數降為零時離開回應列，其餘膠囊滑動就位（P26、P19）；新增一行時，回應列會以彈簧擴展（P6）。懸停或聚焦到膠囊上會顯示其標籤以及誰做出了回應（`Tooltip`）。鍵盤操作：Enter / Space 切換膠囊或開啟選取器；在選取器中，所有方向鍵都會移動並循環，Home / End 跳轉，Enter 選取，Escape 關閉並將焦點返回新增按鈕。每次變化都會以禮貌方式通報。

trans-unit.source: Name and tooltip of the add button (default "Add reaction").
trans-unit.target: 新增按鈕的名稱與提示（預設 "Add reaction"）。

trans-unit.source: True while the picker is open.
trans-unit.target: 選取器開啟時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the bar (default "Reactions").

trans-unit.source: Arc's reorderable list: organize items with direct drag and drop. Rows are dragged by their grip (pointer capture): the row lifts, follows the pointer, the rows it passes slide aside on springs and the drop settles on a quick spring with the release velocity; holding a row near the edge of a scrolling ancestor scrolls it. Keyboard: ↑/↓ on a grip moves the row one place at once (Arc), Space / Enter picks it up so arrows preview the move, Space / Enter drops it and Escape cancels; every step is announced. A mutable `ItemsSource` (or inline items) is reordered in place; `Reordered` reports each move. Drag motion is render transforms only.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可重新排序清單：透過直接拖放整理項目。列透過抓手拖曳（指標擷取）：列會抬起並跟隨指標，經過的列會以彈簧滑開，放開時以快速彈簧結合放開速度落定；將列按住在捲動祖先的邊緣附近會捲動它。鍵盤操作：抓手上的 ↑/↓ 會立即將該列移動一位（與 Arc 一致），Space / Enter 拾起該列，此時方向鍵可預覽移動，Space / Enter 放下，Escape 取消；每一步都會被通報。可變的 `ItemsSource`（或內嵌項目）會就地重新排序；`Reordered` 回報每次移動。拖曳動態效果僅使用渲染變換。

trans-unit.source: Title used in the grip's accessible name and in announcements (defaults to `Title` or the item text).
trans-unit.target: 用於抓手無障礙名稱與通報的標題（預設為 `Title` 或項目文字）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list.
trans-unit.target: 清單的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) a mutable source is reordered in place; otherwise only `Reordered` is raised.
trans-unit.target: 為 true（預設）時，可變的資料來源會就地重新排序；否則僅引發 `Reordered`。

trans-unit.source: One pane of a `ResizablePanels` group. It carries the pane's configuration (label, default share, limits, collapsibility) and shows its content. Below its minimum the content keeps its minimum width, stays anchored to the moving edge and fades, so a closing pane slides away like a drawer instead of being crushed.
trans-unit.target: `ResizablePanels` 群組中的一個窗格。它承載窗格的設定（標籤、預設比例、限制、是否可摺疊）並顯示其內容。低於最小尺寸時，內容保持最小寬度，錨定在移動的邊緣並淡出，因此關閉中的窗格會像抽屜一樣滑走，而不是被壓扁。

trans-unit.source: Starting share of the group; shares are relative and need not add up to 100.
trans-unit.target: 群組的起始比例；比例為相對值，不必加總為 100。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (dividers reference panes by id).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id（分隔線透過 id 參照窗格）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pane is hidden. Two-way; the initial value is Arc's defaultCollapsed (needs `IsCollapsible`).
trans-unit.target: 窗格是否已隱藏。雙向繫結；初始值取 Arc 的 defaultCollapsed（需要 `IsCollapsible`）。

trans-unit.source: Dragging well past the minimum, or flicking toward the edge, snaps the pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，窗格會吸附關閉。

trans-unit.source: Names the pane for its divider, for example "Folders".
trans-unit.target: 為分隔線標示此窗格的名稱，例如 "Folders"。

trans-unit.source: Maximum width in px (infinite by default).
trans-unit.target: 最大寬度，單位為 px（預設無限制）。

trans-unit.source: Width in px where the pane starts to resist (Arc: 80). Its content never reflows below it.
trans-unit.target: 窗格開始產生阻力的寬度，單位為 px（Arc 為 80）。低於此寬度時內容不會重新排版。

trans-unit.source: Arc resizable panels: a horizontal split view whose panes trade space when the dividers between them are dragged, the way a mail or code editor window works. Dividers follow the pointer 1:1, resist past a pane's limits (rubber band up to 44px) and snap collapsible panes closed when dragged well past their minimum or flicked toward the edge; on release the panes settle on the smooth spring keeping the pointer's velocity. Each divider is focusable: arrows resize by 16px (Shift 64px) on the snappy spring, Home / End jump to the limits, Enter hides or restores a collapsible neighbour, Escape during a drag puts the divider back, and a double-click resets the layout. The group needs a definite height. `Sizes` (two-way, percent) persists the layout.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可調整大小的窗格：水平分割檢視，拖曳其間的分隔線時窗格之間相互讓出空間，與郵件或程式碼編輯器視窗的方式相同。分隔線以 1:1 緊隨指標，超出窗格限制時產生回彈（最多 44px）；拖到明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，可摺疊窗格會吸附關閉。放開後，窗格會以保留指標速度的平滑彈簧穩定下來。每條分隔線都可取得焦點：方向鍵每次調整 16px（按住 Shift 為 64px），使用靈敏彈簧；Home / End 跳到限制位置；Enter 隱藏或還原可摺疊的相鄰窗格；拖曳過程中按 Escape 會將分隔線復位；雙擊會重設版面配置。此群組需要確定的高度。`Sizes`（雙向，百分比）用於儲存版面配置。

trans-unit.source: Names the group for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 為此群組命名，供輔助技術使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each pane's share in percent after a resize settles.
trans-unit.target: 調整大小完成並穩定後引發，附帶每個窗格的比例（百分比）。

trans-unit.source: Each pane's share in percent. Updated after every resize settles; set it (for example from saved settings) to restore a layout. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 每個窗格的比例（百分比）。每次調整大小完成後更新；設定它（例如從儲存的設定中讀取）即可還原版面配置。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Arc's light rich text editor: Markdown shortcuts as you type, a floating selection toolbar that morphs into a link field, a slash menu for blocks, its own undo history, and HTML plus Markdown output. Blocks are paragraphs, three heading levels, nested bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, code blocks and dividers; inline marks are bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code and links.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的輕量富文字編輯器：輸入時支援 Markdown 快捷語法，浮動的選取範圍工具列可變形為連結欄位，斜線選單用於插入區塊，擁有獨立的復原歷史，並支援 HTML 與 Markdown 輸出。區塊包括段落、三級標題、巢狀的無序與有序清單、引用、程式碼區塊和分隔線；行內標記包括粗體、斜體、刪除線、行內程式碼和連結。

trans-unit.source: A ridgeline (joy plot, Arc "Ridgeline"): one smoothed density curve per group, overlapping like ridges and shaded by median. Every curve is sampled on a shared 96-point grid, so a new dataset or domain morphs each ridge from its on-screen shape on one 0.7s spring; the first view rolls the rows in from the top. Hover or ↑ / ↓ lifts a ridge (a copy drawn above the rest) with its middle half and median; ← / → move a reading cursor along the values.
trans-unit.target: 山脊圖（joy plot，即 Arc 的 "Ridgeline"）：每組一條平滑的密度曲線，像山脊般相互重疊，並依中位數著色。所有曲線都在共享的 96 點網格上取樣，因此新的資料集或取值範圍會透過一個 0.7s 的彈簧，使每條山脊從目前螢幕形狀變形過渡；首次顯示時各列會從頂部滾入。懸停或按 ↑ / ↓ 可抬起一條山脊（在其他山脊上方繪製一份副本），並顯示其中間一半與中位數；← / → 沿數值移動讀數游標。

trans-unit.source: Arc scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, keyboard, touch inertia, snap points) with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or hovering and fade away at rest, and edge fades that appear only where content continues, each exactly as long as the content hidden past that edge (up to `FadeLength`). The thumb thickens under the pointer, can be dragged, and pressing the track pages toward the pointer.
trans-unit.target: Arc 捲動區域：原生捲動（滾輪、鍵盤、觸控慣性、貼齊點），搭配細窄的覆蓋式捲軸，捲動或懸停時出現、靜止時淡出；邊緣淡出僅在內容仍延伸處出現，每段淡出的長度與該邊緣之外被隱藏的內容相符（上限為 `FadeLength`）。捲軸滑塊在指標下會變粗、可拖曳，按下軌道會朝指標方向翻頁。

trans-unit.source: Arc's Scrub input: a compact, Figma-style number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (Shift ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer, switching live and shown in a tag above the field), or click in and type an exact value: entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2` and a unit from `Units` such as `50%` (see `ScrubExpression`). Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `ResetValue`. At `Minimum` and `Maximum` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release; a rejected entry shakes and turns the edge red for 900ms. The row has no label or message rows of its own (the label is the drag handle) and fills its column by default.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的 Scrub 輸入框：緊湊的 Figma 風格數字欄位，適用於檢查器與屬性面板。橫向拖曳標籤即可調整數值（按住 Shift 時粗 10 倍，按住 Alt 時細 10 倍，切換時即時生效，並在欄位上方的提示中顯示），也可點入後輸入精確值：輸入內容支援 `12*2` 或 `(100-24)/2` 等算術運算式，以及 `Units` 中的單位，例如 `50%`（參見 `ScrubExpression`）。方向鍵逐步調整，Enter 提交，Escape 還原上一個值，雙擊標籤會還原 `ResetValue`。到達 `Minimum` 與 `Maximum` 時，欄位會以橡皮筋式阻力越過限制，放開後彈回；被拒絕的輸入會晃動，並將邊緣變紅 900ms。此列本身沒有標籤或訊息列（標籤即拖曳把手），預設填滿其所在欄。

trans-unit.source: Step with Shift held (null: ten times `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Shift 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的 10 倍）。

trans-unit.source: Step with Alt held (null: a tenth of `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Alt 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的十分之一）。

trans-unit.source: True for 900ms after a rejected entry.
trans-unit.target: 輸入被拒絕後的 900ms 內為 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc's `pointerLock`, kept for API parity (default true). Avalonia has no pointer lock, so scrubbing always uses normal pointer capture, as Arc does when a browser refuses the lock: a long drag can reach the screen edge.
trans-unit.target: 對應 Arc 的 `pointerLock`，僅為維持 API 一致而保留（預設為 true）。Avalonia 沒有指標鎖定，因此調整數值時一律使用一般的指標擷取，與瀏覽器拒絕鎖定時 Arc 的做法相同：長距離拖曳可能會到達螢幕邊緣。

trans-unit.source: True while the label is being dragged.

trans-unit.source: Shows the value's position between the limits as a quiet wash (null: on when both limits are finite).

trans-unit.target: 數值從最大值回繞到最小值，而不是停止（需要兩個上下限，且 Maximum > Minimum）。

trans-unit.source: The label, which is also the drag handle: text (weight 500) or a control such as a 14px `ArcGlyph`.
trans-unit.target: 標籤，同時也是拖曳把手：文字（字重 500）或控制項，例如 14px 的 `ArcGlyph`。

trans-unit.target: 數值（雙向繫結，預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Raised for every real change of `Value`: each step of a scrub, typed entries, key steps and resets (Arc's `onValueChange`), and values set from code or a binding (`Programmatic`).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 每次實際變更時引發：拖曳的每一步、鍵入的輸入、方向鍵步進與重設，以及由程式碼或繫結設定的值（`Programmatic`）（對應 Arc 的 `onValueChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a change settles: a scrub ends (or is cancelled), Enter or blur commits typing, a key step lands, or a reset. Like Arc it also fires when a commit leaves the value unchanged (a clamped entry at the limit).
trans-unit.target: 變更穩定後引發一次：拖曳結束（或取消）、按下 Enter 或失去焦點提交輸入、方向鍵步進完成，或重設時。與 Arc 一致，即使提交後值未變（例如在上限被夾限的輸入），也會引發。

trans-unit.source: A date range over `Date`, edited with a two-thumb slider. The range spans `Minimum` to `Maximum` (the oldest and newest item date when null); `Start` and `End` are the chosen ends (null: that end of the range). Items of kinds outside `AppliesTo` pass the filter, so a range over documents does not hide people.
trans-unit.target: 依 `Date` 的日期範圍，以雙滑桿編輯。範圍從 `Minimum` 到 `Maximum`（為 null 時取最早與最新項目的日期）；`Start` 與 `End` 為所選的兩端（為 null 時該端取範圍邊界）。不在 `AppliesTo` 所列類型之內的項目不受此篩選影響，因此針對文件的日期範圍不會隱藏人員。

trans-unit.source: The kinds the range applies to, as a comma separated list ("Docs, Files"). Empty: every item. Also words the default caption ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 此範圍適用的類型，以逗號分隔的清單表示（"Docs, Files"）。為空時適用於所有項目。也用於預設註腳的文字（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen end of the range (two-way). Null: the maximum.
trans-unit.target: 所選的範圍結束端（雙向繫結）。為 null 時取最大值。

trans-unit.source: The newest date the slider reaches. Null: the newest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑桿能到達的最新日期。為 null 時取最新項目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The oldest date the slider reaches. Null: the oldest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑桿能到達的最早日期。為 null 時取最早項目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The chosen start of the range (two-way). Null: the minimum.
trans-unit.target: 所選的範圍起始端（雙向繫結）。為 null 時取最小值。

trans-unit.source: Arc search field: a labeled search input with a leading glass that wakes up (full contrast) while the field is focused or filled, and a clear button that pops into a reserved slot, so the field never changes width. Every keystroke updates the two-way `Text` (debounce expensive filtering yourself); Escape clears the field, Enter raises `SearchSubmitted`, and clearing with the button returns focus to the field.
trans-unit.target: Arc 搜尋欄位：帶標籤的搜尋輸入框，前導的放大鏡圖示在欄位取得焦點或已填入內容時會亮起（全對比），清除按鈕會出現在預留的位置，因此欄位寬度永遠不變。每次按鍵都會更新雙向繫結的 `Text`（開銷大的篩選請自行防抖）；Escape 清空欄位，Enter 引發 `SearchSubmitted`，使用按鈕清空後焦點會回到欄位。

trans-unit.source: Name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter is pressed in the field.
trans-unit.target: 在欄位中按下 Enter 時引發。

trans-unit.source: A way to narrow the results of a `SearchResults`: a `SearchValueFilter` (a group of checkbox values) or a `SearchDateFilter` (a date range). Filters AND together; the values of one value filter OR.
trans-unit.target: 用於縮小 `SearchResults` 結果的一種方式：`SearchValueFilter`（一組核取方塊值）或 `SearchDateFilter`（日期範圍）。各篩選器之間為且關係；同一個值篩選器的各個值之間為或關係。

trans-unit.source: A muted line under the filter ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 篩選器下方的淡色提示行（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: Names the attribute of `SearchResultItem` the filter reads (see `Attributes`).
trans-unit.target: 指定篩選器讀取的 `SearchResultItem` 屬性名稱（參見 `Attributes`）。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the filter ("Type", "Team", "Edited").
trans-unit.target: 篩選器上方的標題（"Type"、"Team"、"Edited"）。

trans-unit.source: One value of a `SearchValueFilter`: a checkbox with a label and a count.
trans-unit.target: `SearchValueFilter` 的一個值：帶文字標籤與數量的核取方塊。

trans-unit.source: The results behind the value. `SearchResults` writes it while it filters; with `IsFilteringEnabled` false it is yours (a server's facet counts) and the control only reads it. A value with a count of 0 is dimmed and cannot be ticked, but keeps its place.
trans-unit.target: 此值對應的結果數量。`SearchResults` 在篩選時寫入此值；當 `IsFilteringEnabled` 為 false 時由你設定（例如伺服器的分面計數），控制項只讀取它。數量為 0 的值會變暗且無法勾選，但仍保留其位置。

trans-unit.source: Whether the checkbox is ticked (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 核取方塊是否已勾選（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The text beside the checkbox; `Value` when null.
trans-unit.target: 核取方塊旁的文字；為 null 時使用 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: What an item's attribute has to equal (ignoring case).
trans-unit.target: 項目的屬性必須等於的值（忽略大小寫）。

trans-unit.source: One key/value row of a result's detail sheet.
trans-unit.target: 結果詳情面板中的一行鍵值。

trans-unit.source: A person's photo for the avatar before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片，顯示在值之前的大頭貼中。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: a small avatar with their initials is shown before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：值之前會顯示一個帶其姓名首字母的小型大頭貼。

trans-unit.source: The muted name on the left ("Team").
trans-unit.target: 左側淡色顯示的名稱（"Team"）。

trans-unit.source: A muted remark after the value ("3 weeks ago").
trans-unit.target: 值之後淡色顯示的備註（"3 weeks ago"）。

trans-unit.source: The value on the right.
trans-unit.target: 右側顯示的值。

trans-unit.source: One searchable entry of a `SearchResults`: a document, a person, a file or anything else your workspace holds. `Kind` and `Attributes` feed the filters, the text properties are searched and shown, and the detail properties fill the sheet that opens when the result is chosen.
trans-unit.target: `SearchResults` 中一個可搜尋的項目：文件、人員、檔案或工作區中的任何其他內容。`Kind` 與 `Attributes` 供篩選器使用；文字屬性會被搜尋並顯示；詳情屬性會填入選取結果時開啟的詳情面板。

trans-unit.source: A photo for a person: the row and the detail show a round avatar instead of the icon.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片：列與詳情中會顯示圓形大頭貼而非圖示。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: the avatar shows its initials (and the photo's fallback). Setting it switches the row to an avatar.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：大頭貼會顯示其姓名首字母（也是照片載入失敗時的備用內容）。設定後該列會切換為大頭貼。

trans-unit.source: The paragraphs shown in the detail sheet, separated by blank lines. Searched and marked there.
trans-unit.target: 詳情面板中顯示的段落，以空白行分隔。在此處進行搜尋並醒目標示。

trans-unit.source: A last, muted line under the snippet, such as an email address. Not searched.
trans-unit.target: 摘錄下方最後一行淡色顯示的文字，例如電子郵件地址。不參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: When the result was last edited; sorts "Newest" and feeds a `SearchDateFilter`.
trans-unit.target: 結果最後編輯的時間；用於 "Newest" 排序，並為 `SearchDateFilter` 提供資料。

trans-unit.source: A 20px icon: a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry` or a control. Default: Lucide FileText.
trans-unit.target: 20px 圖示：24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry` 或一個控制項。預設為 Lucide FileText。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; the title is used when it is empty.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id；為空時使用標題。

trans-unit.source: When false the result is listed dimmed, skipped by the keyboard cursor and cannot be opened.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，該結果會以淡化樣式列出，鍵盤游標會略過它，且無法開啟。

trans-unit.source: Extra words that also find the result (synonyms, ids, tags).
trans-unit.target: 同樣可用於查找結果的額外詞語（同義詞、id、標籤）。

trans-unit.source: The type of the result ("Docs", "People", "Files"): the value of the filter whose key is `KindKey`.
trans-unit.target: 結果的類型（"Docs"、"People"、"Files"）：即鍵為 `KindKey` 的篩選器的值。

trans-unit.source: The singular name of the kind ("Doc") used in the subtitle and the detail sheet; `Kind` when null.
trans-unit.target: 該類型的單數名稱（"文件"），用於副標題與詳情面板；為 null 時使用 `Kind`。

trans-unit.source: Where the result lives: a path or a breadcrumb ("Engineering / Handbook"). Also searched.
trans-unit.target: 結果所在的位置：路徑或麵包屑（"Engineering / Handbook"）。同樣參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: A passage of the content; long passages are cut to a window around the first match. Searched.
trans-unit.target: 內容的一段文字；較長的段落會裁剪為圍繞第一個符合項的一個視窗。參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title (a person's role and city). When null the row shows "`KindLabel` in `Location`" (or just the location).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行（人員的角色和城市）。為 null 時該行顯示 "`KindLabel` in `Location`"（或僅顯示位置）。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the result is opened.
trans-unit.target: 任何你希望在開啟結果時取回的值。

trans-unit.source: The name of the result; searched first, marked where it matches and ranked by.
trans-unit.target: 結果的名稱；優先參與搜尋，符合處會醒目標示，並作為排序依據。

trans-unit.source: The address "Copy link" puts on the clipboard.
trans-unit.target: "複製連結"寫入剪貼簿的位址。

trans-unit.source: A search results page for a workspace (an original TKCode design, after Algolia InstantSearch's search box, hits, highlight, refinement list and stats). A large search field with a suggestions popup (recent and suggested searches), a filters column (checkbox groups whose counts follow the query and the other filters, and a date range), a results header with the count, the time it took and a sort switch, the active filters as removable chips, and the results: people and documents in one list, matches marked in titles and in a snippet cut around the first match. One cursor block glides between the results; Enter or a click opens a result in a detail dialog (a bottom sheet on narrow screens). Below 560 the filters move behind a button into a sheet.
trans-unit.target: 工作區的搜尋結果頁面（TKCode 原創設計，參照 Algolia InstantSearch 的搜尋框、命中結果、醒目標示、細化清單與統計資訊）。包含一個大型搜尋欄及建議彈層（最近搜尋與建議搜尋）、篩選欄（核取方塊群組，其計數隨查詢與其他篩選條件變化，另有日期範圍）、帶有數量、耗時與排序切換的結果標題列、以可移除標籤形式顯示的已啟用篩選條件，以及結果：人員與文件混合在同一清單中，標題與摘錄中的符合處會醒目標示，摘錄圍繞第一個符合處裁切。一個游標區塊在結果之間平滑移動；按 Enter 或點按可在詳情對話框中開啟結果（窄螢幕時為底部面板）。寬度小於 560 時，篩選器會收入按鈕後的面板中。

trans-unit.source: The number of filter values ticked plus date ranges narrowed (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 已勾選的篩選值數量加上已縮小範圍的日期範圍數量（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The result under the cursor, or null.
trans-unit.target: 游標所在的結果，或為 null。

trans-unit.source: The word between the last two kinds of the default caption. Default "and".
trans-unit.target: 預設標題中最後兩種類型之間的連接詞。預設為 "and"。

trans-unit.source: The caption of a date filter without one; {0} lists its kinds ("docs and files"). Default "Applies to {0}".
trans-unit.target: 未設定標題的日期篩選器的標題；{0} 列出其類型（"docs and files"）。預設為 "Applies to {0}"。

trans-unit.source: The "Best match" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "最佳符合"排序選項。

trans-unit.source: The link that clears every filter (in the column and in the active filters bar). Default "Clear all".
trans-unit.target: 清除所有篩選條件的連結（位於篩選欄與已啟用篩選條件列中）。預設為 "Clear all"。

trans-unit.source: The empty state's button that clears the filters. Default "Clear filters".
trans-unit.target: 空狀態中用於清除篩選條件的按鈕。預設為 "Clear filters"。

trans-unit.source: Names the clear button of the field. Default "Clear search".
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄清除按鈕的名稱。預設為 "Clear search"。

trans-unit.source: Names the close buttons of the detail and the filters sheet. Default "Close".
trans-unit.target: 詳情面板和篩選器面板關閉按鈕的名稱。預設為 "Close"。

trans-unit.source: The detail's secondary button. Default "Copy link".
trans-unit.target: 詳情中的次要按鈕。預設為 "Copy link"。

trans-unit.source: The month and year format of a date range ("Sep 2025"). Default "MMM yyyy".
trans-unit.target: 日期範圍的月份和年份格式（"Sep 2025"）。預設為 "MMM yyyy"。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a button of the detail is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下詳情中的按鈕時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the built-in content of the detail (everything between the header and the buttons); its data is the `SearchResultItem`.
trans-unit.target: 取代詳情中的內建內容（標題與按鈕之間的全部內容）；其資料為 `SearchResultItem`。

trans-unit.source: How long the search took, shown after the count ("in 0.12 seconds"). Null shows nothing; the app measures it.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋耗時，顯示在數量之後（"in 0.12 seconds"）。為 null 時不顯示；耗時由應用程式量測。

trans-unit.source: The time after the count; {0} is the seconds. Default "in {0} seconds".
trans-unit.target: 數量之後的時間文字；{0} 為秒數。預設為 "in {0} seconds"。

trans-unit.source: Empty state description. Default "Check the spelling or try fewer words."
trans-unit.target: 空狀態描述。預設為 "Check the spelling or try fewer words."

trans-unit.source: Empty state description while filters hide results. Default "The filters leave nothing. Remove one to see more."
trans-unit.target: 篩選條件隱藏所有結果時的空狀態描述。預設為 "The filters leave nothing. Remove one to see more."

trans-unit.source: Empty state title; {0} is the query. Default "No results for “{0}”".
trans-unit.target: 空狀態標題；{0} 為查詢內容。預設為「No results for “{0}”」。

trans-unit.source: The narrow layout's button that opens the filters. Default "Filters".
trans-unit.target: 窄螢幕版面中用於開啟篩選器的按鈕。預設為 "Filters"。

trans-unit.source: The filters column title. Default "Filters".
trans-unit.target: 篩選欄的標題。預設為 "Filters"。

trans-unit.source: True while at least one filter narrows the results (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 至少有一個篩選條件縮小結果範圍時為 true（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to move". Default "to move,".
trans-unit.target: 按鍵提示"移動"。預設為 "to move,"。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to open". Default "to open,".
trans-unit.target: 按鍵提示"開啟"。預設為 "to open,"。

trans-unit.source: The key hint "to search". Default "to search".
trans-unit.target: 按鍵提示"搜尋"。預設為 "to search"。

trans-unit.source: Executed with the opened `SearchResultItem`.
trans-unit.target: 以被開啟的 `SearchResultItem` 執行。

trans-unit.source: Whether Enter or a click opens the built-in detail. Turn it off when your app navigates on `ItemInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: 按下 Enter 或點按時是否開啟內建詳情。若應用程式在 `ItemInvoked` 中進行導覽，請關閉此項。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) the items are matched, filtered, counted and sorted here. Set it to false when a server searched: the items are shown as given, `Count` is yours, and the query's terms are still marked.
trans-unit.target: 為 true（預設）時，項目會在此處進行比對、篩選、計數與排序。若搜尋由伺服器執行，請設為 false：項目將依原樣顯示，`Count` 由你自行提供，查詢詞仍會醒目標示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the keyboard hints show under the results. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 是否在結果下方顯示鍵盤提示。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows skeleton rows in place of the results (keeping the previous results' height).
trans-unit.target: 以骨架列取代結果顯示（保持先前結果的高度）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the suggestions popup opens under the focused field. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 是否在取得焦點的欄位下方開啟建議彈層。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a result is opened with Enter or a click (before the detail shows; set Handled to skip the detail).
trans-unit.target: 以 Enter 或點按開啟結果時引發（在顯示詳情之前；設定 Handled 可略過詳情）。

trans-unit.source: Items to search; when null the inline `Items` are used. Collection changes are followed.
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的項目；為 null 時使用內嵌的 `Items`。會追蹤集合的變更。

trans-unit.source: The kind and the location in a result's subtitle; {0} is the kind label, {1} the location. Default "{0} in {1}".
trans-unit.target: 結果副標題中的類型與位置；{0} 為類型標籤，{1} 為位置。預設 "{0} in {1}"。

trans-unit.source: Names the search landmark and the search field.
trans-unit.target: 為搜尋地標與搜尋欄指定名稱。

trans-unit.source: Stats text while `IsLoading` is true. Default "Searching…".
trans-unit.target: `IsLoading` 為 true 時的統計資訊文字。預設為「Searching…」。

trans-unit.source: The first row of the detail table: how often the query matches. Default "Matches".
trans-unit.target: 詳情表格的第一行：查詢的比對次數。預設 "Matches"。

trans-unit.source: How many recent searches are kept. Default 5.
trans-unit.target: 保留的最近搜尋數量。預設 5。

trans-unit.source: The "Newest" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "Newest" 排序選項。

trans-unit.source: Stats text (and empty title without a query) when nothing matches. Default "No results".

trans-unit.source: Stats text for one result; {0} is the count. Default "{0} result".
trans-unit.target: 單一結果的統計文字；{0} 為數量。預設 "{0} result"。

trans-unit.source: The detail's primary button; {0} is the kind label in lower case. Default "Open {0}".
trans-unit.target: 詳情的主要按鈕；{0} 為小寫的類型標籤。預設 "Open {0}"。

trans-unit.source: The result whose detail is open, or null (two-way). Setting it opens that result's detail.
trans-unit.target: 目前開啟詳情的結果，或為 null（雙向）。設定此項會開啟該結果的詳情。

trans-unit.source: Results listed first; more follow when the list is scrolled to its end or "Show more" is pressed. Default 15.
trans-unit.target: 首先列出的結果數；當清單捲動至結尾或按下 "Show more" 時會載入更多。預設 15。

trans-unit.source: Hint in the empty search field.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄為空時的提示文字。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄中的文字（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a query is submitted: Enter in the field, or a suggestion chosen.
trans-unit.target: 提交查詢時引發：在欄位中按下 Enter，或選取某個建議時。

trans-unit.source: The group of recent searches in the popup. Default "Recent".
trans-unit.target: 彈層中最近搜尋的分組。預設 "Recent"。

trans-unit.source: Names the remove button of a filter chip. Default "Remove filter".
trans-unit.target: 為篩選器標籤的移除按鈕命名。預設 "Remove filter"。

trans-unit.source: The number of results for the current query and filters.
trans-unit.target: 目前查詢與篩選器下的結果數量。

trans-unit.source: Stats text for several results; {0} is the count (it rolls). Default "{0} results".
trans-unit.target: 多筆結果的統計文字；{0} 為數量（數字會滾動更新）。預設 "{0} results"。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the query, a filter or the sort order changed (ask your server again).
trans-unit.target: 查詢、篩選器或排序方式變更時引發（請讓伺服器重新搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: The key hint on the field's keycap (the key that focuses it). Default "/".
trans-unit.target: 欄位鍵帽上的按鍵提示（即用來聚焦該欄位的按鍵）。預設 "/"。

trans-unit.source: Button under the listed results when more are left. Default "Show more".
trans-unit.target: 當仍有更多結果時，顯示在已列出結果下方的按鈕。預設 "Show more"。

trans-unit.source: How the results are ordered (two-way). Default `BestMatch`.
trans-unit.target: 結果的排序方式（雙向）。預設 `BestMatch`。

trans-unit.source: The group of suggested searches in the popup. Default "Suggested".
trans-unit.target: 彈層中建議搜尋的分組。預設 "Suggested"。

trans-unit.source: Queries offered under "Suggested" in the popup and when nothing matches; choosing one fills the search field.
trans-unit.target: 在彈層的 "Suggested" 下以及無符合結果時提供的查詢；選取其中一項會填入搜尋欄位。

trans-unit.source: The "A to Z" sort option.
trans-unit.target: "A to Z" 排序選項。

trans-unit.source: The word before the suggestions of the empty state. Default "Try".
trans-unit.target: 空白狀態下建議之前的提示詞。預設 "Try"。

trans-unit.source: A group of checkbox values over one attribute. Tick several values to see results with any of them. Leave `Values` empty to list the values found in the items (in the order they first appear); list them yourself to fix their order and labels. `SearchResults` writes each value's `Count`: the results that value would show with the query and the other filters applied.
trans-unit.target: 基於同一屬性的一組核取方塊值。勾選多個值可查看符合其中任一值的結果。將 `Values` 留空時，會依項目中值首次出現的順序列出找到的值；如需固定順序與標籤，請自行列出。`SearchResults` 會寫入每個值的 `Count`：即套用查詢與其他篩選器後，該值會顯示的結果數。

trans-unit.source: The account security page: a checkup of four safeguards (password, two-step verification, passkeys, recovery codes), the password with a change form that opens in place, the two-step methods, and every signed-in session with a way to sign it out. Each action happens on the page; the host hears about it through routed events.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶安全性設定頁面：檢查四項安全防護（密碼、兩步驟驗證、通行金鑰、復原碼），提供可就地展開的密碼變更表單、兩步驟驗證方式，以及所有登入工作階段，並可將其登出。每項操作都在頁面內完成，宿主透過路由事件得知。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Add passkey" is pressed; the host runs the passkey ceremony and updates `PasskeyCount`.
trans-unit.target: 按下「新增通行金鑰」時引發；宿主執行通行金鑰流程並更新 `PasskeyCount`。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the meter moves under the summary text and "Sign out other sessions" moves under the list (default 560).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，進度條移至摘要文字下方，「登出其他工作階段」移至列表下方（預設 560）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the account has a password (default true). Without one the row offers "Set password" and the form asks only for the new password; a successful change sets it to true (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 帳戶是否已設定密碼（預設為 true）。未設定時，該設定列提供「設定密碼」，表單僅要求輸入新密碼；變更成功後會將其設為 true（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins ask for a code from an authenticator app (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登入時要求輸入驗證器應用程式中的驗證碼（雙向繫結，跟隨其開關）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the password form is open.
trans-unit.target: 是否已展開密碼表單。

trans-unit.source: Whether the security checkup card is shown at the top (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否在頂部顯示安全檢查卡片（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins send a code by text message (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登入時透過簡訊傳送驗證碼（雙向繫結，跟隨其開關）。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text and the culture for dates; replace the whole object to localize.
trans-unit.target: 所有內建文字以及日期地區設定；取代整個物件即可在地化。

trans-unit.source: Raised after "Sign out other sessions" was confirmed and every other session's row has left.
trans-unit.target: 在「登出其他工作階段」獲得確認且其他工作階段的各列均已移除後引發。

trans-unit.source: How many passkeys the account has.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶擁有的通行金鑰數量。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the password form is submitted. Set `ErrorMessage` to reject it.
trans-unit.target: 提交密碼表單時引發。設定 `ErrorMessage` 可拒絕此次提交。

trans-unit.source: When the password was last changed; null reads "Never changed". Set to the clock's time after a successful change (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 密碼最後一次變更的時間；為 null 時顯示「從未變更」。變更成功後設為時鐘的目前時間（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The phone number for text messages; only its last four digits are shown ("•••• 4821"). Without one the text message switch is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 簡訊使用的電話號碼；僅顯示末四碼（「•••• 4821」）。沒有號碼時，簡訊開關會被停用。

trans-unit.source: How many of the four safeguards are on (0–4): a password, two-step verification by either method, at least one passkey, and recovery codes.
trans-unit.target: 四項安全防護中已開啟的數量（0–4）：密碼、任一方式的兩步驟驗證、至少一組通行金鑰，以及復原碼。

trans-unit.source: When the recovery codes were created; null means there are none.
trans-unit.target: 復原碼的建立時間；null 表示沒有復原碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "View codes" or "Create codes" is pressed; the host shows or creates the codes and updates `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`.
trans-unit.target: 按下「查看復原碼」或「建立復原碼」時引發；宿主應用程式會顯示或建立復原碼，並更新 `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`。

trans-unit.source: Which cards are shown (default all): show only the sessions, or only the password, on a page of your own.
trans-unit.target: 顯示哪些卡片（預設全部）。例如在自己的頁面上只顯示登入工作階段，或只顯示密碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a session's "Sign out" row has left and the session was taken off `Sessions`.
trans-unit.target: 登入工作階段的「登出」列離開，且該工作階段已從 `Sessions` 移除後引發。

trans-unit.source: The signed-in sessions, listed current first, then by most recent activity. A signed-out session leaves its row and is removed from this list when the list can be changed. Defaults to an empty observable list.
trans-unit.target: 已登入的工作階段，目前的工作階段排在最前，其餘依最近活動時間排序。已登出的工作階段會離開其列，並在列表可以變更時從此列表移除。預設為空的可觀察列表。

trans-unit.source: Arc segmented control: a row of buttons for switching between a small set of related views. One selection pill glides between them on the morph spring; segments never scale or change weight, only their label color follows. Arrows (wrapping), Home and End move the selection like a tab list and only the selected segment is a tab stop. When the options are wider than the control the row scrolls inside itself with faded edges, and the selected segment is always scrolled fully into view. `ItemIntent` fires when the pointer or focus reaches a segment before it is chosen (preload what it shows).
trans-unit.target: Arc 分段控制項：一排按鈕，用於在一小組相關檢視之間切換。被選取的膠囊會在變形彈簧上於各段之間滑動；分段從不縮放或變更字重，只有標籤顏色會跟著變化。方向鍵（循環）、Home 與 End 會像索引標籤清單一樣移動選取項，且只有被選取的分段才是 Tab 停駐點。當選項寬度超過控制項時，該列會在內部捲動並帶有淡出的邊緣，被選取的分段總是完整捲動到可見範圍內。`ItemIntent` 會在指標或焦點於分段被選取前到達時引發（可用於預先載入其內容）。

trans-unit.source: The pointer or keyboard focus reached a segment (it may not be selected yet).
trans-unit.target: 指標或鍵盤焦點已到達某個分段（該分段可能尚未被選取）。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `SegmentedControl` (Arc `Segment`): a short label and optional accessory.
trans-unit.target: `SegmentedControl` 的一個選項（Arc 的 `Segment`）：一個簡短的標籤與可選的附加元件。

trans-unit.source: Arc select: a labelled, compact choice field with a keyboard friendly menu (Radix Select semantics). The shown value rolls in the direction of the list, the menu drops from the trigger, a highlight glides between options and the chosen option carries a check. Use it for short, fixed lists such as regions or sort orders. Options come from `ItemsSource` (any objects, `SelectOption` records) or inline `SelectItem` children; labels use `TextSelector`, `DisplayMemberBinding` or `ToString()`, values use `ValueSelector`, `SelectedValueBinding` or the item. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the highlight; Enter or Space picks; Escape closes without a change; typing jumps to the next matching option (and picks it directly while the menu is closed).
trans-unit.target: Arc 選取框：帶標籤的緊湊型選擇欄位，配有對鍵盤友善的選單（Radix Select 語意）。顯示的值會沿清單方向滾動切換，選單從觸發器處展開，反白會在選項之間滑動，被選取的選項會帶有勾選標記。適用於地區或排序方式等簡短的固定清單。選項來自 `ItemsSource`（任意物件，或 `SelectOption` 記錄）或內嵌的 `SelectItem` 子元素；標籤使用 `TextSelector`、`DisplayMemberBinding` 或 `ToString()`，值使用 `ValueSelector`、`SelectedValueBinding` 或選項本身。鍵盤操作：Enter、Space 和方向鍵可開啟；方向鍵、Home / End 和 PageUp / PageDown 移動反白；Enter 或 Space 選取；Escape 關閉且不做變更；鍵入字元會跳到下一個符合的選項（選單關閉時則直接選取該選項）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Description` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Description` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `DisabledSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `DisabledSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsOpen` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsOpen` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxDropDownHeight` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxDropDownHeight` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Placeholder` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Placeholder` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SelectedText` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SelectedText` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `TextSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `TextSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ValueSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ValueSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Declares one option of a `Select`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `MorphSelect` or `ChipGroup` inline in XAML: `<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`. The owning control draws the option itself (virtualized and filtered without containers), so this element only carries data; set `IsEnabled` to false for an option that can be seen but not picked.
trans-unit.target: 在 XAML 中以內嵌方式宣告 `Select`、`Combobox`、`MultiSelect`、`MorphSelect` 或 `ChipGroup` 的一個選項：`<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`。所屬控制項自行繪製選項（虛擬化且篩選時無需容器），因此此元素只承載資料；若選項需要可見但不可選取，請將 `IsEnabled` 設為 false。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Content` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Content` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Group` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Group` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Icon` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Icon` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Keywords` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Keywords` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Meta` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Meta` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Value` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Value` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A plain option record for `ItemsSource` lists that every select in this category understands without selectors: `new SelectOption("us", "United States")`.
trans-unit.target: 供 `ItemsSource` 清單使用的一般選項記錄，此分類中的所有選取框無需選取器即可辨識：`new SelectOption("us", "United States")`。

trans-unit.source: A settings command palette: one search field that finds any setting and changes it in place. Toggles flip, choices cycle through their options and actions run, all without leaving the keyboard; focus stays in the search field while the arrow keys move a highlight that glides between rows. A notice in the footer confirms each change. Write the settings inline (`SettingsCommandToggle`, `SettingsCommandChoice`, `SettingsCommandAction`) or bind `Items`. Their values are styled properties, so `IsChecked` and `SelectedOption` bind two-way and the rows follow changes made elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 設定命令面板：一個搜尋欄，可以找到任意設定並就地修改。開關會切換，選項會在各個可選值之間循環，動作會直接執行，全程不必離開鍵盤；焦點保持在搜尋欄中，方向鍵移動高亮，高亮在各設定列之間滑動。頁尾的提示會確認每次變更。可以內嵌撰寫設定（`SettingsCommandToggle`、`SettingsCommandChoice`、`SettingsCommandAction`），也可以繫結 `Items`。它們的值是樣式屬性，因此 `IsChecked` 與 `SelectedOption` 支援雙向繫結，各設定列會跟隨其他地方的變更。

trans-unit.source: The highlighted setting that Enter acts on, or null when nothing is on show.
trans-unit.target: 高亮的設定，按 Enter 即對其執行動作；沒有可顯示的設定時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Escape is pressed with an empty query: close the palette. Mark it handled so a surrounding Dialog does not handle the same Escape again.
trans-unit.target: 在查詢為空時按下 Escape 時引發，用於關閉面板。將其標記為已處理，使外層的 Dialog 不會再次處理同一次 Escape。

trans-unit.source: Whether the palette draws its own panel (surface, border, radius and floating shadow). Turn it off inside a Dialog or another surface.
trans-unit.target: 是否由面板自行繪製外框（底色、邊框、圓角與浮動陰影）。在 Dialog 或其他容器中使用時請關閉。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is invoked with Enter or a click, after its command ran.
trans-unit.target: 透過 Enter 或點擊呼叫動作時引發，在其命令執行之後。

trans-unit.source: The settings to search, in the order they are listed when the query is empty.
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的設定，查詢為空時依此順序列出。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the palette.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字；如需在地化面板，請替換整個物件。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄中的文字（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The tallest the result list gets before it scrolls.
trans-unit.target: 結果列表在出現捲動之前可達到的最大高度。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user changes a toggle or a choice (not when the app sets the value).
trans-unit.target: 使用者變更開關或選項時引發（應用程式以程式碼設定值時不引發）。

trans-unit.source: A command such as "Change email" or "Sign out everywhere". Enter or a click runs `Command`, then the palette raises `ItemInvoked`. The row shows the `Shortcut` in key caps and, for links to another page, an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 一則命令，例如「變更電子郵件」或「在所有裝置上登出」。按 Enter 或點擊會執行 `Command`，然後面板引發 `ItemInvoked`。該設定列以鍵帽形式顯示 `Shortcut`；如果是連到其他頁面的連結，則顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: The command to run.
trans-unit.target: 要執行的命令。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Whether the action opens another page; the row shows an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 是否開啟其他頁面；設定列會顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: The app's shortcut for the action, shown in key caps, such as "mod+shift+d" (Command on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) or "Ctrl+,". The palette only shows it; the app handles the shortcut itself.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式為該動作設定的快捷鍵，以鍵帽形式顯示，例如「mod+shift+d」（Mac 上為 Command，其他平台為 Ctrl）或「Ctrl+,」。面板只負責顯示，快捷鍵由應用程式自行處理。

trans-unit.source: A setting with a few named values. Enter or a click moves to the next option (after the last comes the first); the left and right arrow keys, and the arrows beside the value, step without wrapping.
trans-unit.target: 具有數個具名值的設定。按 Enter 或點擊會切換到下一個選項（最後一個之後回到第一個）；左右方向鍵以及值旁邊的箭頭逐項移動，不循環。

trans-unit.source: The values in order. In XAML a comma-separated string works: `Options="Light, Dark, System"`.
trans-unit.target: 依序排列的值。在 XAML 中可以使用逗號分隔的字串：`Options="Light, Dark, System"`。

trans-unit.source: The current value (two-way). When null it becomes the first option.
trans-unit.target: 目前的值（雙向繫結）。為 null 時會變為第一個選項。

trans-unit.source: One line under the header (trimmed to a single line); also searched.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字（會截為單行）；同時參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: The group the row is listed under, such as "Appearance"; also searched. Without one it is listed under "Settings" when other settings have a group.
trans-unit.target: 該設定列所屬的群組，例如「外觀」；同時參與搜尋。未指定群組時，若其他設定有群組，則歸入「設定」。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in the row and searched first.
trans-unit.target: 設定的名稱，顯示在設定列中，並優先參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成員），顯示在標題前的圖塊中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting can be changed. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 是否可以修改該設定。停用的設定列會變暗，並在鍵盤操作中被略過。

trans-unit.source: Other words that find the setting (synonyms separated by spaces or commas), such as "dark light appearance".
trans-unit.target: 其他能搜尋到該設定的詞語（以空格或逗號分隔的同義詞），例如「深色 淺色 外觀」。

trans-unit.source: An on / off setting. Enter or a click flips `IsChecked`; the row shows a switch.
trans-unit.target: 開 / 關設定。按 Enter 或點擊會切換 `IsChecked`；該設定列會顯示開關。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting is on (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 是否開啟該設定（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: A group of related settings: an optional header with a description and actions, a stack of rows (usually `SettingsRow`, written inline or bound through `ItemsSource`), and an optional footer strip for a note or a save button. Drawn as a card by default, or plain inside a page.
trans-unit.target: 一組相關設定：可選的標題（含描述與操作）、一組設定列（通常為 `SettingsRow`，可直接寫在 XAML 中，或透過 `ItemsSource` 繫結），以及可選的底部條，用於放置備註或儲存按鈕。預設以卡片樣式繪製，在頁面中則為平鋪。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 卡片（預設）或平鋪。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一句說明。

trans-unit.source: Content of the strip under the rows, such as a note and a save button.
trans-unit.target: 設定列下方底部條中的內容，例如備註或儲存按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Content at the right of the header, such as a button.
trans-unit.target: 標題右側的內容，例如按鈕。

trans-unit.source: A full settings page. The left column holds the page `Title`, one navigation item per `SettingsSection` (icon, header, badge) under a raised selection pill that glides between them, and a `Footer` such as an account card; the chosen section fills the rest of the page. While the chosen section is `IsDirty`, a save bar rises at the bottom with Discard and Save. Narrower than `CompactWidth`, the page becomes one column with the sections as a scrolling row of pills. Write the sections inline (`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`) or bind them through `ItemsSource`; the first enabled section is selected by default.
trans-unit.target: 完整的設定頁。左欄顯示頁面的 `Title`，每個 `SettingsSection` 對應一個導覽項目（圖示、標題、徽章），導覽項目之間有一個凸起的選取膠囊滑動切換；左欄底部是 `Footer`，例如帳戶卡片。所選區段佔滿頁面其餘部分。所選區段有未儲存的變更（`IsDirty`）時，底部會升起儲存列，含捨棄與儲存按鈕。寬度小於 `CompactWidth` 時，頁面變為單欄，區段以一排可捲動的膠囊呈現。可直接內嵌撰寫區段（`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`），也可透過 `ItemsSource` 繫結；預設選取第一個已啟用的區段。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the page becomes one column with the sections as a row of pills (default 720).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，頁面變為單欄，區段以一排膠囊呈現（預設 720）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Discard is pressed in the save bar.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存列中按下「捨棄」時引發。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom of the navigation column, such as an account card. Hidden on compact pages.
trans-unit.target: 導覽欄底部的內容，例如帳戶卡片。在精簡版面的頁面中隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page is narrower than `CompactWidth` and shows one column.
trans-unit.target: 頁面是否窄於 `CompactWidth` 並顯示為單欄。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text (save bar, accessible names). Replace the whole object to translate it.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字（儲存列、無障礙名稱）。替換整個物件即可翻譯。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Save is pressed (or Ctrl/⌘+S) while the selected section has unsaved changes.
trans-unit.target: 所選區段有未儲存的變更時，按下儲存（或 Ctrl/⌘+S）時引發。

trans-unit.source: The page title above the navigation (default "Settings").
trans-unit.target: 導覽上方的頁面標題（預設為「設定」）。

trans-unit.source: One setting: an optional icon, a header and description on the left, and the control that changes it (`Content`) on the right. Below `StackWidth` the control moves under the text. Rows in a `SettingsGroup` (or any panel) are separated by a hairline; the first row has none. When the control is a toggle (Switch, Checkbox), clicking the header or description toggles it too, and the control takes the header as its accessible name and the description as its help text unless it has its own.
trans-unit.target: 一項設定：左側為可選的圖示、標題與描述，右側為用來變更此設定的控制項（`Content`）。寬度小於 `StackWidth` 時，控制項會移到文字下方。`SettingsGroup`（或任何面板）中的設定列以細線分隔，第一列沒有分隔線。當控制項是開關（Switch）或核取方塊（Checkbox）時，點擊標題或描述也會切換它；除非控制項已有自己的名稱與說明文字，否則會以標題作為無障礙名稱，以描述作為說明文字。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header that explains the setting; also the control's help text.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方說明此設定的一句話；同時也是控制項的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in medium weight; also the control's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 設定的名稱，以中等字重顯示；同時也是控制項的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 線性圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成員），顯示在標題前的圖塊中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the control currently sits under the text (the row is narrower than `StackWidth`).
trans-unit.target: 控制項目前是否位於文字下方（即設定列寬度小於 `StackWidth`）。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the control moves under the header and description (default 440).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，控制項會移到標題與描述下方（預設 440）。

trans-unit.source: One section of a `SettingsPage`: its `Header`, `Icon` and `Badge` appear in the page's navigation, and while it is selected the section itself (header, `Description` and content) fills the page's content area. Set `IsDirty` while it has unsaved changes to show the page's save bar.
trans-unit.target: `SettingsPage` 的一個區段：其 `Header`、`Icon` 與 `Badge` 會顯示在頁面導覽中；選取時，區段本身（標題、`Description` 與內容）會佔滿頁面的內容區域。區段有未儲存的變更時，設定 `IsDirty` 即可顯示頁面的儲存列。

trans-unit.source: A short marker at the end of the navigation item, such as "New" or a count.
trans-unit.target: 導覽項目末端的簡短標記，例如「New」或數量。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the section title in the content area.
trans-unit.target: 內容區域中區段標題下方的一句說明。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon shown before the header in the navigation.
trans-unit.target: 導覽中標題前顯示的 24×24 線性圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the section has unsaved changes: the page shows its save bar while this section is selected.
trans-unit.target: 區段是否有未儲存的變更：選取此區段時，頁面會顯示其儲存列。

trans-unit.source: Arc shortcut recorder: a field that records a keyboard shortcut. Press it (Enter, Space or a click), then press the combination: held modifiers light up as key caps while the chord is built, the finished shortcut settles into place (caps pop in with a 35ms stagger), and a combination that is already taken (`Bindings`, or one the browser or system keeps such as ⌘W and ⌘C) asks before it is used. Escape cancels, Backspace / Delete clears, Tab stops recording and moves on, and the reset button restores `ResetValue`. Caps follow the platform: ⌘ ⇧ glyphs on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift names elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 快速鍵錄入框：記錄鍵盤快速鍵的欄位。按下它（Enter、Space 或按一下），再按下組合鍵：組合過程中，已按住的修飾鍵會以按鍵帽形式亮起；完成的快速鍵以 35ms 錯開的節奏彈出按鍵帽並定位。若組合鍵已被佔用（`Bindings` 中的，或瀏覽器、系統保留的如 ⌘W 與 ⌘C），使用前會先詢問。Escape 取消錄入，Backspace / Delete 清除，Tab 停止錄入並移到下一項，重設按鈕則還原 `ResetValue`。按鍵帽遵循平台慣例：Mac 上顯示 ⌘ ⇧ 符號，其他平台顯示 Ctrl+Shift 文字。

trans-unit.source: Shortcuts already in use.
trans-unit.target: 已被佔用的快速鍵。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that keeps the previous shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 保留原快速鍵的衝突操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field, shown while no other message is.
trans-unit.target: 欄位下方的輔助文字，在沒有其他提示資訊時顯示。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is only read by assistive technology (Arc: `hideLabel`).
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤不顯示，僅供輔助技術讀取（Arc 中為 `hideLabel`）。

trans-unit.source: Require ⌘, Ctrl or ⌥ / Alt; function keys are always allowed (Arc: `requireModifier`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 要求包含 ⌘、Ctrl 或 ⌥ / Alt；功能鍵始終允許（Arc 中為 `requireModifier`，預設開啟）。

trans-unit.source: True while the recorder listens for a combination.
trans-unit.target: 錄入器正在監聽組合鍵時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Also warn about combinations the browser or system keeps (Arc: `warnReserved`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 同時對瀏覽器或系統保留的組合鍵發出警告（Arc 中為 `warnReserved`，預設開啟）。

trans-unit.source: The field label (Arc: required); also the start of the recorder's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 欄位標籤（Arc 中必填）；同時作為錄入器無障礙名稱的開頭。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there is no shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 沒有快速鍵時顯示。

trans-unit.source: Key cap conventions; null detects the platform (Mac on macOS and iOS).
trans-unit.target: 按鍵帽顯示慣例；null 時自動偵測平台（macOS 與 iOS 為 Mac）。

trans-unit.source: The message under the field while recording.
trans-unit.target: 錄入過程中顯示在欄位下方的提示資訊。

trans-unit.source: Shown while recording, before a key is held.
trans-unit.target: 錄入中、尚未按下按鍵時顯示。

trans-unit.source: What the reset button restores (Arc: `resetValue`, defaulting to `defaultValue`).
trans-unit.target: 重設按鈕還原的值（Arc 中為 `resetValue`，預設為 `defaultValue`）。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that takes the shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 仍然使用該快速鍵的衝突操作。

trans-unit.source: The recorded shortcut (two-way); null means none.
trans-unit.target: 已錄入的快速鍵（雙向）；null 表示沒有。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Value` changes (recorded, cleared, reset, or set by code).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 變化時觸發（錄入、清除、重設或由程式碼設定）。

trans-unit.source: The app's main navigation (an original TKCode design): a header for a logo or a workspace switcher, an optional filter box, sections of pages with icons, counts and one level of nested pages, and a footer for the signed-in user. The selected page carries a muted block behind it and an accent-colored icon; the block glides between rows on a snappy spring. Parents open their pages with a height spring and a turning chevron. The sidebar collapses to a 64px icon rail on a width spring: labels and counts fade, counts become dots, every page gets a tooltip on the right and a parent shows its pages in a menu. Keyboard (WAI-ARIA tree model): the list is one tab stop; ↑ / ↓, Home / End move, → opens a parent or enters it, ← closes it or goes back to the parent, Enter / Space choose, typing jumps to a page by its first letters, and Cmd / Ctrl+B collapses or expands the sidebar while focus is inside it.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式的主導覽（TKCode 原創設計）：頂部區域放標誌或工作區切換器，接著是可選的篩選框、含圖示與計數並可支援一層巢狀頁面的頁面分區，以及顯示已登入使用者的底部區域。選取的頁面背後有一塊柔和色塊，圖示變為強調色，色塊會以輕快的彈簧動畫在各列之間滑動；父層頁面以高度彈簧動畫展開其子頁面，並附有旋轉的 V 形箭頭。側邊欄會以寬度彈簧動畫收合為 64px 的圖示窄欄：文字與計數淡出，計數變為圓點，每個頁面在右側顯示工具提示，父層頁面則以選單形式顯示其子頁面。鍵盤操作（WAI-ARIA 樹狀模型）：清單只佔一個 Tab 停駐點；↑ / ↓、Home / End 移動焦點，→ 展開父層或進入其中，← 收合或返回父層，Enter / Space 選擇，輸入字母可依頁面開頭字母跳轉，焦點位於側邊欄內時 Cmd / Ctrl+B 可收合或展開側邊欄。

trans-unit.source: Where the collapse button sits while the sidebar is open: in the header row (default) or beside the filter box. On the rail it always sits at the top.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄展開時收合按鈕的位置：頭部列（預設）或篩選框旁邊。在窄欄上它一律位於頂端。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is open.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄展開時，收合按鈕的無障礙名稱與工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is the rail.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄為窄欄時，收合按鈕的無障礙名稱與工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder and accessible name of the filter box.
trans-unit.target: 篩選框的預留文字與無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The filter text (two-way). Pages whose label contains it stay; a parent with a matching page opens.
trans-unit.target: 篩選文字（雙向）。標籤包含該文字的頁面會保留顯示；含有符合頁面的父層會展開。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom (the signed-in user, a storage meter), under a thin separator. It keeps its open-width layout on the rail, clipped to the rail; use the `:collapsed` pseudo-class to adapt it.
trans-unit.target: 底部內容（已登入的使用者、儲存空間用量條），位於一條細分隔線下。在窄欄上仍保持展開時的版面配置，並裁切至窄欄內；可使用 `:collapsed` 偽類進行調整。

trans-unit.source: Content at the top (a logo and title, a workspace switcher), beside the collapse button when that sits in the header row. It is hidden on the rail while the collapse button shows.
trans-unit.target: 頂部內容（標誌與標題、工作區切換器）；收合按鈕位於頭部列時，顯示在它旁邊。在窄欄上，收合按鈕顯示時此區域會隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows the collapse / expand button (PanelLeft icon). Its place is `CollapseButtonPlacement`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示收合或展開按鈕（PanelLeft 圖示）。它的位置由 `CollapseButtonPlacement` 決定。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sidebar is the 64px icon rail (two-way). The width springs between the two.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄是否為 64px 圖示窄欄（雙向）。寬度在兩種狀態之間以彈簧動畫變化。

trans-unit.source: Shows the filter box under the header (it becomes a search button on the rail).
trans-unit.target: 在頭部下方顯示篩選框（在窄欄上變為搜尋按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a page is chosen (click, Enter or Space, or a page in a rail menu), also when it already was the selected page.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時觸發（點擊、Enter 或 Space 鍵，或在窄欄選單中選擇頁面），即使該頁面已是目前選取的頁面也會觸發。

trans-unit.source: Name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 導覽地標的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Text shown when the filter matches no page.
trans-unit.target: 篩選沒有符合的頁面時顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: How the width change between the open sidebar and the rail reaches the page next to it: `Push` (default) or `Overlay`.
trans-unit.target: 展開與窄欄之間的寬度變化如何傳到旁邊的頁面：`Push`（預設）或 `Overlay`。

trans-unit.source: Runs when a page is chosen; the parameter is the `SidebarItem`.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時執行；參數為 `SidebarItem`。

trans-unit.source: The selected page (two-way). A parent cannot be selected: choosing it opens and closes its pages.
trans-unit.target: 被選取的頁面（雙向）。父項目不能被選取：選擇父項目會展開或收合其子頁面。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the selected page (two-way), kept in step with `SelectedItem`; bind it to your route.
trans-unit.target: 被選取頁面的 `Key`（雙向），與 `SelectedItem` 保持同步；可綁定到路由。

trans-unit.source: Added to the accessible name of a page that has `IsUnread` ("Inbox, unread").
trans-unit.target: 附加到帶有 `IsUnread` 的頁面的無障礙名稱中（“Inbox, unread”）。

trans-unit.source: One page of a `Sidebar`: a row with an icon, a label and an optional count. An item with `Items` is a parent: it opens and closes its child pages instead of being selected (one level of nesting).
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一個頁面：一列，包含圖示、文字和可選的計數。帶有 `Items` 的項目為父項目：它會展開或收合其子頁面，而不會被選取（僅支援一層巢狀）。

trans-unit.source: A short count at the end of the row (for example "12"); on the icon rail it becomes a dot on the icon. Null shows nothing.
trans-unit.target: 列尾的簡短計數（例如“12”）；在圖示窄欄上會變為圖示上的圓點。為 null 時不顯示任何內容。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the page is chosen (with `CommandParameter`).
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時執行（使用 `CommandParameter`）。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The 16px leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (for example an `ArcIcons` glyph) or any control.
trans-unit.target: 16px 的前置圖示：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry`（例如 `ArcIcons` 圖示），或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: Makes the row an action instead of a page: muted, never selected. Choosing it raises `ItemInvoked` and runs the commands, but `SelectedItem` stays (for example "New project", "More").
trans-unit.target: 讓該列成為動作而不是頁面：顏色柔和，永遠不會被選取。選取它會觸發 `ItemInvoked` 並執行命令，但 `SelectedItem` 保持不變（例如“New project”“More”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page can be chosen. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 頁面是否可以被選取。停用的列會變淡，並在方向鍵操作時被略過。

trans-unit.source: Whether the child pages of a parent are shown (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 父項目的子頁面是否顯示（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Marks the page as having something new: a small accent dot at the end of the row, a stronger label, and a dot on the icon on the rail.
trans-unit.target: 把頁面標記為有新內容：列尾顯示一個小的強調色圓點，名稱更醒目，在窄欄上圖示上會出現一個圓點。

trans-unit.source: A stable id for the page (a route or view name); `SelectedKey` selects by it.
trans-unit.target: 頁面的穩定識別碼（路由或檢視名稱）；`SelectedKey` 透過它進行選取。

trans-unit.source: The row text; also the tooltip on the icon rail and the text that typing and the filter match.
trans-unit.target: 列文字；同時作為圖示窄欄上的工具提示，並用於輸入搜尋和篩選時的比對。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the page is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時取回的任意值。

trans-unit.source: An icon after the label, in the label's muted color (for example a chevron on a "More" row): a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` or any control.
trans-unit.target: 名稱之後的圖示，顏色與名稱的柔和色相同（例如“More”列上的箭頭）：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry` 或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: One group of pages in a `Sidebar`: an optional small heading over its `Items`. A collapsible section folds its pages away under the heading; on the icon rail sections are separated by a thin line instead.
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一組頁面：`Items` 上方可選的小標題。可收合群組會在標題下收合其頁面；在圖示窄欄上，群組之間改以細線分隔。

trans-unit.source: The small heading over the pages; null shows no heading (for example the first group: Home, Inbox).
trans-unit.target: 頁面上方的小標題；為 null 時不顯示標題（例如第一個群組：Home、Inbox）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the heading is a button that folds the pages away (it shows a small chevron). Needs a `Header`.
trans-unit.target: 標題是否為用於收合頁面的按鈕（會顯示一個小箭頭）。需要設定 `Header`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pages of a collapsible section are shown (two-way). Ignored when the section is not collapsible.
trans-unit.target: 可收合群組的頁面是否顯示（雙向）。群組不可收合時會被忽略。

trans-unit.source: Arc's signature field with real ink: width follows pen pressure, or speed for a mouse or finger, and the ends taper like a nib lifting off. It keeps undo and redo, clears with a wipe across the pad, replays the signature in its original rhythm, and exports a cropped PNG or SVG. A "Sign here" hint rests on the baseline until the first stroke.
trans-unit.target: Arc 簽名板，帶有真實墨跡：線寬隨筆壓變化；使用滑鼠或手指時則隨速度變化，筆畫兩端像筆尖離紙一樣逐漸收細。支援復原與重做，以一次擦拭橫越整個畫板即可清除，並能依原有節奏重播簽名，還可匯出裁切後的 PNG 或 SVG。在第一筆落下之前，基線上會保留一個「在此簽名」提示。

trans-unit.source: True when an undone change can be redone.
trans-unit.target: 存在可重做的已復原變更時為 true。

trans-unit.source: True when a change can be undone (the last 60 are kept).
trans-unit.target: 存在可復原的變更時為 true（保留最近 60 次）。

trans-unit.source: File name for exports, without extension (default "signature").
trans-unit.target: 匯出檔案的檔名，不含副檔名（預設為 "signature"）。

trans-unit.source: The resting hint on the baseline before the first stroke (default "Sign here").
trans-unit.target: 第一筆落下之前，基線上的靜置提示（預設為「在此簽名」）。

trans-unit.source: The ink for new strokes (default black). Each stroke keeps the ink it was drawn with.
trans-unit.target: 新筆畫使用的墨色（預設為黑色）。每一筆保留繪製時所用的墨色。

trans-unit.source: Reserves space while content is still loading (Arc Skeleton): an optional round avatar and 1–6 text lines that pulse top to bottom in a calm, finite wave. With `Content` it crossfades into the content when `IsLoading` turns false (the content rises 4px into place) while the height springs from the placeholder to the content. Without content the placeholder always shows.
trans-unit.target: 在內容仍在載入時預留空間（Arc 骨架屏）：可選的圓形頭像與 1–6 行文字佔位，以平穩有限的波浪由上而下脈動。設定 `Content` 後，當 `IsLoading` 變為 false 時，內容會淡入取代佔位（內容上移 4px 就位），同時高度以彈簧由佔位過渡到內容的高度。沒有內容時始終顯示佔位。

trans-unit.source: Adds a round avatar placeholder before the lines.
trans-unit.target: 在文字行之前加入一個圓形頭像佔位。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the placeholder visible while true; only used when `Content` is set.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時保持佔位可見；僅在設定了 `Content` 時生效。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the placeholder (Arc `label`, "Loading content").
trans-unit.target: 佔位的無障礙名稱（Arc 中為 `label`，即「正在載入內容」）。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder text lines (Arc clamps to 1–6). Defaults to 3.
trans-unit.target: 佔位文字行數（Arc 會限制在 1–6 之間）。預設為 3。

trans-unit.source: Arc slider: a value or a range on a track. The thumb follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands up to 9px past its limits and settles on the step grid with the velocity of the release (on a coarse grid the release may carry it one step further); pressing the track springs the nearest thumb there. A bubble with rolling digits rides the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard focused and lingers 700ms after a release. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit makes the thumb strain toward the press and spring home. Unlike `Slider`, `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to. Set `IsRange` for two thumbs (`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 滑桿：在軌道上選擇一個值或一個範圍。滑塊跟隨指標 1:1 移動，超出限制時會有 9px 的回彈，並以放開時的速度落到步進網格上（在粗網格上，放開時可能再多移動一步）；按下軌道會使最近的滑塊彈到該處。拖曳或鍵盤聚焦時，一個帶滾動數字的氣泡會跟隨滑塊，放開後再保留 700ms。方向鍵、Shift+方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的行為與原生範圍輸入一致；在極限處按鍵時，滑塊會朝按壓方向拉伸，然後彈回原位。與 `Slider` 不同，`SmallChange` 是數值吸附的步長。設定 `IsRange` 可使用兩個滑塊（`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Content after the track, such as an icon or a button.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之後的內容，例如圖示或按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Two thumbs: `LowerValue` and `UpperValue` instead of `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 兩個滑塊：使用 `LowerValue` 與 `UpperValue`，而不是 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value beside the label. The bubble still appears while dragging or keyboard focused.

trans-unit.source: Visible label; also names the thumb (or, with " minimum" / " maximum", the range thumbs).

trans-unit.source: A mark on a `Slider` or `ElasticSlider` track. A mark without a label draws a tick; a mark with a label also prints it under the track, and clicking the label moves there. On an elastic slider marks are detents the dragged thumb clicks into.
trans-unit.target: `Slider` 或 `ElasticSlider` 軌道上的刻度。沒有標籤的刻度只畫出一個短線；帶標籤的刻度還會將標籤印在軌道下方，點按標籤即可移到該處。在彈性滑桿上，刻度是被拖曳的滑塊會「喀嗒」卡入的檔位。

trans-unit.source: A before / after comparison on two shared axes (Arc "Slope chart"). Lines draw in from the first column to the second on first view; labels push apart instead of overlapping and connect back to their dots with thin leaders; rank movement sits beside each end value. A new dataset slides every line, dot and label to its new place on the shared morph spring. Hover or the arrow keys (in end-value order) bring one line forward and show a tooltip.
trans-unit.target: 在兩個共享座標軸上進行的前後比較（Arc「斜率圖」）。首次顯示時，線條由第一欄向第二欄逐漸畫出；標籤會互相推開而不是重疊，並以細引線連回各自的圓點；每個端點數值旁邊顯示排名變化。新資料集會以共享的變形彈簧，將每條線、每個圓點和每個標籤滑動到新位置。懸停或使用方向鍵（依終點數值順序）可將某條線置於前方並顯示提示。
