trans-unit.source: Arc's sortable data table: compare structured records with sortable columns. Click a header (or press Enter / Space on it) to sort ascending, again for descending; rows slide to their new places on a smooth spring and the sort arrow flips on a snappy one. `IsSelectable` adds a checkbox column, row-click selection, Shift range selection, Escape to clear and a count line with Clear selection. Rows are drawn as light text cells, virtualized for thousands of records, sorted by index (never by container), and the header sticks to the top of the visible area. Below 620px rows fold into two lines and the header becomes a strip of sort pills, as in Arc.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可排序資料表格：以可排序的欄位比較結構化記錄。點按表頭（或在表頭上按 Enter / Space）升冪排列，再點一次降冪；列以平滑的彈簧滑動到新位置，排序箭頭以更靈敏的彈簧翻轉。`IsSelectable` 會加入核取方塊欄、點按列選取、Shift 範圍選取、Escape 清除選取，以及帶「清除選取」的計數列。列以輕量文字儲存格繪製，對數千筆記錄進行虛擬化，依索引（而非容器）排序，表頭會黏附在可見區域頂端。寬度低於 620px 時，列會摺疊為兩行，表頭則變為排序膠囊條，與 Arc 一致。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sparkline: a compact trend beside a value, for cards, table rows and KPI blocks. Scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys: the cursor springs between points, the stretch after it dims as if it has not happened yet, and the headline and aside roll to the scrubbed point. The line draws once like a pen the first time it is half visible; the fill follows the tip, then the end dot lands. New data morphs the line from the shape on screen. Motion is code-driven because the pen tip, cursor and morph are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 迷你趨勢圖：緊接數值旁的精簡趨勢圖，適用於卡片、表格列與 KPI 區塊。可用指標或方向鍵拖曳瀏覽：游標在各資料點之間彈動，其後的區段會變暗，彷彿尚未發生；標題與附註會滾動到所瀏覽的資料點。首次半數可見時，折線會像畫筆一樣繪製一次；填滿區隨筆尖跟進，然後末端圓點落定。新資料會從畫面上的形狀變形為新折線。由於筆尖、游標與變形都是自繪繪圖區內的座標，因此動態效果由程式碼驅動。

trans-unit.target: 靜止時顯示的附註，如「+4.1%」，顏色為語氣色。

trans-unit.target: 折線下方一層淡淡的語氣色底紋。

trans-unit.source: Color of the line, its fill and the change.
trans-unit.target: 折線、其填滿區與變化值的顏色。

trans-unit.target: 靜止時的標題，如「$48.2K」。設為 null 時，則在標籤旁顯示被瀏覽的數值。

trans-unit.source: One default action joined to a chevron menu of nearby alternatives (Arc split button): Merge pull request with Squash and merge or Rebase and merge, an export with its usual format, Copy page that answers Copied in place. The whole pill presses in for the main action; the chevron half anchors the menu, so it answers in color only and turns while the menu is open. The main label morphs letter by letter (shared runs glide, changed letters rise out of a soft blur), a new `Icon` grows in while the old one shrinks away, and the main half springs to the new width. Menu rows are `MenuEntry` items declared inline or supplied with `ItemsSource`; the menu opens 4px below the chevron, aligned to the end. Keyboard: Enter or Space runs the main action on the main half and opens the menu on the first row from the chevron (ArrowDown too); arrow keys move through the rows and loop, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the chevron. Label changes are announced politely.
trans-unit.target: 將一個預設動作與一個相近替代項的下拉選單（Arc 分割按鈕）合併：例如「合併拉取要求」帶有「Squash 並合併」或「Rebase 並合併」，匯出操作帶有其常用格式，「複製頁面」操作則會就地顯示「已複製」。主操作時整個膠囊形按鈕會按下；下拉箭頭部分用於錨定選單，因此僅以顏色作出回應，並在選單開啟時旋轉。主標籤逐字母變形（相同的部分平滑滑動，變化的字母從柔和的模糊中升起），新的 `Icon` 會淡入而舊圖示縮小消失，主區域則以彈簧過渡到新寬度。選單行為內嵌宣告的 `MenuEntry` 項目，或由 `ItemsSource` 提供；選單在箭頭下方 4px 處開啟，並靠末端對齊。鍵盤：Enter 或 Space 在主區域執行主操作，從箭頭處開啟選單並定位到第一行（ArrowDown 同樣可以）；方向鍵在各行之間移動並循環，Escape 關閉選單並將焦點返回箭頭。標籤變化時以禮貌方式朗讀。

trans-unit.target: 視覺權重：Primary（預設，實心按鈕）或 Secondary（緊湊的描邊膠囊）。

trans-unit.source: Shows where someone is in a strict multi-step flow and which steps are done (Arc Stepper). Drive it with `CurrentIndex` (the step count marks the whole flow complete). When progress jumps across several steps the connectors fill one after another (80ms apart) from the previous current step, then the halo grows around the new current step; numbers turn into drawn checks or alerts. With `IsNavigable` completed steps can be chosen by click or keyboard (arrows between reachable steps, Home / End, Enter / Space). Horizontal steppers narrower than 30rem fold into markers with the current step named underneath. Steps come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Steps`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示使用者在嚴格的多步驟流程中所處的位置，以及哪些步驟已完成（Arc 步驟條）。使用 `CurrentIndex` 驅動（步驟數表示整個流程已完成）。當進度跨越多個步驟時，連接線會從上一個當前步驟起逐一填滿（每隔 80ms），然後光暈在新的當前步驟周圍擴散；數字則變為繪製出的勾號或警示圖示。設定 `IsNavigable` 後，已完成的步驟可透過按一下或鍵盤選取（方向鍵在可到達的步驟之間移動，Home / End，Enter / Space）。寬度小於 30rem 的水平步驟條會摺疊為標記，並在下方標明當前步驟名稱。步驟來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `Steps`。

trans-unit.source: Announced, and shown in the compact caption, once every step is complete.
trans-unit.target: 所有步驟完成後朗讀，並在精簡的說明文字中顯示。

trans-unit.source: Index of the step in progress; the step count marks every step complete.
trans-unit.target: 進行中步驟的索引；步驟數表示所有步驟均已完成。

trans-unit.source: Which descriptions show (Arc `details`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示哪些描述（Arc 中為 `details`）。

trans-unit.source: Markers only; labels stay available to assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 僅顯示標記；標籤仍可供輔助技術讀取。

trans-unit.source: True when every step is complete.
trans-unit.target: 所有步驟都已完成時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Lets people return to completed steps (Arc `onStepSelect`); otherwise the stepper is read-only.
trans-unit.target: 允許使用者返回已完成的步驟（Arc `onStepSelect`）；否則步驟條為唯讀。

trans-unit.source: Bound steps (`StepperStep` or any object, shown by its text); takes precedence over `Steps`.
trans-unit.target: 繫結的步驟（`StepperStep` 或任意物件，以其文字顯示）；優先於 `Steps`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name (Arc `label`, "Progress").
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱（Arc `label`，“Progress”）。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal (default) or vertical.
trans-unit.target: 水平（預設）或垂直。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a completed step is chosen by click or keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 使用者以按一下或鍵盤選取已完成的步驟時引發。

trans-unit.source: One step of a `Stepper` (Arc `steps[]` entry).
trans-unit.target: `Stepper` 的一個步驟（Arc `steps[]` 項目）。

trans-unit.source: A short hint under the label.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的簡短提示。

trans-unit.source: Marks the step as failed: the marker becomes an alert and this message replaces the description.
trans-unit.target: 將該步驟標記為失敗：標記變為警示圖示，此訊息取代描述。

trans-unit.source: Stable key, so each step keeps its own motion when the list changes.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的鍵，使清單變化時每個步驟保留自己的動畫。

trans-unit.source: Step name, shown beside its marker.
trans-unit.target: 步驟名稱，顯示在其標記旁。

trans-unit.source: Arc's streamgraph: layers stacked on a wiggle baseline, flowing over time. Hovering a layer isolates it and reads every layer at that moment; switching ranges blends every layer from the shape on screen on a shared 161-point grid, a hidden layer thins to nothing while the others close over it, and the first time the chart is seen the whole stream swells out of a hairline along its center. Motion is code-driven (a per-sample spring array and `MotionValue`) because every layer edge is recomputed from the stack each frame inside one self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的串流圖：各圖層堆疊在擺動基線上，隨時間流動。懸停某一圖層會將其單獨突出，並讀取該時刻每個圖層的數值；切換範圍時，所有圖層會從螢幕上的形狀出發，在共用的 161 點網格上過渡融合，隱藏的圖層會收縮至消失，其餘圖層隨之閉合；圖表首次出現時，整個串流從中線處的細線舒展開。動畫由程式碼驅動（每個取樣點的彈簧陣列加 `MotionValue`），因為每個圖層邊緣都要在單一自繪繪圖區內逐格根據堆疊結果重新計算。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the series hidden from the plot; the legend toggles them (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 從圖中隱藏的系列鍵；圖例會切換它們（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series.
trans-unit.target: 圖例顯示或隱藏某個系列時引發。

trans-unit.source: How the layers stack.
trans-unit.target: 圖層的堆疊方式。

trans-unit.source: Names each layer inside its widest stretch when it is thick enough to hold the text.
trans-unit.target: 當圖層夠厚、能容納文字時，在其最寬處直接標示圖層名稱。

trans-unit.source: Layer toggles above the plot (shown by default when there is more than one layer).
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區上方的圖層開關（存在多個圖層時預設顯示）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the category (time) axis labels under the plot.
trans-unit.target: 在圖表下方顯示類別（時間）軸標籤。

trans-unit.source: One action of a `SwipeActionsRow`: revealed under the row's edge by a swipe (icon over label), committed by a full swipe on the outermost action, a tap on the revealed action, or the row's More actions menu. An action that removes its item (the default) runs once the row has slid away and collapsed, so the handler can remove the item without a jump; set `KeepsRow` for actions such as Mark as unread, which run at once while the row springs home.
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActionsRow` 的一個動作：以水平滑動顯示在列的邊緣下方（圖示在上、文字在下），完整滑動最外側的動作、輕觸已顯示的動作，或列的「更多動作」選單即可執行。會移除其項目的動作（預設）會在列滑開並收合後執行，因此處理程式可以移除項目而不跳動；對於「標示為未讀」等動作，請設定 `KeepsRow`，這類動作會立即執行，而列則以彈簧彈回原位。

trans-unit.source: Runs after `Invoked`; its parameter defaults to the row's data item.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Invoked` 之後執行；其參數預設為該列的資料項目。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to Command; when null the row's data item is used.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 Command 的參數；為 null 時使用該列的資料項。

trans-unit.source: 24×24 Lucide geometry drawn at 20px (Arc: required), for example `ArcIcons.Archive`.
trans-unit.target: 以 20px 繪製的 24×24 Lucide 圖形（Arc：必填），例如 `ArcIcons.Archive`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the action runs (full swipe, tap on the revealed action, or the menu).
trans-unit.target: 動作執行時引發（完整滑動、輕觸已顯示的動作或選單）。

trans-unit.source: The row springs home after the action instead of sliding away and collapsing.
trans-unit.target: 動作之後該列以彈簧彈回原位，而不是滑開並收合。

trans-unit.source: Shown under the icon and in the menu (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在圖示下方以及選單中（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Fill of the revealed action: Neutral (default), Accent or Danger.
trans-unit.target: 露出操作的填色：Neutral（預設）、Accent 或 Danger。

trans-unit.source: A list whose rows reveal actions on a horizontal swipe, the way a mail inbox does (Arc swipe actions): short, touch-first triage lists such as mail, notifications or tasks. Rows are `SwipeActionsRow`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (with `LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` shared by every row that declares none, and `RowLabelBinding` naming each row). Only one row stays open at a time; pressing anywhere else or Escape puts it away. Every row also has a More actions menu with the same actions, so keyboard and screen reader users never need the gesture. Remove the item in `ActionInvoked` (or the action's own handler or command): removing actions run once their row has slid away and collapsed. The surface fades with the last row and hides when the list is empty. Rows are not virtualized; paginate long lists.
trans-unit.target: 一個清單，其列可以像郵件收件匣一樣透過水平滑動顯示動作（Arc 滑動動作）：適用於以觸控為先的簡短分類清單，如郵件、通知或任務。列為 `SwipeActionsRow`，可以內嵌宣告，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` 由未宣告自身動作的所有列共用，`RowLabelBinding` 用於為每列命名）。同一時間只有一列保持展開；按下其他任何位置或按 Escape 即可將其收起。每列還提供「更多動作」選單，包含相同的動作，因此鍵盤和螢幕閱讀器使用者無需使用手勢。請在 `ActionInvoked`（或動作自身的處理程式或命令）中移除項目：會移除項目的動作會在該列滑開並收合後執行。表面隨最後一列淡出，清單為空時隱藏。列不做虛擬化；長清單請分頁。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling from the row) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 動作執行後從列引發（並冒泡至清單）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action of rows that do not decide for themselves (default true).
trans-unit.target: 允許長距離滑動為不自行決定的列提交最外側的動作（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list (Arc: required), such as "Inbox".
trans-unit.target: 清單的無障礙名稱（Arc：必填），例如 “Inbox”。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of each row's More actions button; {0} is the row's label.
trans-unit.target: 每列「更多動作」按鈕的無障礙名稱；{0} 為該列的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Binding that names generated rows (their `Label`), such as the message subject.
trans-unit.target: 為產生的列命名（其 `Label`）的繫結，例如郵件主旨。

trans-unit.source: One row of `SwipeActions` (Arc SwipeActionsRow): its content follows a horizontal swipe to reveal `LeadingActions` under the left edge and `TrailingActions` under the right. Past the last stop the row still follows with rubber-band resistance; a full swipe commits the outermost action (the action stretches across the row, the row slides away and collapses), and a release settles open or closed on a spring that carries the release velocity. Vertical drags pass through to the page. Every row also has a More actions button with the same actions in a menu, so the gesture is never required: Enter or Space opens it on the first row, arrows move, Escape closes the menu or puts an open row away. Pressing outside an open row closes it, and only one row of a list is open at a time. Use it on its own or inside a `SwipeActions` list (whose actions it uses when it declares none of its own).
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActions` 的一列（Arc SwipeActionsRow）：其內容隨水平滑動移動，以顯示左邊緣下方的 `LeadingActions` 和右邊緣下方的 `TrailingActions`。超過最後一個停駐點後，列仍會以橡皮筋阻力跟隨；完整滑動會提交最外側的動作（該動作橫跨整列，列滑開並收合）；鬆手後，列會以帶有釋放速度的彈簧停駐在展開或收合位置。垂直拖曳會傳遞給頁面。每列還提供「更多動作」按鈕，選單中包含相同的動作，因此手勢並非必需：Enter 或空白鍵在第一列上開啟選單，方向鍵移動，Escape 關閉選單或收起已展開的列。在已展開的列外按下即可將其關閉，清單中同一時間只有一列展開。可單獨使用，也可置於 `SwipeActions` 清單中（未宣告自身動作時使用清單的動作）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the row (and bubbled to its list) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 動作執行後在該列引發（並冒泡至其清單）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action without a tap; null follows the list (default on).
trans-unit.target: 允許長距離滑動無需輕觸即可提交最外側的動作；null 則跟隨清單（預設開啟）。

trans-unit.source: Names the row in its More actions button, for example the message subject (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 在其「更多動作」按鈕中為該列命名，例如郵件主旨（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: The side resting open (or heading there), or `None`.
trans-unit.target: 保持展開（或正在展開）的一側，或 `None`。

trans-unit.source: Left inset of the hairline separator under the row (Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`, default 16).
trans-unit.target: 列下方細分隔線的左側縮排（Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`，預設 16）。

trans-unit.source: Arc switch: a tactile toggle for settings that take effect immediately. While pressed the thumb widens toward the other side (far edge anchored); on release it glides on a critically damped spring. Toggles that did not come from a press (keyboard, code) play a brief stretch instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 開關：用於即時生效設定的觸感切換。按下時，滑塊會向另一側拉寬（遠端固定）；鬆開後，它以臨界阻尼彈簧滑動。非按下觸發的切換（鍵盤、程式碼）則改為短暫拉伸。

trans-unit.source: Arc tabs: switch between related views of the same object. A single selection pill glides between the triggers on a morph spring, the incoming panel slides 8px in from the side of travel while the outgoing one is pinned in place and fades, and the panel area springs from the old panel height to the new one so the content below glides. Long tab lists scroll horizontally with soft edges and edge scroll buttons, and the selected or focused tab is always scrolled into view. Items are `TabItem` containers written inline (`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource`: `ItemTemplate` renders the trigger and `ContentTemplate` the panel.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分頁：在同一物件的相關檢視之間切換。單一選取的膠囊形指示器在觸發器之間沿彈簧曲線滑動，進入的面板從移動方向的一側滑入 8px，而離開的面板固定在原處並淡出；面板區域從舊面板高度以彈簧過渡到新高度，使下方內容平滑滑動。分頁較多時，分頁列可水平捲動，帶柔和邊緣和邊緣捲動按鈕，且選取或聚焦的分頁始終捲動到可見範圍內。項目可以內嵌寫為 `TabItem` 容器（`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`），也可由 `ItemsSource` 產生：`ItemTemplate` 渲染觸發器，`ContentTemplate` 渲染面板。

trans-unit.source: Whether arrow keys select the tab they move to (`Automatic`, Arc default).
trans-unit.target: 方向鍵是否同時選取移動到的分頁（`Automatic`，Arc 預設）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the panel of data items (the trigger uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項目面板的範本（觸發器使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the left scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 左側捲動按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the right scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 右側捲動按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The panel content of the selected tab.
trans-unit.target: 選取分頁的面板內容。

trans-unit.source: The template of the selected tab's panel.
trans-unit.target: 選取分頁面板的範本。

trans-unit.source: Arc tag input: turns short typed values into removable tags. Enter or a comma adds the trimmed draft (a duplicate, compared case-insensitively, pulses the tag that exists instead); Backspace at the start of the field picks the last tag and the next Backspace removes it; the arrow keys move the pick and a ring glides to it; leaving the field commits the draft. New tags blur in where they were typed, removed tags leave their slot and the rest glide in, and the shell follows wrapped rows on a spring; the field never scrolls sideways.
trans-unit.target: Arc 標籤輸入框：將簡短輸入的值轉換為可移除的標籤。按 Enter 或逗號可新增去除前後空白後的草稿（重複的標籤（不區分大小寫比較）會改為使既有的那個標籤閃動）；插入點位於欄位開頭時按 Backspace 選取最後一個標籤，再按一次 Backspace 將其移除；方向鍵移動選取項，光圈會滑動到該處；離開欄位時提交草稿。新標籤在輸入位置淡入，被移除的標籤離開原位，其餘標籤滑動補位；外殼隨換行的列以彈簧跟隨調整，欄位本身從不橫向捲動。

trans-unit.source: Announced after an add; `{0}` is the tag (or the tags, comma separated, after a paste).
trans-unit.target: 新增後播報；`{0}` 為標籤（貼上後則為以逗號分隔的多個標籤）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field; it describes the editor for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 欄位下方的輔助文字；為輔助技術描述編輯器。

trans-unit.source: Announced when the draft repeats a tag; `{0}` is the existing tag.
trans-unit.target: 草稿與既有標籤重複時播報；`{0}` 為既有的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the field; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 欄位下方的錯誤提示；非空時欄位為無效狀態。

trans-unit.source: Invalid state (danger border). Always true while `ErrorMessage` is not empty.
trans-unit.target: 無效狀態（危險色邊框）。`ErrorMessage` 不為空時一律為 true。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden visually but still names the editor.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤在視覺上隱藏，但仍為編輯器命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label (Arc: required). Also the accessible name of the editor.
trans-unit.target: 可見標籤（Arc：必填），同時也是編輯器的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Announced when `MaxTags` refuses an add; `{0}` is the limit.
trans-unit.target: `MaxTags` 拒絕新增時播報；`{0}` 為上限。

trans-unit.source: The most tags a user can add (extension; null = unlimited, as Arc). Negative values read as 0.
trans-unit.target: 使用者可新增的最多標籤數（擴充；null 表示無限制，與 Arc 一致）。負值按 0 處理。

trans-unit.source: Announced when a tag is picked; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 選取某個標籤時播報；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there are no tags and no draft (Arc default "Add a tag").
trans-unit.target: 沒有標籤且沒有草稿時顯示（Arc 預設文字為「新增標籤」）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of a tag's remove button; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 標籤移除按鈕的無障礙名稱；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: Announced after a removal; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 移除後播報；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: The tags (two-way). Never null: setting null reads back as an empty list.
trans-unit.target: 標籤（雙向繫結）。永不為 null：設定為 null 時讀回為空清單。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling) whenever `Value` changes, by the user or in code.
trans-unit.target: `Value` 變更時引發（冒泡），無論由使用者還是程式碼引起。

trans-unit.source: Morphs one short label into the next in place (P4): letters both strings share glide to their new positions, new letters sharpen in with a short stagger, removed letters blur away, and the width follows on a spring. Single line; assistive technology reads the plain text. Rendered directly: no control per letter.
trans-unit.target: 將一個短標籤原地變形為下一個標籤（P4）：兩個字串共有的字母滑動到新位置，新字母以短暫錯開的節奏清晰浮現，被移除的字母模糊消失，寬度隨彈簧調整。單行；輔助技術讀取純文字。直接渲染：不為每個字母建立控制項。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字型系列（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font size of the text in device-independent pixels (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字級，單位為與裝置無關的像素（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font weight of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字重（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Brush that paints the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 繪製文字的筆刷（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: How letters pair between the old and the new text: Occurrence (default) or PrefixSuffix.
trans-unit.target: 新舊文字之間字母的配對方式：Occurrence（預設）或 PrefixSuffix。

trans-unit.source: The label to show; a change morphs the letters from the old text to the new one.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的標籤；變更時字母會從舊文字變形為新文字。

trans-unit.source: A headline that reveals itself once as it appears (Arc TextReveal): each word rises out of its own feathered clip while it sharpens from a soft blur and fades in, word after word (P20, P29). A title that mounts on screen starts with the first frame like Arc; one that mounts below the fold waits until it enters the viewport (S6, once). Whenever the animation cannot run (motion off, detached), the text shows at rest. Use `\n` for a deliberate line break; lines are at most `MaxWidthInChars` wide and balanced. Drawn as one control: no per-word controls.
trans-unit.target: 標題在出現時只播放一次的顯現動畫（Arc TextReveal）：每個詞從各自帶羽化邊緣的裁剪區中升起，同時由柔和模糊逐漸清晰並淡入，逐詞依序進行（P20、P29）。掛載於螢幕上的標題從第一格開始，與 Arc 一致；掛載於視口之下的標題會等到進入視口後才播放（S6，僅一次）。無法播放動畫時（動畫關閉、已分離）文字直接以靜止狀態顯示。使用 `\n` 來刻意換行；每行最多為 `MaxWidthInChars` 寬，且行寬均衡。作為一個控制項繪製：沒有逐詞控制項。

trans-unit.source: Starting blur of each word (BlurText for headings, BlurSoft for paragraphs).
trans-unit.target: 每個詞的初始模糊半徑（標題使用 BlurText，段落使用 BlurSoft）。

trans-unit.source: Wait before the first word rises.
trans-unit.target: 第一個詞升起前的等待時間。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字型系列（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font size of the text in device-independent pixels (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字級，單位為與裝置無關的像素（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Font weight of the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 文字的字重（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Brush that paints the text (from TextElement).
trans-unit.target: 繪製文字的筆刷（繼承自 TextElement）。

trans-unit.source: Line height as a multiple of the font size.
trans-unit.target: 行高，以字級的倍數表示。

trans-unit.source: Heading level (Arc `as`, default h2); a paragraph uses body type and a softer blur.
trans-unit.target: 標題層級（Arc `as`，預設 h2）；段落使用內文字型並採用較柔和的模糊。

trans-unit.source: Line length limit in "0" glyph widths (Arc: 24ch). 0 disables the limit.
trans-unit.target: 以 “0” 字形寬度計算的行長上限（Arc：24ch）。0 表示不限制。

trans-unit.source: The headline; use `\n` for a deliberate line break.
trans-unit.target: 標題文字；使用 `\n` 進行刻意換行。

trans-unit.source: Letter spacing in em (display tracking for headings).
trans-unit.target: 字距，以 em 為單位（標題的展示字距）。

trans-unit.source: A calm light sweeping across a short status line (Arc TextShimmer), such as "Thinking" or "Generating summary": a bell-shaped band of the text color crosses a muted base, then pauses briefly before the next pass (P21). The sweep runs only while `IsActive`, within 64px of the viewport and visible, and resumes where it stopped. Turning `IsActive` off lets a band in flight glide off while the text settles to solid. A new label rises in place from a soft blur while the line springs to its width (P2, P5). Drawn as one control: the band is the text drawn again through a sliding opacity mask, so a frame allocates nothing.
trans-unit.target: 一道平靜的光帶掃過簡短的狀態列（Arc TextShimmer），例如 “Thinking” 或 “Generating summary”：一條鐘形的文字顏色光帶穿過靜止的底色，然後在下一輪開始前短暫停頓（P21）。掃光僅在 `IsActive` 為 true、距視口 64px 以內且可見時執行，並從停止處繼續。關閉 `IsActive` 時，進行中的光帶會滑出，文字則平穩過渡為實色。新標籤從柔和的模糊中原地升起，同時該列以彈簧調整至其寬度（P2、P5）。作為一個控制項繪製：光帶是透過滑動不透明度遮罩再次繪製的文字，因此每格不配置任何記憶體。

trans-unit.source: Resting base color; when unset it is 12% of the text color mixed into muted text.
trans-unit.target: 靜止的底色；未設定時為文字顏色的 12%，與次要文字顏色混合。

trans-unit.source: Font family of the text; inherited from TextElement unless set.
trans-unit.target: 文字的字型系列；除非設定，否則繼承自 TextElement。

trans-unit.source: Font size in device-independent pixels; inherited from TextElement unless set.
trans-unit.target: 與裝置無關像素單位的字級；除非設定，否則繼承自 TextElement。

trans-unit.source: Font weight of the text; inherited from TextElement unless set.
trans-unit.target: 文字的字重；除非設定，否則繼承自 TextElement。

trans-unit.source: Text color; the resting base color is derived from it unless BaseForeground is set.
trans-unit.target: 文字顏色；除非設定了 BaseForeground，否則靜止時的基礎色由它推導而來。

trans-unit.source: Sweeps while work is ongoing (Arc `active`, true).
trans-unit.target: 工作進行時掃光（Arc `active`，true）。

trans-unit.source: One pass across the text (Arc `duration`, 1.8s).
trans-unit.target: 掃過文字一次的時長（Arc `duration`，1.8s）。

trans-unit.source: The status text; keep it to one short line. A new value rises in place.
trans-unit.target: 狀態文字；保持為一行簡短文字。新值會原地升起。

trans-unit.source: Arc textarea: a labeled multiline field (Enter adds a line) with the same helper / error rows as `Input`; a live count in the description ("120 characters") rolls only the digits that change. It fills its column with a 110px minimum height and, like Arc's `resize: vertical`, can be made taller by dragging the corner grip (`IsResizable`). Focus draws Arc's 3px focus ring around the border. Arc's textarea does not grow with its content, so neither does this one; it scrolls instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 多行文字方塊：帶標籤的多行欄位（Enter 新增換行），其輔助文字列和錯誤列與 `Input` 相同；描述中的即時計數（如 “120 characters”）只捲動變化的數字。它以 110px 的最小高度填滿所在欄，並且與 Arc 的 `resize: vertical` 一樣，可透過拖曳右下角把手（`IsResizable`）加高。聚焦時在邊框周圍繪製 Arc 的 3px 焦點環。與 Arc 的多行文字方塊一樣，此控制項不隨內容增長，而是改為捲動。

trans-unit.source: Height chosen with the grip, in px; NaN follows the minimum height.
trans-unit.target: 透過把手選定的高度（單位 px）；NaN 表示遵循最小高度。

trans-unit.source: Shows the corner grip that drags the field taller (Arc: `resize: vertical`). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示可拖曳欄位加高的右下角把手（Arc：`resize: vertical`）。預設為 true。

trans-unit.source: A single light / dark switch for a header: a secondary button that swaps sun and moon on a shared turn and names the next appearance. Pressing it raises `ThemeChangeRequested`; unless a handler marks it handled, the switcher applies the change through AtomUI's theme manager (toggling `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` and keeping the rest of the current theme) inside the page transition of its `Variant`. Arc hands that transition to the View Transitions API; here the old window is snapshotted into an overlay whose animated clip reveals the new theme beneath (`RunTransitionAsync`, also usable from a handler). Reduced motion switches without a transition.
trans-unit.target: 用於頁首的單一明暗切換：一個次要按鈕，在共用的轉動動畫中切換太陽與月亮圖示，並標示下一種外觀。按下時引發 `ThemeChangeRequested`；除非處理程式將其標記為已處理，否則切換器會透過 AtomUI 的主題管理器套用變更（切換 `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` 並保留目前主題的其他設定），並在其 `Variant` 的頁面過渡中進行。Arc 將該過渡交給 View Transitions API；此處則將舊視窗擷取為覆蓋層，由其動畫裁剪區在下方顯示新主題（`RunTransitionAsync`，也可在處理程式中使用）。減少動態效果時直接切換，不做過渡。

trans-unit.source: The appearance shown; null follows the control's actual theme variant (default).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的外觀；null 則跟隨控制項實際的主題變體（預設）。

trans-unit.source: Shows only the icon in a 38×38 square.
trans-unit.target: 僅在 38×38 的方塊中顯示圖示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name; null says "Switch to dark mode" or "Switch to light mode".
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱；null 時為「切換到深色模式」或「切換到淺色模式」。

trans-unit.source: The visible text beside the icon (default "Switch theme").
trans-unit.target: 圖示旁可見的文字（預設為「切換主題」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the theme changes. Set `Handled` to apply the theme yourself (optionally inside `RunTransitionAsync`); otherwise the switcher applies it through AtomUI's theme manager.
trans-unit.target: 主題變更前引發。設定 `Handled` 以自行套用主題（可選擇在 `RunTransitionAsync` 中進行）；否則切換器透過 AtomUI 的主題管理器套用。

trans-unit.source: Which page transition to play (default Reveal).
trans-unit.target: 播放哪種頁面過渡（預設為 Reveal）。

trans-unit.source: A comment and its replies (Arc's `ThreadComment`). Immutable: every change made in a `CommentThread` produces a new tree (unchanged comments are shared), so it can be stored as is.
trans-unit.target: 一則註解及其回覆（Arc 的 `ThreadComment`）。不可變：在 `CommentThread` 中做出的每次變更都會產生新的樹狀結構（未變更的註解會被共用），因此可以原樣儲存。

trans-unit.source: Arc time field: a trigger over a scrolling list of times generated every `MinuteStep` minutes. The list opens centred on the chosen time, arrow keys move the highlight (the list glides to keep it in view, wrapping at both ends), Enter or a click chooses and closes, Escape closes. The shown time rolls like a clock face: a later time rises from below, an earlier one drops from above. 12- or 24-hour display follows the culture unless `ClockFormat` says otherwise; the value is always a 24-hour `TimeOnly`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 時間欄位：觸發器下方是一個可捲動的時間清單，每隔 `MinuteStep` 分鐘產生一項。清單開啟時以所選時間為中心，方向鍵移動反白（清單會滑動以保持其可見，兩端循環），Enter 或按一下選取並關閉，Escape 關閉。顯示的時間如同鐘面一樣滾動：較晚的時間從下方升起，較早的時間從上方落下。除非 `ClockFormat` 另有指定，否則 12 小時制或 24 小時制顯示跟隨文化設定；值一律為 24 小時制的 `TimeOnly`。

trans-unit.source: 12- or 24-hour display (Auto follows the culture).
trans-unit.target: 12 小時制或 24 小時制顯示（Auto 跟隨文化設定）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for the clock format and the AM / PM designators (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 時鐘格式及上午/下午標示所使用的文化（null = 目前 UI 文化）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的輔助文字。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the trigger; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的錯誤提示；非空時欄位為無效狀態。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 清單是否展開（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden but still names the field.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤隱藏，但仍為欄位命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label above the trigger (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 觸發器上方的可見標籤（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the list grows before it scrolls (Arc: 250px).
trans-unit.target: 清單增長的最大高度，超過後捲動（Arc：250px）。

trans-unit.source: Minutes between options (Arc: 1, 5, 10, 15 or 30; default 15).
trans-unit.target: 選項之間的分鐘間隔（Arc：1、5、10、15 或 30；預設 15）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there is no time (Arc: "Select a time").
trans-unit.target: 沒有時間時顯示（Arc 預設文字為「選擇時間」）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen time (two-way). Arc's default is 09:00; null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 所選時間（雙向繫結）。Arc 的預設值為 09:00；null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedTime` changes.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedTime` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Trigger height: Small 36, Medium 44 (default), Large 50.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器高度：Small 36、Medium 44（預設）、Large 50。

trans-unit.source: A vertical activity feed grouped by day, newest first (Arc's `Timeline`), for project history, audit logs and deploy streams. Day labels stay pinned while their updates scroll, the connecting line draws itself as rows come into view, rows with a `Detail` expand in place, and new updates slide in at the top while the rest glide down. ↑ / ↓ / Home / End move between expandable rows; Enter or Space expands one.
trans-unit.target: 依日期分組的垂直活動動態，最新的在前（Arc 的 `Timeline`），適用於專案歷程、稽核記錄和部署串流。日期標籤在其更新捲動時保持固定，連接線會隨列進入視口而自行繪製，帶有 `Detail` 的列會原地展開，新的更新從頂部滑入，其餘內容滑動下移。↑ / ↓ / Home / End 在可展開的列之間移動；Enter 或空白鍵展開一列。

trans-unit.source: Culture of day headings and clock times; null uses en-US (Arc's default locale).
trans-unit.target: 日期標題與時鐘時間所用的文化；null 則使用 en-US（Arc 的預設地區設定）。

trans-unit.source: A row opened or closed by the user (click, keyboard, assistive technology or the methods).
trans-unit.target: 使用者（按一下、鍵盤、輔助技術或方法）開啟或關閉某列時引發。

trans-unit.source: Ids of the expanded rows (Arc's `defaultExpanded`, two-way).
trans-unit.target: 已展開列的 ID（Arc 的 `defaultExpanded`，雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Background of the day labels, which cover the updates scrolling under them (Arc's `--timeline-surface`, Surface by default). Set it to the surface the feed sits on.
trans-unit.target: 日期標籤的背景，覆蓋在其下方捲動的更新內容之上（Arc 的 `--timeline-surface`，預設為 Surface）。請將其設為資訊流所在的表面。

trans-unit.source: Heading level of the day labels (2 to 6; default 3).
trans-unit.target: 日期標籤的標題層級（2 到 6；預設為 3）。

trans-unit.source: Scroll back to the top when a new newest update arrives while the feed is scrolled down.
trans-unit.target: 當資訊流捲動到下方時，若有新的最新更新抵達，則捲動回頂部。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the feed (Arc's required `label`).
trans-unit.target: 資訊流的無障礙名稱（Arc 必要的 `label`）。

trans-unit.source: Reference time for relative labels ("9m") and day groups ("Today"). Pass a ticking clock (about once a minute) to keep labels fresh; the default (`MinValue`) reads the system clock when labels are built.
trans-unit.target: 相對時間標籤（“9m”）與日期分組（“Today”）所用的參考時間。傳入約每分鐘更新一次的時鐘可讓標籤保持最新；預設值（`MinValue`）會在建立標籤時讀取系統時鐘。

trans-unit.source: Time zone for day groups and clock times. Fixed (UTC) by default, like Arc, so every viewer agrees.
trans-unit.target: 日期分組與時刻所用的時區。與 Arc 一樣預設為固定的 UTC，使所有檢視者看到的時間一致。

trans-unit.source: One update in a `Timeline` (Arc's `TimelineEvent`): who did what and when, with optional context and a detail revealed in place. Events are read when they are added; replace an event to change it.
trans-unit.target: `Timeline` 中的一則更新（Arc 的 `TimelineEvent`）：誰在何時做了什麼，可附帶上下文，並可在原位展開詳細資訊。事件在新增時讀取；如需修改，請取代該事件。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast: a brief confirmation for a completed background action (one locally controlled success message such as "Changes saved"). It rises from its edge on the morph spring while its check mark draws itself, closes after `Duration` (the timer does not pause, so keep the copy short), and can be swiped away in either direction with velocity. Text changes rise in place while the height springs to fit. For app-wide notifications (types, actions, updates, stacking) call `Show` from anywhere: it goes to the window's `ToastStack` (see `ToastHost`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知提示（Toast）：用於已完成背景操作的簡短確認（一則本地控制的成功訊息，如“Changes saved”）。它沿邊緣升起，依托形變彈簧運動，同時其勾號逐步繪出；經過 `Duration` 後關閉（計時器不會暫停，因此請保持文案簡短），並可依速度向任一方向滑動移除。文字變化時原位上浮，高度以彈簧方式調整至合適大小。若需應用程式層級的通知（類型、操作、更新、堆疊），請在任意位置呼叫 `Show`：它會進入視窗的 `ToastStack`（參見 `ToastHost`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the toast starts closing.
trans-unit.target: 提示開始關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Optional second line.
trans-unit.target: 可選的第二行文字。

trans-unit.source: Time before the toast closes itself (default 4.5s); zero or less keeps it until closed.
trans-unit.target: 提示自動關閉前的時間（預設 4.5s）；為零或負值時會保持顯示，直到手動關閉。

trans-unit.source: Whether the toast is shown (default true). Closing, swiping or timing out sets it to false. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 提示是否顯示（預設為 true）。關閉、滑動移除或逾時後會設為 false。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: The message. A new title rises in while the old one lifts away.
trans-unit.target: 訊息內容。新標題上浮出現，舊標題向上移出。

trans-unit.source: What to show in a new toast (`Show`).
trans-unit.target: 新提示的顯示內容（`Show`）。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast stack: short, non-blocking results of what someone just did, stacked at the edge of the window until they reach for them. New toasts rise from the bottom edge, older ones tuck 14px behind and shrink by 5% per step; hovering or focusing the stack fans it out into a list (Alt+T moves focus in). Toasts pause while the stack is open, dragged or the window is minimized, swipe right to dismiss, and morph in place when updated (`Update`): a loading toast becomes its result. Place one in the window (over the content, for example as the last child of the root panel) or let `ToastHost` create one on the window's overlay layer; then call `Show` or this control's `IToastService` methods from anywhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知堆疊：對某人剛完成操作的簡短、非阻塞結果，堆疊在視窗邊緣，直到使用者主動查看。新提示從底部邊緣升起，較舊的提示向後收入 14px 並每層縮小 5%；懸停或聚焦到堆疊區時會展開為清單（Alt+T 可將焦點移入）。開啟、拖曳或視窗最小化時提示會暫停；向右滑動可關閉；透過 `Update` 更新時會原位變形（載入中的提示會變為其結果）。可將其放置在視窗中（覆蓋在內容之上，例如作為根面板的最後一個子元素），或讓 `ToastHost` 在視窗的覆蓋層上自動建立；之後在任意位置呼叫 `Show` 或此控制項的 `IToastService` 方法即可。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts are queued (shown or waiting behind).
trans-unit.target: 排隊中的提示數量（顯示中及等待中的）。

trans-unit.source: Base lifetime (default 5s). Warnings and errors stay 1.6 times longer; loading toasts wait for an update.
trans-unit.target: 基礎顯示時長（預設 5s）。警告和錯誤的時長為其 1.6 倍；載入中的提示會等待更新。

trans-unit.source: Pins the stack 16px inside its own bounds (panels and previews) instead of 24px from the window edge.
trans-unit.target: 將堆疊固定在其自身邊界內 16px 處（適用於面板和預覽），而非距視窗邊緣 24px。

trans-unit.source: True while the stack is fanned out (hover, keyboard focus or a tap).
trans-unit.target: 堆疊展開時為 true（懸停、鍵盤焦點或點按時）。

trans-unit.source: Alt+T moves keyboard focus into the stack (default true).
trans-unit.target: Alt+T 將鍵盤焦點移入堆疊（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the notification region (default "Notifications").
trans-unit.target: 通知區域的無障礙名稱（預設為“Notifications”）。

trans-unit.source: Oldest toasts beyond this count are dropped (default 12).
trans-unit.target: 超出此數量的最舊提示會被捨棄（預設 12）。

trans-unit.source: Edge position (default bottom right). Windows narrower than 480px always center the stack.
trans-unit.target: 邊緣位置（預設右下）。寬度小於 480px 的視窗會始終將堆疊置中。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a toast is shown, updated or dismissed.
trans-unit.target: 提示被顯示、更新或關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts show at once (default 3); older ones wait behind and return as the front ones close.
trans-unit.target: 同時顯示的提示數量（預設 3）；較舊的提示在後方等待，前方的提示關閉後再依序出現。

trans-unit.source: A short label on hover or keyboard focus. Attach it to any control with `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"` (and optionally `arc:Tooltip.Side`). The first tooltip waits 250ms and rises 3px from its trigger; while any tooltip is open, and for 300ms after the last one closes, the next opens at once with a fade only. String content that changes while open crossfades and the bubble springs to the new size. The `Tooltip` instance itself is the bubble shown in the popup.
trans-unit.target: 懸停或鍵盤聚焦時顯示的簡短標籤。使用 `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"`（可選 `arc:Tooltip.Side`）即可將其附加到任意控制項。第一個提示會等待 250ms，並從其觸發點上浮 3px；當任一提示開啟時，以及最後一個提示關閉後的 300ms 內，下一個提示會立即開啟，僅做淡入淡出。開啟期間變化的字串內容會交叉淡入，氣泡以彈簧方式調整到新尺寸。`Tooltip` 實例本身即為彈出層中顯示的氣泡。

trans-unit.source: Shows or hides the tooltip on the element at once, without ShowDelay.
trans-unit.target: 立即顯示或隱藏該元素上的提示，不經過 ShowDelay。

trans-unit.source: Wait before the first tooltip opens after hover or focus; default 250 ms. Open tooltips skip the wait.
trans-unit.target: 指標懸停或取得焦點後，第一個提示開啟前的等待時間；預設 250 ms。已開啟的提示會跳過等待。

trans-unit.source: Side of the trigger the bubble opens on: Top (default), Bottom, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 氣泡相對於觸發元素開啟的一側：Top（預設）、Bottom、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Tooltip content: a string, or any object (bind it when the text comes from the view model).
trans-unit.target: 提示內容：字串或任意物件（當文字來自檢視模型時進行繫結）。

trans-unit.source: A keyboard-navigable file tree with animated folders and a selection fill that glides between rows. Folders open with their space growing on a smooth spring while the new rows stagger in; the chevron turns on a snappy spring and the folder icon pops open. Keyboard: ↑/↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter/Space select and toggle, and typing jumps to a matching row. Unlike `TreeView` (nested item containers), rows are a flat, virtualized list of pooled, self-drawn rows (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`): thousands of open nodes cost one screenful of rows, and the open / close motion never relayouts the whole tree. Nodes come from inline `Items` (`TreeViewItem`) or from `ItemsSource` with `ChildrenSelector`.
trans-unit.target: 可用鍵盤導覽的檔案樹，資料夾帶動畫，選取填滿會在列之間平滑滑動。資料夾展開時其空間以平滑彈簧增長，新列依序交錯出現；箭頭以靈敏的彈簧轉動，資料夾圖示彈出展開。鍵盤操作：↑/↓ 移動，→ 展開或進入，← 收合或回到上層，Home/End，PageUp/PageDown，Enter/Space 選取並切換展開，輸入字元可跳到符合的列。與 `TreeView`（巢狀的項目容器）不同，列是扁平的虛擬化清單，由池化的自繪列組成（參見 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`）：數千個展開的節點只需繪製一螢幕的列，展開和收合動畫也從不重新配置整棵樹。節點可來自內嵌的 `Items`（`TreeViewItem`），或來自帶 `ChildrenSelector` 的 `ItemsSource`。

trans-unit.source: Children of a data item (null or empty: a file). Not needed for `TreeViewItem` nodes.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的子項（為 null 或空時：表示檔案）。`TreeViewItem` 節點無需設定。

trans-unit.source: Row label of a data item; `ToString()` when not set.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的列標籤；未設定時使用 `ToString()`。

trans-unit.source: Optional icon of a data item (24x24 stroked glyph); folders and files get Arc's icons otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的可選圖示（24x24 描邊圖示）；否則資料夾和檔案使用 Arc 的圖示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a branch item collapses.
trans-unit.target: 分支項目收合時引發。

trans-unit.target: 分支項目展開時引發。

trans-unit.target: 列被點按或透過 Enter / Space 啟動時引發（Arc 的 `onSelect`），即使該列已被選取。

trans-unit.target: 選取的節點（雙向繫結）。將其設為隱藏節點時會展開其祖系節點。

trans-unit.target: 選取項目變更時引發；參數包含舊項目與新項目。

trans-unit.source: Shows each row's icon (16px slot before the label); when false the label starts at the indent.
trans-unit.target: 顯示每列的圖示（標籤前有 16px 的占位）；為 false 時標籤從縮排處開始。

trans-unit.source: Draws the short branch line beside nested rows (Arc's indent guide).
trans-unit.target: 在巢狀列旁繪製短的分支線（Arc 的縮排參考線）。

trans-unit.source: A node written inline in a `TreeView` (Arc's `TreeNode`): a label, optional icon and child nodes. A node with children is a folder. Not a control: the tree draws its rows itself (virtualized), so nodes stay cheap however many there are.
trans-unit.target: 在 `TreeView` 中內嵌撰寫的節點（Arc 的 `TreeNode`）：包含標籤、可選圖示和子節點。含子節點的節點即為資料夾。它不是控制項：樹會自行繪製其列（虛擬化），因此無論節點多少都很輕量。

trans-unit.target: 列的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Optional 24x24 stroked glyph (for example an `ArcIcons` member) replacing the folder / file icon.
trans-unit.target: 可選的 24x24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 成員），用於取代資料夾或檔案圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the folder is open (two-way; the tree keeps it in sync).
trans-unit.target: 資料夾是否展開（雙向繫結；樹會保持同步）。

trans-unit.source: A squarified treemap (Arc "Treemap") for a hierarchy of parts. Top-level branches take Series1–4 and, with `ColorLabel`, every tile deepens with a second measure. Clicking (or Enter on) a branch zooms in: the tile grows to fill the view while its siblings fly out and its children open inside it, all on one affine 0.62s spring; the breadcrumb, Escape or Backspace zoom back out along the same path. A data change morphs every tile in place. Labels never scale: each tile lays its text out at its size and shows it only when it fits.
trans-unit.target: 方塊化樹狀圖（Arc 的“Treemap”），用於呈現階層結構的各個部分。頂層分支使用 Series1–4；設定 `ColorLabel` 後，每個方塊會隨第二個度量值加深顏色。點按（或在分支上按 Enter）可放大該分支：方塊放大以填滿檢視，同層方塊飛出，其子項在其中展開，全部由一個 0.62s 的仿射彈簧驅動；麵包屑導覽、Escape 或 Backspace 會沿同一路徑縮小返回。資料變化時，每個方塊原位變形。標籤從不縮放：每個方塊以其自身尺寸排版文字，並僅在能放下時顯示。

trans-unit.source: A metered billing period on one page: what has been spent so far and the projected total, the spend per day, each meter's usage against what the plan includes (with the overage priced), and a spending limit that can be turned on and set in place. The totals follow the meters: change `Used` and the amounts, bars and projection update. "Today" comes from `Clock`.
trans-unit.target: 頁面中的一個計量計費週期：迄今已花費的金額與預估總額、每日花費、每個計量項目的用量與方案內含額度的對比（超額部分依價格計費），以及可就地開啟並設定的支出上限。總額會隨計量項目變化：修改 `Used` 後，金額、進度條與預估總額都會隨之更新。「今天」取自 `Clock`。

trans-unit.source: The share of the limit (0–1, default 0.8) at which the progress turns to the warning color and the tick sits.
trans-unit.target: 達到上限的比例（0–1，預設 0.8），進度條到達該比例時變為警告色，刻度線也位於此處。

trans-unit.source: The fixed charge of the period (the plan price), added to the metered charges.
trans-unit.target: 本週期的固定費用（方案價格），會加到計量費用之上。

trans-unit.source: ISO 4217 code of every amount ("USD" by default).
trans-unit.target: 所有金額所用的 ISO 4217 貨幣代碼（預設為「USD」）。

trans-unit.source: What the period has cost so far: `BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal`.
trans-unit.target: 本週期迄今的費用：`BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal`。

trans-unit.source: The amount spent on each day of the period, starting with the first day. Days after today are not drawn; a null or empty list hides the daily spend card. A list that raises collection changes redraws as it changes.
trans-unit.target: 計費週期內每天的花費金額，從第一天開始。今天之後的日期不繪製；null 或空列表會隱藏每日花費卡片。會引發集合變更的列表在變動時會重新繪製。

trans-unit.source: Whether the spending limit applies. Two-way: the limit switch edits it.
trans-unit.target: 支出上限是否生效（雙向繫結）：上限開關會修改此值。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text and its culture; replace the object to localize the block.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字及其地區性設定；替換整個物件即可在地化此區塊。

trans-unit.source: Where `CurrentTotal` stands against the spending limit and its alert threshold.

trans-unit.source: The sum of every meter's `Cost`.
trans-unit.target: 所有計量項目的 `Cost` 總和。

trans-unit.source: The meters of the period, in display order. Meters written inline in XAML land here.
trans-unit.target: 本週期的計量項目，依顯示順序排列。直接在 XAML 中內嵌撰寫的計量項目會放在此處。

trans-unit.source: The last day of the billing period (inclusive); by default the last day of the start's month.
trans-unit.target: 計費週期的最後一天（含當天）；預設為開始日期所在月份的最後一天。

trans-unit.source: The first day of the billing period; by default the first day of the `Clock`'s month.
trans-unit.target: 計費週期的第一天；預設為 `Clock` 所在月份的第一天。

trans-unit.source: The period's expected total if usage keeps its pace: `BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal` ÷ the share of the period's days that have begun by `Clock`'s today (kept between one day's share and 1).
trans-unit.target: 若用量維持目前的節奏，本週期的預估總額：`BaseFee` + `MeteredTotal` ÷ 截至 `Clock` 當天已開始的週期天數佔比（限制在一天的佔比與 1 之間）。

trans-unit.source: The spending limit for the period, in `Currency`. Two-way: the limit field edits it.
trans-unit.target: 本週期的支出上限，以 `Currency` 計價。雙向繫結：上限輸入欄會修改此值。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the spending limit changes or is turned on or off. While someone types in the limit field the change is reported once, when the field loses focus or Enter is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 支出上限變更、或被開啟或關閉時引發。在上限輸入欄中輸入的過程中，變更只會在輸入欄失去焦點或按下 Enter 時回報一次。

trans-unit.source: Shows what fills a fixed allowance and how close it is to the limit (Arc UsageMeter): a title with a status badge, the rolling total, a bar of accent steps (one per category) and a legend that doubles as the keyboard path. The first time 40% of the meter is visible the categories grow in left to right; later changes re-flow every category on its own smooth spring (P18, P23) and the numbers roll the way they moved (P14). Past the limit the bar is struck through with a hatch beside a limit marker, so the overage reads without color. Hovering or focusing a category previews it (the others dim); a press pins it until pressed again or Escape. Categories come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Segments`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示固定配額已佔用多少，以及距離上限還有多遠（Arc UsageMeter）：包括標題和狀態徽章、滾動的總量、依類別分段的強調色進度條，以及兼作鍵盤操作路徑的圖例。首次有 40% 的儀表可見時，各類別從左到右增長；之後的變化會以各自的平滑彈簧重新排列每個類別（P18, P23），數字也會依變化方向滾動（P14）。超過上限後，進度條會以斜線劃掉，並在旁邊顯示上限標記，即使沒有顏色也能看出超出部分。懸停或聚焦某一類別會預覽它（其餘變暗）；按下會將其固定，直到再次按下或按 Escape。類別來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `Segments`。

trans-unit.source: Digits after the decimal point (Arc: 1).

trans-unit.target: 剩餘配額的圖例標籤（Arc `freeLabel`，“Free”）。

trans-unit.source: One category of a `UsageMeter` (Arc `segments[]` entry).
trans-unit.target: `UsageMeter` 的一個類別（Arc `segments[]` 項目）。

trans-unit.source: Stable identity: keep it while the value changes, so the segment re-flows instead of being replaced.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼：數值變化時保持不變，使分段重新排列而非被取代。

trans-unit.source: Category name shown for the segment (Arc `label`).
trans-unit.target: 該區段顯示的類別名稱（Arc 的 `label`）。

trans-unit.source: Amount used, in the meter's unit.

trans-unit.source: The account menu behind a person's avatar in an app's top bar (Arc user menu): a compact identity header, a short group of account destinations (`Items`, keep it to three or four), an inline light / dark / system switch, an optional presence switch and sign out. Theme and status choices keep the menu open; everything else closes it and returns focus to the avatar. When `SignOutAction` returns an unfinished task the row shows a spinner and "Signing out", and the menu closes once it settles. Below a 640px wide window the menu opens as a bottom sheet that follows a downward drag. The panel scales out of the avatar on a spring that never overshoots, rows fade in 16ms apart, one highlight glides between rows and the switch thumbs slide on Arc's CSS spring.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式頂欄中位於使用者頭像後的帳戶選單（Arc 使用者選單）：包含精簡的身分標題、一組簡短的帳戶目的地（`Items`，建議保留三到四個）、內嵌的淺色 / 深色 / 跟隨系統切換、可選的線上狀態切換以及登出。主題和狀態選項會使選單保持開啟；其他操作會關閉選單並將焦點返回頭像。當 `SignOutAction` 回傳未完成的工作時，該列會顯示載入指示並顯示“Signing out”，待其完成後選單再關閉。視窗寬度小於 640px 時，選單會以底部面板形式開啟，並跟隨向下拖曳。面板以不會過衝的彈簧從頭像處縮放展開，各列每隔 16ms 依序淡入，一個反白區塊在列間滑動，開關滑塊依 Arc 的 CSS 彈簧滑動。

trans-unit.source: Sign-out handler. An unfinished task keeps the menu open with a spinner until it settles.
trans-unit.target: 登出處理常式。未完成的工作會使選單保持開啟並顯示載入指示，直到工作完成。

trans-unit.source: An animated semantic search: a question is typed, embedded into a vector, dropped into a map of document vectors, and its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity become the ranked answers. The search is real (hashed bag-of-words embeddings, cosine ranking, a principal-component map), so `Search` works with any question.
trans-unit.target: 動態語意搜尋：輸入一個問題，將其嵌入為向量，放入文件向量地圖中，並依餘弦相似度取出最近鄰作為排序後的答案。搜尋是真實的（雜湊詞袋嵌入、餘弦排序、主成分地圖），因此 `Search` 可處理任何問題。

trans-unit.source: The documents to search (defaults to 32 help-centre articles in four topics).
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的文件（預設為四個主題下的 32 篇說明中心文章）。

trans-unit.source: Step titles, badges and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的步驟標題、徽章與說明文字；設定此項可重新命名或翻譯場景。

trans-unit.source: One category of a `WaffleChart`: a share of the whole drawn as countable cells.
trans-unit.target: `WaffleChart` 的一個類別：整體中的一份佔比，以可計數的方格繪製。

trans-unit.source: A unit chart (Arc "Waffle chart"): a rows × columns grid where every cell is one share of the whole (10 × 10 = one cell per percent), filled column by column from the bottom-left corner. Cells are persistent: when the data changes they stay put where they can and the rest fly, staggered, to their new block while dipping and changing color. The legend rolls each share to its new value; hovering or focusing a category dims the others, clicking pins it. Arrow keys walk the grid cell by cell, Page Up / Page Down jump between categories, Escape clears the reading.
trans-unit.target: 單位圖表（Arc“Waffle chart”）：列 × 欄的網格，每個方格代表整體的一份（10 × 10 = 每格一個百分比），從左下角開始逐欄填滿。方格是持久的：資料變化時，盡量保留在原位，其餘方格則交錯飛至新的區塊，過程中下沉並改變顏色。圖例會將各佔比滾動到新值；懸停或聚焦某一類別會使其他類別變暗，點按則將其固定。方向鍵逐格移動網格，Page Up / Page Down 在類別之間跳轉，Escape 清除讀數。
